@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_success_becomes_terminal_idempotent_replay() -> None:
    _require_database()

    publication_id = uuid4()
    idempotency_key = f"ws22-3-5-6-{uuid4()}"
    correlation_id = f"corr-{uuid4()}"

    request = PublicationExecutionRequest(
        publication_id=publication_id,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        actor="ws22-3-5-6-test",
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
    )

    publisher_1 = RecordingPublisher(
        result="provider-terminal-message",
    )

    composition_1 = create_durable_publication_execution_composition(
        publisher=publisher_1,
    )

    try:
        first = await composition_1.service.execute(
            publication=ApprovedPublication(id=publication_id),
            request=request,
        )

        assert first.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
        assert first.provider_message_id == "provider-terminal-message"
        assert len(publisher_1.calls) == 1

        async with composition_1.session_factory() as session:
            execution = await session.scalar(
                select(PublicationExecutionRecordModel).where(
                    PublicationExecutionRecordModel.idempotency_key
                    == idempotency_key
                )
            )

            assert execution is not None
            assert execution.status == "succeeded"
            assert execution.attempt == 1
            assert execution.provider_message_id == (
                "provider-terminal-message"
            )
            assert execution.error_code is None

    finally:
        await composition_1.dispose()

    # Simulate a real application restart.
    publisher_2 = RecordingPublisher(
        result="MUST-NOT-BE-SENT",
    )

    composition_2 = create_durable_publication_execution_composition(
        publisher=publisher_2,
    )

    try:
        replay = await composition_2.service.execute(
            publication=ApprovedPublication(id=publication_id),
            request=request,
        )

        assert replay.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY
        assert replay.provider_message_id == "provider-terminal-message"

        # Terminal success means the external provider must never be called
        # again for the same idempotency key.
        assert publisher_2.calls == []

        async with composition_2.session_factory() as session:
            execution = await session.scalar(
                select(PublicationExecutionRecordModel).where(
                    PublicationExecutionRecordModel.idempotency_key
                    == idempotency_key
                )
            )

            assert execution is not None
            assert execution.status == "succeeded"
            assert execution.attempt == 1
            assert execution.provider_message_id == (
                "provider-terminal-message"
            )

            audit_events = (
                await session.scalars(
                    select(PublicationAuditEventModel)
                    .where(
                        PublicationAuditEventModel.publication_id
                        == str(publication_id)
                    )
                    .order_by(PublicationAuditEventModel.id)
                )
            ).all()

            # Replay must not create another publication audit event.
            assert len(audit_events) == 1
            assert audit_events[0].event_type == "published"

    finally:
        await _cleanup(
            composition_2,
            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
            publication_id=publication_id,
        )
        await composition_2.dispose()

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI

from backend.app.api.announcement_operations_approval import (
    create_announcement_operations_approval_router,
)
from backend.app.application.announcements.approval.approval_service import (
    AnnouncementPublicationApprovalService,
)
from backend.app.application.announcements.publication_service import (
    AnnouncementPublicationService,
)
from backend.app.application.announcements.template_registry import (
    AnnouncementTemplateRegistry,
)
from backend.app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from backend.app.domain.announcements.template_models import PublicationStatus, PublicationType
from backend.app.infrastructure.announcements.in_memory_repositories import (
    InMemoryAnnouncementTemplateRepository,
    InMemoryPublicationRepository,
)


class AuditRecorder:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.events: list[dict] = []

    async def record_approval(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        self.events.append(kwargs)


def make_publication(status: PublicationStatus) -> Publication:
    return Publication(
        publication_id="ws23-1-3-api-test",
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


def make_service(repo: InMemoryPublicationRepository) -> AnnouncementPublicationApprovalService:
    template_repository = InMemoryAnnouncementTemplateRepository()
    templates = AnnouncementTemplateRegistry(repository=template_repository)
    publication_service = AnnouncementPublicationService(
        templates=templates,
        publications=repo,
    )
    return AnnouncementPublicationApprovalService(
        publications=publication_service,
        audit=AuditRecorder(),
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approval_api_requires_administrator_authorization() -> None:
    repo = InMemoryPublicationRepository()
    publication = make_publication(PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL)
    repo.save(publication)

    service = make_service(repo)
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(
        create_announcement_operations_approval_router(
            approval_service=service,
            admin_authorizer=lambda: _deny(),
        )
    )

    async with AsyncClient(
        transport=ASGITransport(app=app),
        base_url="http://test",
    ) as client:
        response = await client.post(
            f"/api/announcement-operations/publications/{publication.publication_id}/approve",
            json={"actor": "admin-test"},
        )

    assert response.status_code == 403
    assert repo.get(publication.publication_id).status is PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL


async def _deny() -> bool:
    return False


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approval_api_approves_pending_publication() -> None:
    repo = InMemoryPublicationRepository()
    publication = make_publication(PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL)
    repo.save(publication)

    audit = AuditRecorder()
    template_repository = InMemoryAnnouncementTemplateRepository()
    templates = AnnouncementTemplateRegistry(repository=template_repository)
    publication_service = AnnouncementPublicationService(
        templates=templates,
        publications=repo,

        return True

        create_announcement_operations_approval_router(
            approval_service=service,
            admin_authorizer=allow,
        )

    async with AsyncClient(

        )

    assert response.json()["status"] == "approved"
    assert repo.get(publication.publication_id).status is PublicationStatus.APPROVED
    assert len(audit.events) == 1
    assert audit.events[0]["actor"] == "admin-test"

class FakeAsyncRepository:
    def __init__(self, publication: Publication | None) -> None:
        self.publication = publication
        self.saved = []

    async def get_async(self, publication_id: str):
        if self.publication and self.publication.publication_id == publication_id:
            return self.publication
        return None

    async def save_async(self, publication: Publication) -> None:
        self.saved.append(publication)
        self.publication = publication


class AuditRecorder:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.events = []

    async def record_approval(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        self.events.append(kwargs)


def make_publication() -> Publication:
    return Publication(
        publication_id="ws23-1-3-persistence-test",
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,

        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from backend.app.application.announcements.execution.approved_publication_execution import (
    ApprovedPublicationExecutionService,
)
from backend.app.application.announcements.execution.contracts import (
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)
from backend.app.domain.announcements.publication import Publication
from backend.app.domain.announcements.template_models import (
    PublicationStatus,
    PublicationType,
)


class FakeDurableExecution:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = []

    async def execute(self, *, publication, request):
        self.calls.append((publication, request))
        return type(
            "Result",
            (),
            {
                "status": PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED,
            },
        )()


def make_publication(
    *,
    status: PublicationStatus = PublicationStatus.APPROVED,
) -> Publication:
    return Publication(
        publication_id=str(uuid4()),
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approved_publication_delegates_to_existing_ws22_service() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = make_publication()

    result = await service.execute(
        publication=publication,
        actor="admin-test",
        idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
        correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert len(durable.calls) == 1
    _, request = durable.calls[0]
    assert request.actor == "admin-test"
    assert request.idempotency_key == "ws23-1-4-test-key"
    assert request.correlation_id == "ws23-1-4-correlation"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_non_uuid_publication_id_is_rejected_at_ws22_boundary() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = Publication(
        publication_id="ws23-publication-001",
        template_id="beta-update",
        template_version=1,
        publication_type=PublicationType.BETA_UPDATE,
        title="Beta update",
        content="Test announcement",
        status=PublicationStatus.APPROVED,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Approved publication ID must be a UUID",
    ):
        await service.execute(
            publication=publication,
            actor="admin-test",
            idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
            correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
        )

    assert durable.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_non_approved_publication_is_not_sent_directly() -> None:
    durable = FakeDurableExecution()
    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=durable,
    )

    publication = make_publication(
        status=PublicationStatus.PENDING_APPROVAL,
    )

    # The integration boundary itself does not bypass WS-22. The canonical
    # durable service remains responsible for enforcing approved-only execution.
    class RejectingDurableExecution:
        async def execute(self, *, publication, request):
            raise ValueError("Only approved publications may be executed.")

    service = ApprovedPublicationExecutionService(
        durable_execution=RejectingDurableExecution(),
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Only approved publications may be executed",
    ):
        await service.execute(
            publication=publication,
            actor="admin-test",
            idempotency_key="ws23-1-4-test-key",
            correlation_id="ws23-1-4-correlation",
        )

class FakeControlledPublisher:

    async def publish(
        self,

    ):
        self.calls.append(

import pytest

from backend.app.application.announcement_operations.publication_execution_service import (
    PublicationExecutionService,
)
from app.domain.announcement_publication.execution import (
    PublishAnnouncementCommand,
    PublicationExecutionStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.announcement_operations.publication_execution_ports import (
    PublicationForExecution,
)


class FakeRepository:
    def __init__(self, publication=None):
        self.publication = publication
        self.results = []

    async def get_for_execution(self, publication_id):
        return self.publication

    async def record_execution(self, result):
        self.results.append(result)


class FakePublisher:
    def __init__(self, reference="provider-123", error=None):
        self.reference = reference
        self.error = error
        self.calls = 0

    async def publish(self, *, publication, idempotency_key):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.error:
            raise RuntimeError(self.error)
        return self.reference


class FakeIdempotencyStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = {}

    async def get_result(self, idempotency_key):
        return self.results.get(idempotency_key)

    async def store_result(self, result):
        self.results[result.idempotency_key] = result


class FakeAuditSink:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    async def record(self, event):
        self.events.append(event)


def make_service(publication=None, publisher=None):
    repository = FakeRepository(publication)
    publisher = publisher or FakePublisher()
    idempotency = FakeIdempotencyStore()
    audit = FakeAuditSink()

    service = PublicationExecutionService(
        repository=repository,
        publisher=publisher,
        idempotency_store=idempotency,
        audit_sink=audit,
    )
    return service, repository, publisher, idempotency, audit


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_executes_approved_publication():
    service, repository, publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-001",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Approved announcement",
        )
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-001",
            idempotency_key="idem-001",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert result.provider_reference == "provider-123"
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(repository.results) == 1
    assert len(audit.events) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_rejects_non_executable_publication():
    service, repository, publisher, _idempotency, audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-002",
            status="draft",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Draft",
        )
    )

    result = await service.execute(
        PublishAnnouncementCommand(
            publication_id="pub-002",
            idempotency_key="idem-002",
            requested_by="operator-001",
        )
    )

    assert result.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.FAILED
    assert publisher.calls == 0
    assert len(repository.results) == 1
    assert len(audit.events) == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ws22_3_1_is_idempotent():
    service, _repository, publisher, idempotency, _audit = make_service(
        PublicationForExecution(
            publication_id="pub-003",
            status="approved",
            destination="announcement-group",
            rendered_content="Approved",
        )
    )

    command = PublishAnnouncementCommand(
        publication_id="pub-003",
        idempotency_key="idem-003",
        requested_by="operator-001",
    )

    first = await service.execute(command)
    second = await service.execute(command)

    assert first.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert second.status is PublicationExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED
    assert first.provider_reference == second.provider_reference
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    assert len(idempotency.results) == 1

@dataclass
class FakeTelegramMessage:
    message_id: int


class FakeTelegramClient:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[dict] = []

    async def send_message(
        self,
        *,
        chat_id: str,
        text: str,
        parse_mode: str,
    ) -> FakeTelegramMessage:
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "chat_id": chat_id,
                "text": text,
                "parse_mode": parse_mode,
            }
        )

        return FakeTelegramMessage(
            message_id=123,
        )


def create_test_app(
    *,
    client: FakeTelegramClient,
    authorized: bool = True,
    publishing_enabled: bool = True,
) -> FastAPI:
    publisher = ControlledAnnouncementPublisher(
        publisher=_TelegramPublisherDouble(
            client=client,
        ),
        publishing_enabled=publishing_enabled,
    )

    async def authorize_admin() -> bool:
        return authorized

    router = create_announcement_router(
        publisher=publisher,
        composer=AnnouncementComposer(),
        admin_authorizer=authorize_admin,
    )

    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(router)

    return app


class _TelegramPublisherDouble:
    """Small test double implementing AnnouncementPublisher."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        client: FakeTelegramClient,
    ) -> None:
        self._client = client

    async def publish(
        self,
        *,
        channel_id: str,
        text: str,
    ) -> str:
        result = await self._client.send_message(
            chat_id=channel_id,
            text=text,
            parse_mode="Markdown",
        )

        return str(result.message_id)

    |

def test_complete_voice_call_lifecycle():
    """
    Validate complete voice journey.
    """

    #
    # Step 1:
    # Trigger voice call
    #

    trigger_response = client.post(
        "/voice/trigger",
        json={
            "learner_id": "learner-001",
            "character_id": "yeti",
            "world_id": "french_world",
            "language_code": "fr",
            "channel": "inbox",
        },
    )


    assert trigger_response.status_code == 200


    trigger_body = (
        trigger_response.json()
    )


    voice_call_id = (
        trigger_body["voice_call_id"]
    )


    notification_id = (
        trigger_body["notification_id"]
    )


    assert voice_call_id

    assert notification_id



    #
    # Step 2:
    # Accept notification
    #

    acceptance_response = client.post(
        f"/voice/notification/{notification_id}/accept"
    )


    print(
        acceptance_response.json()
    )


    assert acceptance_response.status_code == 200


    acceptance_body = (
        acceptance_response.json()
    )


    assert acceptance_body[
        "voice_call_id"
    ] == voice_call_id


    assert acceptance_body[
        "learner_id"
    ] == "learner-001"


    assert acceptance_body[

        },
    )


    second = client.post(
        "/voice/trigger",
        json={
            "learner_id": "learner-001",
            "character_id": "alix",
            "world_id": "french_world",
            "language_code": "fr",
            "channel": "inbox",
        },
    )


    assert first.status_code == 200

    assert second.status_code == 200


    first_body = first.json()

    second_body = second.json()


    assert (
        first_body["voice_call_id"]
        !=
        second_body["voice_call_id"]
    )


    assert (
        first_body["notification_id"]
        !=
        second_body["notification_id"]
    )

    build_voice_call_management_service,
)

    app
)



def create_voice_call():

    service = (
        build_voice_call_management_service()
    )


    voice_call = (
        service.create_call(
            learner_id="learner-001",
            character_id="yeti",
            world_id="french_world",
            language_code="fr",
        )
    )


    disconnected = (
        voice_call
        .mark_disconnected()
    )


    service.repository.save(
        voice_call=disconnected,
    )


    return voice_call



def test_reconnect_existing_voice_call():

    voice_call = (
        create_voice_call()
    )


    response = client.post(
        f"/voice/call/{voice_call.id}/reconnect"
    )


    print(
        response.json()
    )


    assert response.status_code == 200


    body = response.json()


    assert body["voice_call_id"] == (
        voice_call.id
    )


    assert body["character_id"] == (
        "yeti"
    )


    assert body["language_code"] == (
        "fr"
    )


    assert body["state"] == (
        "ready"
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from backend.app.application.composition.beta_telegram_composition import (
    create_beta_telegram_composition,
)
from backend.app.application.providers.provider_usage_capture import (
    ProviderUsageCapture,
)
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.repository import ProviderUsageRepository


class RecordingRepository(ProviderUsageRepository):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.events = []

    def save(self, event) -> None:
        self.events.append(event)

    def get_all(self):
        return list(self.events)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self.events.clear()


def test_composition_injects_durable_usage_repository_into_capture() -> None:
    repository = RecordingRepository()
    runtime = MagicMock()

    composition = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=MagicMock(),
        token_repository=MagicMock(),
        binding_repository=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_repository=MagicMock(),
        privacy_identifier_service=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_validator=MagicMock(),
        conversation_runtime=runtime,
        provider_usage_repository=repository,
    )

    assert composition.provider_usage_repository is repository
    assert composition.conversation_runtime is runtime


def test_default_composition_retains_in_memory_usage_repository() -> None:
    runtime = MagicMock()

    composition = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=MagicMock(),
        token_repository=MagicMock(),
        binding_repository=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_repository=MagicMock(),
        privacy_identifier_service=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_validator=MagicMock(),
        conversation_runtime=runtime,
    )

    # Explicit runtime injection must not silently create a competing usage
    # repository or alter the injected runtime.
    assert composition.provider_usage_repository is None
    assert composition.conversation_runtime is runtime


def test_provider_usage_repository_is_not_required_for_injected_capture() -> None:
    capture = MagicMock(spec=ProviderUsageCapture)
    runtime = MagicMock()

    composition = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=MagicMock(),
        token_repository=MagicMock(),
        binding_repository=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_repository=MagicMock(),
        privacy_identifier_service=MagicMock(),
        conversation_event_validator=MagicMock(),
        conversation_runtime=runtime,
        provider_usage_capture=capture,
    )

    assert composition.provider_usage_repository is None
    assert composition.conversation_runtime is runtime

"""P1.6.1 regression: production composition attaches durable usage capture."""

import asyncio

from backend.app.application.composition.beta_telegram_composition import (
    create_beta_telegram_composition,
)
from backend.app.application.providers.provider_usage_capture import (
    ProviderUsageCapture,
)
from backend.app.ai_runtime.conversation.conversation_runtime import ConversationRuntime


def test_factory_runtime_gets_durable_usage_capture():
    class FakeRepository:
        def __init__(self):
            self.event = None

        def save(self, event):
            self.event = event

        def get_all(self):
            return [] if self.event is None else [self.event]

        def clear(self):
            self.event = None

    class FakeProvider:
        async def generate(self, *, system_prompt, user_message):
            from backend.app.providers.provider_result import (
                ProviderResult,
                ProviderUsage,
            )

            return ProviderResult(
                success=True,
                provider_id="p1_6_1_fake",
                model="deterministic",
                content="ok",
                usage=ProviderUsage(
                    input_tokens=2,
                    output_tokens=3,
                    total_tokens=5,
                ),
                provider_request_id="req-p1-6-1",
                latency_ms=7,
            )

    class FakeUserRepository:
        pass

    class FakeTokenRepository:
        pass

    class FakeBindingRepository:
        pass

    class FakeConversationEventRepository:
        pass

    class FakePrivacyIdentifierService:
        pass

    class FakeConversationEventValidator:
        pass

    repo = FakeRepository()

    runtime = ConversationRuntime(
        llm_provider=FakeProvider(),
    )

    composition = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=FakeUserRepository(),
        token_repository=FakeTokenRepository(),
        binding_repository=FakeBindingRepository(),
        conversation_event_repository=FakeConversationEventRepository(),
        privacy_identifier_service=FakePrivacyIdentifierService(),
        conversation_event_validator=FakeConversationEventValidator(),
        conversation_runtime_factory=lambda: runtime,
        provider_usage_repository=repo,
    )

    resolved = composition.conversation_runtime

    assert isinstance(resolved, ConversationRuntime)
    assert isinstance(resolved.usage_capture, ProviderUsageCapture)

    result = asyncio.run(
        resolved.respond(
            character_instruction="You are a test tutor.",
            learner_message="Bonjour",
        )
    )

    assert result == "ok"
    assert repo.event is not None
    assert repo.event.provider == "p1_6_1_fake"
    assert repo.event.model == "deterministic"
    assert repo.event.input_tokens == 2
    assert repo.event.output_tokens == 3
    assert repo.event.latency_ms == 7
    assert repo.event.success is True


def test_factory_runtime_captures_failure_before_runtime_raises():
    class FakeRepository:
        def __init__(self):
            self.event = None

        def save(self, event):
            self.event = event

        def get_all(self):
            return [] if self.event is None else [self.event]

        def clear(self):
            self.event = None

    class FailingProvider:
        async def generate(self, *, system_prompt, user_message):
            from backend.app.providers.provider_result import (
                ProviderResult,
            )

            return ProviderResult(
                success=False,
                provider_id="p1_6_1_failure",
                model="deterministic",
                content=None,
                error="deterministic provider failure",
                latency_ms=9,
            )

    class FakeUserRepository:
        pass

    class FakeTokenRepository:
        pass

    class FakeBindingRepository:
        pass

    class FakeConversationEventRepository:
        pass

    class FakePrivacyIdentifierService:
        pass

    class FakeConversationEventValidator:
        pass

    repo = FakeRepository()

    runtime = ConversationRuntime(
        llm_provider=FailingProvider(),
    )

    composition = create_beta_telegram_composition(
        user_repository=FakeUserRepository(),
        token_repository=FakeTokenRepository(),
        binding_repository=FakeBindingRepository(),
        conversation_event_repository=FakeConversationEventRepository(),
        privacy_identifier_service=FakePrivacyIdentifierService(),
        conversation_event_validator=FakeConversationEventValidator(),
        conversation_runtime_factory=lambda: runtime,
        provider_usage_repository=repo,
    )

    resolved = composition.conversation_runtime

    assert isinstance(resolved, ConversationRuntime)
    assert isinstance(resolved.usage_capture, ProviderUsageCapture)

    try:
        asyncio.run(
            resolved.respond(
                character_instruction="You are a test tutor.",
                learner_message="Bonjour",
            )
        )
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        assert "deterministic provider failure" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Expected ConversationRuntime to raise RuntimeError")

    assert repo.event is not None
    assert repo.event.provider == "p1_6_1_failure"
    assert repo.event.success is False

    ProviderUsageDashboardService,

def test_p1_6_4d_default_composition_is_constructible_without_database_configuration(
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    """Operations Center composition must not create its own database infrastructure."""

    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)

    composition = create_operations_center_composition()

    assert composition is not None


def test_p1_6_4d_injected_provider_usage_dashboard_service_is_preserved() -> None:
    """The injected provider-usage dashboard service must remain part of the composition."""

    provider_usage_dashboard_service = Mock(
        spec=ProviderUsageDashboardService,
    )

    composition = create_operations_center_composition(
        provider_usage_dashboard_service=provider_usage_dashboard_service,
    )

    assert (
        composition.provider_usage_dashboard_service
        is provider_usage_dashboard_service
    )


def test_p1_6_4d_composition_has_no_database_infrastructure_attributes() -> None:
    """Database infrastructure must remain owned by application bootstrap."""

    composition = create_operations_center_composition()

    assert not hasattr(composition, "provider_usage_engine")
    assert not hasattr(composition, "provider_usage_session_factory")
    assert not hasattr(composition, "provider_usage_repository")

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock

from backend.app.application.operations_center.dashboard_composition import (
    OperationsCenterComposition,
)
from backend.app.application.provider_management.provider_usage_dashboard_service import (
    ProviderUsageDashboardService,
)


def test_operations_center_composition_accepts_usage_service_without_database_creation(
    monkeypatch,
):
    import backend.app.application.operations_center.dashboard_composition as module

    def fail_database_creation():
        raise AssertionError(
            "Operations Center composition must not create a database engine."
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "create_database_engine", fail_database_creation, raising=False)

    service = Mock(spec=ProviderUsageDashboardService)

    composition = OperationsCenterComposition(
        provider_usage_dashboard_service=service,
    )

    assert composition.provider_usage_dashboard_service is service


def test_operations_center_router_can_be_composed_with_injected_usage_service():
    import backend.app.api.operations_center as module

    service = Mock(spec=ProviderUsageDashboardService)
    composition = OperationsCenterComposition(
        provider_usage_dashboard_service=service,
    )

    router = module.create_operations_center_router(composition=composition)

    paths = {route.path for route in router.routes}

    assert "/api/operations-center/provider-usage" in paths
    assert "/api/operations-center/dashboard" in paths
    assert "/api/operations-center/functionality-health" in paths


def test_importing_operations_center_module_does_not_require_database_url(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)

    sys.modules.pop("backend.app.api.operations_center", None)

    module = importlib.import_module("backend.app.api.operations_center")

    assert module.router is not None

from backend.app.application.operations_center.dashboard_composition import (
    create_operations_center_composition,
)
from backend.app.application.provider_management.provider_usage_dashboard_service import (
    ProviderUsageDashboardService,
)
from backend.app.api.operations_center import (
    create_operations_center_router,
)


def test_production_operations_center_composition_receives_usage_service():
    service = Mock(spec=ProviderUsageDashboardService)

    composition = create_operations_center_composition(
        provider_usage_dashboard_service=service,
    )

    assert composition.provider_usage_dashboard_service is service


def test_production_operations_center_router_exposes_provider_usage():
    service = Mock(spec=ProviderUsageDashboardService)

    composition = create_operations_center_composition(
        provider_usage_dashboard_service=service,
    )

    router = create_operations_center_router(
        composition=composition,
    )

    paths = {route.path for route in router.routes}

    assert "/api/operations-center/provider-usage" in paths
    assert "/api/operations-center/dashboard" in paths
    assert "/api/operations-center/functionality-health" in paths
    assert "/api/operations-center/operational-events" in paths

"""P1.6.2A regression tests for canonical usage-event completeness."""

import pytest

from backend.app.application.providers.provider_usage_capture import (
    ProviderUsageCapture,
    ProviderUsageContext,
)
from backend.app.providers.provider_result import ProviderResult, ProviderUsage
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.service import ProviderUsageService


class FakeRepository:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def save(self, event):
        self.events.append(event)

    def get_all(self):
        return list(self.events)

    def clear(self):
        self.events.clear()


def _capture(result, repository):
    capture = ProviderUsageCapture(ProviderUsageService(repository))

    return capture.capture(
        result=result,
        context=ProviderUsageContext(
            capability="conversation",
            functionality="chat",
            agent="conversation_agent",
        ),
    )


def test_capture_preserves_provider_request_id_and_provider_total_tokens():
    repository = FakeRepository()

    result = ProviderResult(
        success=True,
        provider_id="p1_6_2a_fake",
        model="deterministic",
        content="ok",
        usage=ProviderUsage(
            input_tokens=2,
            output_tokens=3,
            total_tokens=5,
        ),
        provider_request_id="req-p1-6-2a",
        latency_ms=7,
    )

    event = _capture(result, repository)

    assert event.provider_request_id == "req-p1-6-2a"
    assert event.input_tokens == 2
    assert event.output_tokens == 3
    assert event.total_tokens == 5
    assert repository.events == [event]


def test_capture_preserves_unknown_provider_usage_as_unknown():
    repository = FakeRepository()

    result = ProviderResult(
        success=True,
        provider_id="p1_6_2a_unknown",
        model="deterministic",
        content="ok",
        usage=ProviderUsage(
            input_tokens=None,
            output_tokens=None,
            total_tokens=None,
        ),
        provider_request_id=None,
        latency_ms=None,
    )

    event = _capture(result, repository)

    assert event.input_tokens is None
    assert event.output_tokens is None
    assert event.total_tokens is None
    assert event.provider_request_id is None
    assert event.latency_ms is None


def test_capture_accepts_real_zero_usage():
    repository = FakeRepository()

    result = ProviderResult(
        success=True,
        provider_id="p1_6_2a_zero",
        model="deterministic",
        content="ok",
        usage=ProviderUsage(
            input_tokens=0,
            output_tokens=0,
            total_tokens=0,
        ),
        provider_request_id="req-p1-6-2a-zero",
        latency_ms=1,
    )

    event = _capture(result, repository)

    assert event.input_tokens == 0
    assert event.output_tokens == 0
    assert event.total_tokens == 0
    assert event.provider_request_id == "req-p1-6-2a-zero"


def test_provider_usage_rejects_negative_total_tokens():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="total_tokens"):
        ProviderUsage(
            input_tokens=1,
            output_tokens=1,
            total_tokens=-1,
        )

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from backend.app.application.providers.provider_usage_capture import (
    ProviderUsageCapture,
    ProviderUsageContext,
)
from backend.app.providers.provider_result import ProviderResult, ProviderUsage
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.repository import (
    InMemoryProviderUsageRepository,
)
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.service import ProviderUsageService


def create_capture() -> tuple[ProviderUsageCapture, InMemoryProviderUsageRepository]:
    repository = InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
    service = ProviderUsageService(repository=repository)
    return ProviderUsageCapture(service), repository


def test_capture_translates_and_records_provider_result() -> None:
    capture, repository = create_capture()

    result = ProviderResult(
        success=True,
        provider_id="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        content="Bonjour !",
        usage=ProviderUsage(
            input_tokens=100,
            output_tokens=50,
            total_tokens=150,
        ),
        provider_request_id="req_123",
        latency_ms=812.4,
    )

    event = capture.capture(
        result=result,
        context=ProviderUsageContext(
            capability="conversation",
            functionality="telegram",
            agent="conversation_agent",
            quality_score=95.0,
            estimated_cost=Decimal("0.010"),
        ),
    )

    assert event.provider == "openai"
    assert event.model == "gpt-5-mini"
    assert event.input_tokens == 100
    assert event.output_tokens == 50
    assert event.latency_ms == 812
    assert event.estimated_cost == Decimal("0.010")
    assert event.success is True

    stored = repository.get_all()
    assert len(stored) == 1
    assert stored[0] == event


def test_capture_preserves_failed_provider_result() -> None:
    capture, repository = create_capture()

    result = ProviderResult(
        success=False,
        provider_id="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        error="provider unavailable",
        latency_ms=125.2,
    )

    event = capture.capture(
        result=result,
        context=ProviderUsageContext(
            capability="conversation",
            functionality="telegram",
            agent="conversation_agent",
        ),
    )

    assert event.success is False
    assert event.input_tokens == 0
    assert event.output_tokens == 0
    assert event.estimated_cost == Decimal("0")
    assert repository.get_all() == [event]


def test_capture_rejects_missing_inputs() -> None:
    capture, _ = create_capture()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ProviderResult cannot be None"):
        capture.capture(
            result=None,
            context=ProviderUsageContext(
                capability="conversation",
                functionality="telegram",
                agent="conversation_agent",
            ),
        )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ProviderUsageContext cannot be None"):
        capture.capture(
            result=ProviderResult(
                success=True,
                provider_id="openai",
                model="gpt-5-mini",
                content="ok",
            ),
            context=None,
        )

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

import pytest

from backend.app.application.health.health_result import (
    HealthCheckResult,
    HealthStatus,
    ProductionReadinessResult,
)
from backend.app.application.provider_management.environment import OperationsEnvironment
from backend.app.application.provider_management.functionality_health_service import FunctionalityHealthService


def service(*checks: HealthCheckResult) -> AsyncMock:
    result = AsyncMock()
    result.check.return_value = ProductionReadinessResult(
        status=HealthStatus.HEALTHY,
        checks=checks,
    )
    return result


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_legacy_call_defaults_to_adults() -> None:
    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=service(),
    ).get_health()
    assert payload["environment"] == "adults"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.parametrize("environment", [OperationsEnvironment.KIDS, OperationsEnvironment.ADULTS])
async def test_environment_is_propagated(environment: OperationsEnvironment) -> None:
    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=service(),
    ).get_health(environment=environment)
    assert payload["environment"] == environment.value
    assert all(item["environment"] == environment.value for item in payload["functionalities"])


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_existing_frontend_contract_fields_are_present() -> None:
    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=service(
            HealthCheckResult(
                name="llm_provider",
                status=HealthStatus.HEALTHY,
                details={"provider": "openai", "model": "gpt-5-mini"},
            )
        ),
    ).get_health(environment=OperationsEnvironment.KIDS)

    item = next(
        x for x in payload["functionalities"]
        if x["functionality_id"] == "conversation"
    )

    assert item["category"] == "AI"
    assert item["description"]
    assert item["capability"] == "conversation"
    assert item["checked_at"] == payload["generated_at"]
    assert item["controllable"] is False
    assert item["reason"]
    assert item["environment"] == "kids"
    assert item["availability"] == "enabled"
    assert item["policy_status"] == "not_evaluated"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_unhealthy_provider_is_an_incident() -> None:
    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=service(
            HealthCheckResult(
                name="llm_provider",
                status=HealthStatus.UNHEALTHY,
                details={"provider": "openai"},
            )
        ),
    ).get_health()

    item = next(x for x in payload["functionalities"] if x["functionality_id"] == "conversation")
    assert item["status"] == "unavailable"
    assert payload["platform_health"] == "incident"
    assert payload["platform_health_score"] == 0.0

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

import pytest

from backend.app.application.health.health_result import (
    HealthCheckResult,
    HealthStatus,
    ProductionReadinessResult,
)
from backend.app.application.provider_management.functionality_health_service import (
    FunctionalityHealthService,
)


def _readiness_service(
    checks: tuple[HealthCheckResult, ...],
) -> AsyncMock:
    service = AsyncMock()

    service.check.return_value = ProductionReadinessResult(
        status=HealthStatus.HEALTHY,
        checks=checks,
    )

    return service


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_llm_provider_health_reaches_conversation_functionality() -> None:
    """An existing LLM health result reaches the functionality projection."""

    readiness_service = _readiness_service(
        (
            HealthCheckResult(
                name="llm_provider",
                status=HealthStatus.HEALTHY,
                details={
                    "provider": "openai",
                    "model": "gpt-5-mini",
                    "reachable": True,
                },
            ),
        )
    )

    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=readiness_service,
    ).get_health()

    conversation = next(
        item
        for item in payload["functionalities"]
        if item["functionality_id"] == "conversation"
    )

    assert conversation["status"] == "healthy"
    assert conversation["provider"] == "openai"
    assert conversation["model"] == "gpt-5-mini"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_unobserved_functionality_is_unknown() -> None:
    """Missing health telemetry must never be presented as healthy."""

    readiness_service = _readiness_service(())

    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=readiness_service,
    ).get_health()

    voice = next(
        item
        for item in payload["functionalities"]
        if item["functionality_id"] == "voice_tts"
    )

    assert voice["status"] == "unknown"
    assert voice["health_score"] is None


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_health_payload_contains_required_dashboard_fields() -> None:
    """Protect the read-only dashboard contract consumed by the frontend."""

    readiness_service = _readiness_service(())

    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=readiness_service,
    ).get_health()

    assert "generated_at" in payload
    assert "platform_health" in payload
    assert "user_impact" in payload
    assert "counts" in payload
    assert "functionalities" in payload
    assert "attention" in payload

    assert isinstance(payload["functionalities"], list)
    assert isinstance(payload["attention"], list)
    assert isinstance(payload["counts"], dict)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_unhealthy_provider_is_reported_as_incident() -> None:
    """An unhealthy provider creates an operational attention signal."""

    readiness_service = _readiness_service(
        (
            HealthCheckResult(
                name="llm_provider",
                status=HealthStatus.UNHEALTHY,
                details={
                    "provider": "openai",
                    "reason": "provider_unavailable",
                },
            ),
        )
    )

    payload = await FunctionalityHealthService(
        readiness_service=readiness_service,
    ).get_health()

    conversation = next(
        item
        for item in payload["functionalities"]
        if item["functionality_id"] == "conversation"
    )

    assert conversation["status"] == "unavailable"
    assert conversation["health_score"] == 0.0
    assert conversation["risk_level"] == "high"
    assert conversation in payload["attention"]

    assert payload["platform_health"] == "incident"
    assert payload["user_impact"] == "high"

import pytest

from backend.app.application.provider_management.functionality_operational_control_service import (
    FunctionalityOperationalControlService,
)


class Authorizer:
    def __init__(self, allowed=True):
        self.allowed = allowed

    def can_control_functionality(self, *, actor, environment, functionality_id):
        return self.allowed


class Auditor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def record_functionality_control(self, **event):
        self.events.append(event)


def make_service(allowed=True):
    auditor = Auditor()
    return FunctionalityOperationalControlService(
        authorizer=Authorizer(allowed), auditor=auditor
    ), auditor


def test_stop_requires_reason():
    service, _ = make_service()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="reason is required"):
        service.stop(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                     environment="adults", functionality_id="conversation",
                     reason="   ")


def test_stop_disables_and_audits():
    service, auditor = make_service()
    result = service.stop(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                          environment="kids", functionality_id="conversation",
                          reason="Provider incident")
    assert result.availability == "disabled"
    assert service.get_availability(
        environment="kids", functionality_id="conversation"
    ) == "disabled"
    assert len(auditor.events) == 1
    assert auditor.events[0]["action"] == "stop"
    assert auditor.events[0]["reason"] == "Provider incident"


def test_resume_enables_and_audits():
    service, auditor = make_service()
    service.stop(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                 environment="adults", functionality_id="conversation",
                 reason="Temporary issue")
    result = service.resume(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                            environment="adults", functionality_id="conversation")
    assert result.availability == "enabled"
    assert service.get_availability(
        environment="adults", functionality_id="conversation"
    ) == "enabled"
    assert [e["action"] for e in auditor.events] == ["stop", "resume"]


def test_authorisation_is_enforced():
    service, _ = make_service(False)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        service.stop(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                     environment="adults", functionality_id="conversation",
                     reason="Temporary issue")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("environment", ["invalid", "", "KIDS"])
def test_environment_is_strict(environment):
    service, _ = make_service()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        service.resume(actor="operator", actor_name="operator",
                       environment=environment, functionality_id="conversation")

from decimal import Decimal

from backend.app.application.provider_management.provider_usage_dashboard_service import (
    ProviderUsageDashboardService,
)
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.models import ProviderUsageEvent
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.repository import (
    InMemoryProviderUsageRepository,
)


def _event(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    model: str = "gpt-test",
    input_tokens: int | None = 100,
    output_tokens: int | None = 50,
    total_tokens: int | None = 150,
    cost: str = "0.01000000",
    success: bool = True,
) -> ProviderUsageEvent:
    return ProviderUsageEvent(
        provider=provider,
        model=model,
        capability="conversation",
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=input_tokens,
        output_tokens=output_tokens,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
        latency_ms=100,
        estimated_cost=Decimal(cost),
        quality_score=95.0,
        success=success,
        provider_request_id="req-test",
    )


def test_snapshot_aggregates_repository_events() -> None:
    repository = InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
    repository.save(_event())
    repository.save(
        _event(
            provider="ollama",
            model="gemma-test",
            cost="0",
        )
    )

    service = ProviderUsageDashboardService(
        repository=repository,
    )

    snapshot = service.get_snapshot()

    assert snapshot["total_requests"] == 2
    assert snapshot["successful_requests"] == 2
    assert snapshot["failed_requests"] == 0
    assert snapshot["total_input_tokens"] == 200
    assert snapshot["total_output_tokens"] == 100
    assert snapshot["total_tokens"] == 300
    assert snapshot["total_estimated_cost"] == "0.01000000"
    assert snapshot["by_provider"] == {
        "openai": 1,
        "ollama": 1,
    }


def test_snapshot_preserves_unknown_token_semantics() -> None:
    repository = InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
    repository.save(
        _event(
            input_tokens=None,
            output_tokens=None,
            total_tokens=None,
        )
    )

    service = ProviderUsageDashboardService(
        repository=repository,
    )

    snapshot = service.get_snapshot()

    assert snapshot["total_input_tokens"] is None
    assert snapshot["total_output_tokens"] is None
    assert snapshot["total_tokens"] is None


def test_snapshot_rejects_missing_repository() -> None:
    try:
        ProviderUsageDashboardService(repository=None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == "repository cannot be None."
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Expected ValueError")

"""
Tests for Character Resolver.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from app.application.uai.character.character_resolver import (
    CharacterResolver,
)

from app.infrastructure.characters.yaml_character_repository import (
    YamlCharacterRepository,
)


CHARACTER_PROFILES_PATH = (
    Path(
        r"C:\AI Folder\FrenchTeacherAI"
    )
    / "docs"
    / "specifications"
    / "characters"
    / "profiles"
)


def test_resolve_yeti_character():

    repository = YamlCharacterRepository(
        profiles_path=CHARACTER_PROFILES_PATH
    )

    resolver = CharacterResolver(
        character_repository=repository
    )

    context = resolver.resolve(
        "yeti"
    )

    assert context.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )

    assert context.name == (
        "Yeti"
    )

    assert context.personality_reference == (
        "Storyteller"
    )

    assert context.teaching_style == (
        "Story-driven"
    )


def test_unknown_character_returns_error():

    repository = YamlCharacterRepository(
        profiles_path=CHARACTER_PROFILES_PATH
    )

    resolver = CharacterResolver(
        character_repository=repository
    )

    try:

        resolver.resolve(
            "unknown_character"
        )

        assert False, (
            "Expected ValueError"
        )

    except ValueError as error:

        assert str(error) == (
            "Character not found: unknown_character"
        )

"""
Tests for Interaction Context Builder.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from app.application.uai.character.character_resolver import (
    CharacterResolver,
)

from app.application.uai.context.interaction_context_builder import (
    InteractionContextBuilder,
)

from app.application.uai.world.world_resolver import (
    WorldResolver,
)

from app.domain.uai.context.learner_context import (
    LearnerContext,
)

from app.domain.uai.context.voice_context import (
    VoiceContext,
)

from app.infrastructure.characters.yaml_character_repository import (
    YamlCharacterRepository,
)

from app.infrastructure.worlds.yaml_world_repository import (
    YamlWorldRepository,
)


WORLD_CONFIG_PATH = (
    Path(__file__)
    .resolve()
    .parents[4]
    / "app"
    / "configuration"
    / "worlds"
)


CHARACTER_PROFILE_PATH = (
    Path(
        r"C:\AI Folder\FrenchTeacherAI"
    )
    / "docs"
    / "specifications"
    / "characters"
    / "profiles"
)


def test_build_interaction_context():

    print(
        "WORLD CONFIG PATH:",
        WORLD_CONFIG_PATH,
    )

    print(
        "WORLD CONFIG EXISTS:",
        WORLD_CONFIG_PATH.exists(),
    )

    print(
        "WORLD CONFIG FILES:",
        list(
            WORLD_CONFIG_PATH.glob("*")
        ),
    )


    world_repository = YamlWorldRepository(
        worlds_path=WORLD_CONFIG_PATH
    )

    character_repository = YamlCharacterRepository(
        profiles_path=CHARACTER_PROFILE_PATH
    )


    world_resolver = WorldResolver(
        world_repository=world_repository
    )

    character_resolver = CharacterResolver(
        character_repository=character_repository
    )


    builder = InteractionContextBuilder(
        world_resolver=world_resolver,
        character_resolver=character_resolver,
    )


    learner = LearnerContext(
        learner_id="learner-001",
        learning_goals=[
            "conversation",
            "pronunciation",
        ],
    )


    voice = VoiceContext(
        language_code="fr",
        voice_provider="openai",
        voice_profile="verse",
    )


    context = builder.build(
        learner=learner,
        world_id="french_world",
        character_id="yeti",
        voice=voice,
    )


    assert context.world.world_id == (
        "french_world"
    )

    assert context.world.language_code == (
        "fr"
    )


    assert context.character.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )

    assert context.character.name == (
        "Yeti"
    )


    assert context.learner.learner_id == (

"""
Tests for Voice Call Notification Repository.

Validates the repository contract.

Responsibilities tested:
- Save notification.
- Retrieve notification.
- Delete notification.

The concrete infrastructure
implementation is tested separately.
"""

from datetime import (
    datetime,
    timedelta,
    timezone,
)


import pytest


from app.application.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification_repository import (
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification import (
    VoiceCallNotification,
    VoiceCallNotificationChannel,
    VoiceCallNotificationStatus,
)



class FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository(
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository port.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
    ):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        notification: VoiceCallNotification,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification:

        self.storage[
            notification.id
        ] = notification


        return notification



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            notification_id
        )



    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.storage.pop(
            notification_id,
            None,
        )



def create_repository():

    return (
        FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository()
    )



def create_notification():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallNotification(
        id="notification-001",
        invitation_id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel=(
            VoiceCallNotificationChannel.INBOX
        ),
        status=(
            VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
        ),
        created_at=now,
    )



def test_save_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    result = repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    assert result.id == (
        "notification-001"
    )



def test_get_notification_by_id():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    stored = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    )


    assert stored is not None


    assert stored.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )



def test_unknown_notification_returns_none():

    repository = create_repository()


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="unknown",
    )


    assert result is None



def test_delete_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    repository.delete(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    )


    assert repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    ) is None



def test_repository_is_abstract():

    with pytest.raises(
        TypeError
    ):

        VoiceCallNotificationRepository()

def create_execution_context(
    *,
    state: VoiceCallState = VoiceCallState.READY,
) -> VoiceCallExecutionContext:
    """
    Create execution context.
    """


    session = VoiceCallSession(
        session_id="call-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        world_id="french_world",
        language_code="fr",
        state=state,
    )


    room = VoiceCallRoom(
        room_id="room-001",
        participants=(
            VoiceCallParticipant(
                participant_id="learner-001",
                role=VoiceParticipantRole.LEARNER,
                display_name="Learner",
            ),
            VoiceCallParticipant(
                participant_id="yeti",
                role=VoiceParticipantRole.CHARACTER,
                display_name="Yeti",
            ),
        ),
    )


    return VoiceCallExecutionContext(
        session=session,
        room=room,
    )



def create_coordinator() -> VoiceCallExecutionCoordinator:
    """
    Create coordinator with real
    application dependencies.
    """


    return VoiceCallExecutionCoordinator(
        room_service=VoiceRoomService(
            room_adapter=VoiceRoomAdapter(),
        ),
        execution_runtime=VoiceCallExecutionRuntime(),
    )



def test_start_prepares_room_and_executes_call():

    coordinator = create_coordinator()


    result = coordinator.start(
        context=create_execution_context(),
    )


    assert "room" in result


    assert "session" in result


    assert result["room"]["room_name"] == (
        "room-001"
    )


    assert result["room"]["provider"] == (
        "livekit"
    )


    assert result["session"].state == (
        VoiceCallState.ACTIVE
    )



def test_execution_contains_participants():

    coordinator = create_coordinator()


    result = coordinator.start(
        context=create_execution_context(),
    )


    participants = (
        result["room"]["participants"]
    )


    assert participants == [
        "learner-001",
        "yeti",
    ]



def test_execution_requires_ready_session():

    coordinator = create_coordinator()


    try:

        coordinator.start(
            context=create_execution_context(
                state=VoiceCallState.CREATED,
            )
        )


        assert False

    except ValueError:

        assert True

"""
Tests for Voice Call Invitation Repository.

Validates the repository contract
for voice call invitations.

Responsibilities tested:
- Save invitation.
- Retrieve invitation.
- Delete invitation.

The concrete persistence implementation
is tested separately.
"""

from datetime import (
    datetime,
    timedelta,
    timezone,
)


import pytest


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_invitation_repository import (
    VoiceCallInvitationRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_invitation import (
    VoiceCallInvitation,
    VoiceCallInvitationStatus,
)



class FakeVoiceCallInvitationRepository(
    VoiceCallInvitationRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository port.
    """

    def __init__(self):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        invitation: VoiceCallInvitation,
    ) -> VoiceCallInvitation:

        self.storage[
            invitation.id
        ] = invitation

        return invitation



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        invitation_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCallInvitation | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            invitation_id
        )



    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        invitation_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.storage.pop(
            invitation_id,
            None,
        )



def create_invitation():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallInvitation(
        id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
        status=(
            VoiceCallInvitationStatus.CREATED
        ),
        created_at=now,
        expires_at=(
            now
            +
            timedelta(
                minutes=30
            )
        ),

def test_create_invitation():

    )



def test_mark_invitation_sent():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="email",
    )


    sent = service.mark_sent(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert sent.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.SENT
    )



def test_accept_invitation():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
    )


    accepted = service.accept_invitation(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert accepted.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.ACCEPTED
    )



def test_expired_invitation_cannot_be_accepted():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
        expires_minutes=1,
    )


    expired_check_time = (
        invitation.expires_at
        +
        timedelta(
            minutes=1,
        )
    )


    assert invitation.is_expired(
        now=expired_check_time,
    )


    try:

        service.accept_invitation(
            invitation=invitation,
            now=expired_check_time,
        )


        assert False, (
            "Expired invitation was accepted"
        )


    except ValueError as exc:

        assert str(exc) == (
            "Invitation expired."
        )



def test_cancel_invitation():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="email",
    )


    cancelled = service.cancel_invitation(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert cancelled.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.CANCELLED
    )

"""
Tests for Voice Call Lifecycle Events.

Validates business lifecycle audit trail.

Flow:

VoiceCall
    |
    â†“
Created
    |
    â†“
Accepted
    |
    â†“
Reconnected
    |
    â†“
Events


Events are business events,
not transport events.
"""


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_event_service import (
    VoiceCallEventService,
)


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_management_service import (
    VoiceCallManagementService,
)


from app.infrastructure.persistence.voice_call_repository import (
    InMemoryVoiceCallRepository,
)


from app.infrastructure.persistence.in_memory_voice_call_event_repository import (
    InMemoryVoiceCallEventRepository,
)



from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_event import (
    VoiceCallEventType,
)



def create_services():

    management_service = (
        VoiceCallManagementService(
            repository=(
                InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
            ),
        )
    )


    event_service = (
        VoiceCallEventService(
            repository=(
                InMemoryVoiceCallEventRepository()
            ),
        )
    )


    return (
        management_service,
        event_service,
    )



def create_voice_call(
    management_service,
):

    return (
        management_service.create_call(
            learner_id="learner-001",
            character_id="yeti",
            world_id="french_world",
            language_code="fr",
        )
    )



def test_voice_call_created_event():

    management_service, event_service = (
        create_services()
    )


    voice_call = (
        create_voice_call(
            management_service
        )
    )


    event_service.record_event(
        voice_call_id=voice_call.id,
        learner_id=voice_call.learner_id,
        character_id=voice_call.character_id,
        event_type=(
            VoiceCallEventType.CREATED
        ),
    )


    events = (
        event_service.get_events(
            voice_call_id=voice_call.id,
        )
    )


    assert len(events) == 1


    assert events[0].event_type == (
        VoiceCallEventType.CREATED
    )



def test_voice_call_lifecycle_events_are_ordered():

    management_service, event_service = (
        create_services()
    )


    voice_call = (
        create_voice_call(
            management_service
        )
    )


    lifecycle = [
        VoiceCallEventType.CREATED,
        VoiceCallEventType.ACCEPTED,
        VoiceCallEventType.RECONNECTED,
    ]


    for event_type in lifecycle:

        event_service.record_event(
            voice_call_id=voice_call.id,
            learner_id=voice_call.learner_id,
            character_id=voice_call.character_id,
            event_type=event_type,
        )



    events = (
        event_service.get_events(
            voice_call_id=voice_call.id,
        )
    )


    assert len(events) == 3


    assert [
        event.event_type
        for event in events
    ] == lifecycle



def test_voice_events_are_isolated_per_call():

    management_service, event_service = (
        create_services()
    )


    first_call = (
        create_voice_call(
            management_service
        )
    )


    second_call = (
        management_service.create_call(
            learner_id="learner-002",
            character_id="alix",
            world_id="french_world",
            language_code="fr",
        )
    )


    event_service.record_event(
        voice_call_id=first_call.id,
        learner_id=first_call.learner_id,
        character_id=first_call.character_id,
        event_type=(
            VoiceCallEventType.CREATED
        ),
    )


    first_events = (
        event_service.get_events(
            voice_call_id=first_call.id,
        )
    )


    second_events = (
        event_service.get_events(
            voice_call_id=second_call.id,
        )
    )


    assert len(first_events) == 1

    assert second_events == []

"""
Tests for Voice Call Reconnect Flow.

Validates the complete application flow:

VoiceCall
    |
    â†“
Disconnect
    |
    â†“
Reconnect validation
    |
    â†“
New VoiceCallSession

The same VoiceCall identity must
remain unchanged.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_management_service import (
    VoiceCallManagementService,
)


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_session_service import (
    VoiceCallSessionService,
)

    InMemoryVoiceCallRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_state import (
    VoiceCallState,
)



def create_services():
    """
    Create reconnect flow services.
    """


    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
    )


    management_service = (
        VoiceCallManagementService(
            repository=repository,
        )
    )


    session_service = (
        VoiceCallSessionService()
    )


    return (
        management_service,
        session_service,
    )



def test_voice_call_disconnect_and_reconnect_preserves_identity():

    (
        management_service,
        session_service,
    ) = create_services()


    voice_call = (
        management_service
        .create_call(
            learner_id="learner-001",
            character_id="yeti",
            world_id="french_world",
            language_code="fr",
        )
    )


    original_id = (
        voice_call.id
    )


    disconnected = (
        voice_call
        .mark_disconnected()
    )


    management_service.repository.save(
        voice_call=disconnected,
    )


    stored_call = (
        management_service
        .get_call(
            voice_call_id=original_id,
        )
    )


    assert stored_call is not None


    assert stored_call.id == (
        original_id
    )


    session = (
        session_service
        .reconnect_session(
            voice_call=stored_call,
        )
    )


    assert session.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )


    assert session.learner_id == (
        "learner-001"
    )


    assert session.state == (
        VoiceCallState.READY
    )



def test_reconnect_uses_same_voice_call_identity():

    (
        management_service,
        session_service,
    ) = create_services()


    voice_call = (
        management_service
        .create_call(
            learner_id="learner-002",
            character_id="alix",
            world_id="french_world",
            language_code="fr",
        )
    )


    disconnected = (
        voice_call
        .mark_disconnected()
    )


    management_service.repository.save(
        voice_call=disconnected,
    )


    retrieved = (
        management_service
        .get_call(
            voice_call_id=voice_call.id,
        )
    )


    assert retrieved is not None


    reconnect_session = (
        session_service
        .reconnect_session(
            voice_call=retrieved,
        )
    )


    assert voice_call.id == (
        retrieved.id
    )


    assert reconnect_session.session_id == (
        f"{voice_call.id}-reconnect"
    )



def test_reconnect_window_validation():

    (
        management_service,
        _,
    ) = create_services()


    voice_call = (
        management_service
        .create_call(
            learner_id="learner-003",

"""
Tests for Voice Call Repository contract.

Validates that the repository boundary
defines the expected persistence contract
for VoiceCall aggregates.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta


from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_repository import (
    VoiceCallRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call import (
    VoiceCall,
)


from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_state import (
    VoiceCallState,
)



class InMemoryVoiceCallRepository(
    VoiceCallRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository contract.
    """

    def __init__(self):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        voice_call: VoiceCall,
    ) -> VoiceCall:

        self.storage[
            voice_call.id
        ] = voice_call

        return voice_call



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        voice_call_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCall | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            voice_call_id
        )



def create_voice_call() -> VoiceCall:
    """
    Create valid voice call.
    """

    created_at = datetime.utcnow()


    return VoiceCall(
        id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        world_id="french_world",
        language_code="fr",
        state=VoiceCallState.ACTIVE,
        created_at=created_at,
        expires_at=(
            created_at
            + timedelta(
                minutes=30
            )
        ),
    )



def test_repository_contract_can_save_voice_call():

    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
    )


    voice_call = create_voice_call()


    saved = repository.save(
        voice_call=voice_call,
    )


    assert saved.id == (
        "vc-001"
    )


    assert saved.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )



def test_repository_contract_can_retrieve_voice_call():

    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
    )


    voice_call = create_voice_call()


    repository.save(
        voice_call=voice_call,
    )


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
    )


    assert result is not None


    assert result.id == (
        "vc-001"
    )


    assert result.learner_id == (
        "learner-001"
    )



def test_repository_returns_none_for_unknown_call():

    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
    )


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        voice_call_id="unknown",
    )


    assert result is None



def test_repository_implements_contract():

    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallRepository()
    )


    assert isinstance(
        repository,
        VoiceCallRepository,
    )

"""

from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_room_service import (

)

)



def create_voice_call_session() -> VoiceCallSession:
    """
    Create test voice call session.
    """

    return VoiceCallSession(
        session_id="call-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        world_id="french_world",
        language_code="fr",
    )



def test_create_voice_call_room():

    service = VoiceCallRoomService()


    room = service.create_room(
        session=create_voice_call_session(),
    )


    assert room.room_id == (
        "call-001"
    )


    assert room.has_character() is True


    assert room.learner_count() == (
        1
    )



def test_room_contains_learner_and_character():

    service = VoiceCallRoomService()


    room = service.create_room(
        session=create_voice_call_session(),
    )


    roles = [
        participant.role
        for participant in room.participants
    ]


    assert (
        VoiceParticipantRole.LEARNER
        in roles
    )


    assert (
        VoiceParticipantRole.CHARACTER
        in roles
    )



def test_character_identity_is_preserved():

    service = VoiceCallRoomService()


    room = service.create_room(
        session=create_voice_call_session(),
    )


    character = next(
        participant
        for participant in room.participants
        if participant.role
        ==
        VoiceParticipantRole.CHARACTER
    )


    assert character.participant_id == (
        "yeti"
    )
