"""
Tests for Parallel Podcast Provider.

Validates:

PodcastDiscoveryExecutor
        |
        v
PodcastProvider Contract
        |
        v
ParallelPodcastProvider

These tests do not call:

- Parallel API
- external providers
- Gemini
- Google Cloud
"""


from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import Mock

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import (
    LearningContext,
    PodcastSearchIntent,
)

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.parallel import (
    ParallelPodcastProvider,
)


def create_test_intent() -> PodcastSearchIntent:
    """
    Create deterministic provider-neutral search intent.
    """

    return PodcastSearchIntent(
        user_id="test-user",
        learning_context=LearningContext(
            world_id="hackathon",
            target_language="fr",
            learner_level="B2",
        ),
        topics=(
            "French learning",
        ),
    )


def test_parallel_provider_without_client_returns_empty_results():
    """
    Sprint 0 behaviour.

    Without an injected client:

    - no external calls;
    - deterministic response.
    """

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider()

    results = provider.search(
        create_test_intent(),
    )

    assert results == []


def test_parallel_provider_exposes_provider_id():
    """
    Provider exposes stable identifier.
    """

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider()

    assert provider.provider_id == "parallel"


def test_parallel_provider_uses_injected_client():
    """
    Provider must use dependency injection.

    It must not construct external clients itself.
    """

    client = Mock()

    client.search.return_value = []

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider(
        client=client,
    )

    provider.search(
        create_test_intent(),
    )

    client.search.assert_called_once()


def test_parallel_provider_maps_results():
    """
    External provider responses must be converted
    into provider-neutral PodcastSearchResult objects.
    """

    client = Mock()

    client.search.return_value = [
        {
            "id": "episode-001",
            "title": "French Podcast",
            "description": "Learning French",
            "publisher": "Parallel",
            "languages": [
                "fr",
            ],
            "url": (
                "https://example.com/podcast"
            ),
        }
    ]

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider(
        client=client,
    )

    results = provider.search(
        create_test_intent(),
    )

    assert len(results) == 1

    result = results[0]

    assert result.title == "French Podcast"
    assert result.publisher == "Parallel"
    assert result.url.startswith(
        "https://"
    )

def test_runtime_composition_accepts_parallel_provider():
    """
    Composition root must accept Parallel provider
    through the existing PodcastProvider boundary.

    It must not know Parallel implementation details.

    The Runtime currently creates five supported capability
    executors.
    """

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider()

    executors = create_capability_executors(
        live_intelligence_agent=(
            FakeLiveIntelligenceAgent()
        ),
        podcast_discovery_agent=(
            FakePodcastDiscoveryAgent()
        ),
        podcast_providers=[
            provider,
        ],
    )

    assert len(executors) == 5

    assert any(
        isinstance(
            executor,
            LiveIntelligenceExecutor,
        )
        for executor in executors
    )

    assert any(
        isinstance(
            executor,
            PodcastDiscoveryExecutor,
        )
        for executor in executors
    )

    assert any(
        isinstance(
            executor,
            PodcastLearningChallengeExecutor,
        )
        for executor in executors
    )

    assert any(
        isinstance(
            executor,
            ListeningProposalExecutor,
        )
        for executor in executors
    )

    assert any(
        isinstance(
            executor,
            FlashcardGenerationExecutor,
        )
        for executor in executors
    )


def test_parallel_provider_is_injected_without_runtime_changes():
    """
    Verify provider injection remains explicit.

    Runtime composition receives providers;
    it does not create them.

    The supplied Parallel provider must reach the existing
    PodcastRecommendationService through the
    PodcastDiscoveryExecutor.

    The test intentionally verifies the existing ownership
    boundary rather than requiring PodcastDiscoveryExecutor
    to expose provider state directly.
    """

    provider = ParallelPodcastProvider(
        client=Mock(),
    )

    executors = create_capability_executors(
        live_intelligence_agent=(
            FakeLiveIntelligenceAgent()
        ),
        podcast_discovery_agent=(
            FakePodcastDiscoveryAgent()
        ),
        podcast_providers=[
            provider,
        ],
    )

    podcast_executor = next(
        executor
        for executor in executors
        if isinstance(
            executor,
            PodcastDiscoveryExecutor,
        )
    )

    assert podcast_executor is not None

    recommendation_service = (
        podcast_executor._recommendation_service
    )

    assert recommendation_service is not None

    assert (
        provider
        in recommendation_service._providers
    )

"""
Tests for Runtime capability errors.
"""

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.errors import (
    CapabilityAlreadyRegisteredError,
    CapabilityExecutionError,
    CapabilityGovernanceError,
    CapabilityNotRegisteredError,
    InvalidCapabilityRequestError,
    RuntimeCapabilityError,
)


def test_all_runtime_errors_extend_runtime_capability_error():

    errors = (
        InvalidCapabilityRequestError,
        CapabilityNotRegisteredError,
        CapabilityAlreadyRegisteredError,
        CapabilityExecutionError,
        CapabilityGovernanceError,
    )

    for error_type in errors:
        assert issubclass(
            error_type,
            RuntimeCapabilityError,
        )

"""
Tests for the AI Runtime capability executor contract.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.executor import (
    CapabilityExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilityType,
)


class FakeCapabilityExecutor(CapabilityExecutor):
    """
    Minimal executor used only to verify the contract.
    """

    @property
    def capability(self) -> CapabilityType:
        return CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE

    async def execute(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:

        return CapabilityResult(
            request_id=request.request_id,
            capability=request.capability,
            status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
            output={
                "executed": True,
            },
        )


def test_executor_declares_capability():

    executor = FakeCapabilityExecutor()

    assert (
        executor.capability
        == CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_executor_returns_provider_independent_result():

    executor = FakeCapabilityExecutor()

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        request_id="req-executor-001",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI Act",
        },
    )

    result = await executor.execute(request)

    assert isinstance(
        result,
        CapabilityResult,
    )

    assert (
        result.request_id
        == "req-executor-001"
    )

    assert (
        result.capability
        == CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert result.output == {
        "executed": True,
    }


def test_executor_is_abstract():

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):

        CapabilityExecutor()

"""
Tests for FlashcardGenerationExecutor.

Validates:

- Runtime capability contract;
- executor/service boundary;

- validation behaviour.

This test does not call:

- LLM providers;
- memory persistence;
- external systems.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.flashcard_generation_executor import (
    FlashcardGenerationExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityType,
)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_flashcard_executor_generates_result() -> None:
    """
    Flashcard executor should return a completed result.
    """

    executor = FlashcardGenerationExecutor()

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=(
            CapabilityType.FLASHCARD_GENERATION
        ),
        request_id="flashcard-test-001",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI regulation",
            "learner_context": (
                "B2 French learner interested in technology"
            ),
        },
    )

    result = await executor.execute(
        request,
    )

    assert result.capability == (
        CapabilityType.FLASHCARD_GENERATION
    )

    assert result.status == (
        CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert result.succeeded is True

    assert result.output is not None

    assert result.output.count == 3


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_flashcard_executor_rejects_wrong_capability() -> None:
    """
    Executor must reject unsupported capability calls.
    """

    executor = FlashcardGenerationExecutor()

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=(
            CapabilityType.EVALUATION
        ),
        request_id="flashcard-test-002",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI regulation",
        },
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="unsupported capability",
    ):
        await executor.execute(
            request,
        )

        request_id="flashcard-test-003",
        payload={},
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="topic",
    ):
        await executor.execute(
            request,
        )

"""
Tests for the AI Runtime Capability Gateway.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.errors import (
    CapabilityExecutionError,
    CapabilityGovernanceError,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.executor import (
    CapabilityExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.gateway import (
    CapabilityGateway,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilityType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.registry import (
    CapabilityRegistry,
)


class FakeGovernanceResult:
    """
    Minimal governance result for gateway tests.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        allowed: bool,
    ) -> None:
        self.allowed = allowed


class FakeGovernance:
    """
    Deterministic governance implementation for tests.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        allowed: bool,
    ) -> None:
        self.allowed = allowed
        self.calls = 0

    def evaluate(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> FakeGovernanceResult:

        self.calls += 1

        return FakeGovernanceResult(
            allowed=self.allowed
        )


class FailingGovernance:
    """
    Governance implementation that fails unexpectedly.
    """

    def evaluate(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> FakeGovernanceResult:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "governance infrastructure failure"
        )


class FakeExecutor(CapabilityExecutor):
    """
    Fake executor used to verify gateway orchestration.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = 0
        self.last_request: CapabilityRequest | None = None

    @property
    def capability(self) -> CapabilityType:
        return CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE

    async def execute(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:

        self.calls += 1
        self.last_request = request

        return CapabilityResult(
            request_id=request.request_id,
            capability=request.capability,
            status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
            output={
                "executed": True,
            },
        )


class FailingExecutor(CapabilityExecutor):
    """
    Executor that fails unexpectedly.
    """

    @property
    def capability(self) -> CapabilityType:
        return CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE

    async def execute(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> CapabilityResult:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "provider failure"
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gateway_executes_allowed_capability():

    executor = FakeExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[executor]
    )

    governance = FakeGovernance(
        allowed=True
    )

    gateway = CapabilityGateway(
        registry=registry,
        governance=governance,
    )

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        request_id="gateway-001",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI Act",
        },
    )

    result = await gateway.execute(
        request
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert result.succeeded is True

    assert governance.calls == 1

    assert executor.calls == 1

    assert executor.last_request is request


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gateway_rejects_blocked_capability():

    executor = FakeExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[executor]
    )

    governance = FakeGovernance(
        allowed=False
    )

    gateway = CapabilityGateway(
        registry=registry,
        governance=governance,
    )

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        request_id="gateway-002",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI Act",
        },
    )

    result = await gateway.execute(
        request
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CapabilityExecutionStatus.REJECTED
    )

    assert result.rejected is True

    assert executor.calls == 0

    assert governance.calls == 1

    assert (
        result.metadata["governance_decision"]
        == "rejected"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gateway_passes_original_request_to_executor():

"""

"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.listening_proposal_executor import (
    ListeningProposalExecutor,
)

)

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import (
    PodcastProviderName,
    PodcastRecommendation,
    PodcastSearchResult,
)


def make_recommendation() -> PodcastRecommendation:
    """
    Create a deterministic PodcastRecommendation using
    the established repository contract.
    """

    result = PodcastSearchResult(
        provider=PodcastProviderName.APPLE,
        external_id="podcast-001",
        title="L'IA en Europe",
        description=(
            "Artificial intelligence and "
            "European regulation."
        ),
        publisher="Demo Publisher",
        languages=("fr",),
        url=(
            "https://example.com/"
            "podcasts/ia-en-europe"
        ),
        metadata={},
    )

    return PodcastRecommendation(
        recommendation_id="recommendation-001",
        user_id="user-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
        character_message=(
            "I found a podcast for you."
        ),
        result=result,
        relevance_reason=(
            "This podcast matches your interests."
        ),
        match_score=92.0,
    )


def make_request(
    recommendation: PodcastRecommendation | None = None,
) -> CapabilityRequest:
    """
    Create a valid Podcast Listening Proposal request.
    """

    if recommendation is None:
        recommendation = make_recommendation()

    return CapabilityRequest(
        capability=(
            CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL
        ),
        request_id="listening-proposal-001",
        payload={
            "recommendation": recommendation,
            "target_language": "fr",
            "learner_level": "B2",
        },
        requested_by="learning_application",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_executor_has_correct_capability():
    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    assert executor.capability == (
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_executor_creates_listening_proposal():
    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    result = await executor.execute(
        make_request(),
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert result.succeeded is True

    assert result.capability == (
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL
    )

    assert result.request_id == (
        "listening-proposal-001"
    )

    assert isinstance(
        result.output,
        ListeningProposal,
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_executor_preserves_recommendation_data():
    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    recommendation = make_recommendation()

    result = await executor.execute(
        make_request(
            recommendation,
        ),
    )

    proposal = result.output

    assert isinstance(
        proposal,
        ListeningProposal,
    )

    assert proposal.user_id == (
        recommendation.user_id
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_id == (
        recommendation.result.external_id
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_title == (
        recommendation.result.title
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_url == (
        recommendation.result.url
    )

    assert proposal.character_id == (
        recommendation.character_id
    )

    assert proposal.character_name == (
        recommendation.character_name
    )

"""
Tests for Podcast Listening Proposal capability registration.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.errors import (
    CapabilityAlreadyRegisteredError,
    CapabilityNotRegisteredError,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.listening_proposal_executor import (
    ListeningProposalExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.registry import (
    CapabilityRegistry,
)


def test_registry_registers_listening_proposal_executor():
    """
    Verify that the Listening Proposal executor can be
    registered with the Runtime capability registry.
    """

    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry()

    registry.register(
        executor,
    )

    assert registry.contains(
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL,
    )


def test_registry_resolves_listening_proposal_executor():
    """
    Verify that the registry resolves the exact executor
    registered for Podcast Listening Proposal.
    """

    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[
            executor,
        ],
    )

    resolved = registry.resolve(
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL,
    )

    assert resolved is executor


def test_registry_contains_listening_proposal_capability():
    """
    Verify contains() returns True after registration.
    """

    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[
            executor,
        ],
    )

    assert (
        registry.contains(
            CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL,
        )
        is True
    )


def test_registry_capabilities_includes_listening_proposal():
    """
    Verify capabilities() exposes the registered capability.
    """

    executor = ListeningProposalExecutor()

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[
            executor,
        ],
    )

    capabilities = registry.capabilities()

    assert (
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL
        in capabilities
    )


def test_duplicate_listening_proposal_registration_is_rejected():
    """
    Verify duplicate capability registration is rejected.
    """

    registry = CapabilityRegistry()

    registry.register(
        ListeningProposalExecutor(),
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        CapabilityAlreadyRegisteredError,
        match="already registered",
    ):
        registry.register(
            ListeningProposalExecutor(),
        )


def test_unregistered_listening_proposal_cannot_be_resolved():
    """
    Verify the registry correctly reports the capability
    when no executor has been registered.
    """

    registry = CapabilityRegistry()

    with pytest.raises(
        CapabilityNotRegisteredError,
        match="No executor registered",
    ):
        registry.resolve(
            CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL,
        )


def test_registry_can_hold_listening_with_other_capabilities():
    """
    Verify Podcast Listening Proposal can coexist with
    other Runtime capabilities.
    """

    listening_executor = (
        ListeningProposalExecutor()
    )

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[
            listening_executor,
        ],
    )

    assert registry.contains(
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_LISTENING_PROPOSAL,
    )

    assert (
        CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE
        not in registry.capabilities()
    )

    assert (
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY
        not in registry.capabilities()
    )

    assert (
        CapabilityType.LEARNING_GENERATION
        not in registry.capabilities()
    )

"""
Tests for the Runtime Live Intelligence executor adapter.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.live_intelligence_executor import (
    LiveIntelligenceExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityType,
)


class FakeLiveIntelligenceAgent:
    """
    Fake implementation of the existing agent contract.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = 0
        self.last_request = None

    async def execute(
        self,
        request,
    ):
        self.calls += 1
        self.last_request = request

        return {
            "topic": request.topic,
            "language": request.language,
            "learner_level": request.learner_level,
            "summary": "AI Act learning content",
        }

"""
Tests for AI Runtime capability contracts.
"""

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilityType,
)


def test_capability_request_accepts_valid_request():

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        request_id="req-001",
        payload={
            "topic": "AI Act",
        },
    )

    assert (
        request.capability
        == CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE
    )

    assert request.request_id == "req-001"

    assert request.payload == {
        "topic": "AI Act",
    }

    assert request.requested_by == "application"


def test_capability_request_supports_metadata():

    request = CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.EVALUATION,
        request_id="req-002",
        payload={
            "challenge_id": "challenge-001",
        },
        metadata={
            "trace_id": "trace-001",
        },
        requested_by="learning_application",
    )

    assert request.metadata["trace_id"] == "trace-001"

    assert (
        request.requested_by
        == "learning_application"
    )


def test_empty_request_id_is_rejected():

    try:
        CapabilityRequest(
            capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
            request_id="",
            payload={},
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert "request_id" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(
            "Expected empty request_id to be rejected."
        )


def test_empty_requester_is_rejected():

    try:
        CapabilityRequest(
            capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
            request_id="req-003",
            payload={},
            requested_by="",
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert "requested_by" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(
            "Expected empty requested_by to be rejected."
        )


def test_capability_result_reports_success():

    result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="req-004",
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
        output={
            "summary": "AI Act research",
        },
    )

    assert result.succeeded is True
    assert result.failed is False
    assert result.rejected is False


def test_capability_result_reports_failure():

    result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="req-005",
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.FAILED,
        error="Provider unavailable.",
    )

    assert result.succeeded is False
    assert result.failed is True
    assert result.rejected is False


def test_capability_result_reports_rejection():

    result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="req-006",
        capability=CapabilityType.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.REJECTED,
        error="Governance policy blocked execution.",
    )

    assert result.succeeded is False
    assert result.failed is False
    assert result.rejected is True


def test_capability_result_preserves_metadata():

    result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="req-007",
        capability=CapabilityType.EVALUATION,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.ACCEPTED,
        metadata={
            "governance_decision": "allow",
        },
    )

    assert (
        result.metadata["governance_decision"]
        == "allow"

"""
Integration tests for Podcast Discovery through the AI Runtime Gateway.

This verifies the complete Runtime path:

CapabilityRequest
    |
    v
CapabilityGateway
    |
    v
Governance
    |
    v
CapabilityRegistry
    |
    v
PodcastDiscoveryExecutor
    |
    v
PodcastDiscoveryAgent
    |
    v
PodcastRecommendationService
    |
    v
CapabilityResult

The test deliberately uses a fake provider so no external
Apple or Spotify API is called.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.gateway import (
    CapabilityGateway,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.podcast_discovery_executor import (
    PodcastDiscoveryExecutor,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.registry import (
    CapabilityRegistry,
)

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import (
    MemoryEntry,
    MemoryType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.agent import (
    PodcastDiscoveryAgent,
)

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import (
    LearningContext,
    PodcastProviderName,
    PodcastSearchResult,
)


class FakeGovernanceResult:
    """
    Minimal governance result for the integration test.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        allowed: bool,
    ) -> None:
        self.allowed = allowed


class FakeGovernance:
    """
    Deterministic governance implementation.

    The test verifies that the Runtime governance boundary
    is evaluated before Podcast Discovery execution.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        allowed: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.allowed = allowed
        self.calls = 0

    def evaluate(
        self,
        request: CapabilityRequest,
    ) -> FakeGovernanceResult:
        self.calls += 1

        return FakeGovernanceResult(
            allowed=self.allowed,
        )


class FakePodcastProvider:
    """
    Provider fake used to prevent external API calls.

    This implements the existing PodcastProvider contract.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = 0
        self.last_intent = None

    def search(
        self,
        intent,
    ) -> list[PodcastSearchResult]:
        self.calls += 1
        self.last_intent = intent

        return [
            PodcastSearchResult(
                provider=PodcastProviderName.APPLE,
                external_id="podcast-gateway-001",
                title="IA en Europe",
                description=(
                    "Artificial intelligence and European "
                    "regulation in French."
                ),
                publisher="Demo Publisher",
                languages=("fr",),
                url=(
                    "https://example.com/podcast/"
                    "ia-en-europe"
                ),
                metadata={
                    "learner_level": "B2",
                },
            ),
        ]


def make_memory() -> MemoryEntry:
    """
    Create an explicit learner preference memory.

    Memory is supplied to the Runtime capability payload;
    the PodcastDiscoveryExecutor does not retrieve it itself.
    """

    return MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content=(
            "Prefers artificial intelligence "
            "and European regulation."
        ),
        metadata={
            "topics": (
                "artificial intelligence, "
                "European regulation"
            ),
        },
    )


def make_request() -> CapabilityRequest:
    """
    Build a realistic Podcast Discovery Runtime request.
    """

    return CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY,
        request_id="podcast-gateway-001",
        payload={
            "user_id": "user-001",
            "world_id": "French World",
            "target_language": "fr",
            "learner_level": "B2",
            "learning_goal": (
                "Learn French through current affairs."
            ),
            "country_code": "LU",
            "memories": [
                make_memory(),
            ],
            "character_id": "yeti",
            "character_name": "Yeti",
            "character_message": (
                "I found this podcast for you!"
            ),
            "max_results": 10,
        },
        requested_by="learning_application",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_podcast_discovery_executes_through_runtime_gateway():
    """
    Verify the complete Runtime â†’ Podcast Discovery flow.
    """

    provider = FakePodcastProvider()

    executor = PodcastDiscoveryExecutor(
        agent=PodcastDiscoveryAgent(),
        providers=[provider],
    )

    registry = CapabilityRegistry(
        executors=[
            executor,
        ],
    )

    governance = FakeGovernance(
        allowed=True,
    )

    gateway = CapabilityGateway(
        registry=registry,
        governance=governance,
    )

    request = make_request()

    result = await gateway.execute(
        request,
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert result.succeeded is True

    assert result.request_id == (
        "podcast-gateway-001"
    )

    assert result.capability == (
        CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY
    )

    assert result.output is not None

    recommendation = result.output

    assert recommendation.user_id == (
        "user-001"
    )

    assert recommendation.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )

    assert recommendation.character_name == (
        "Yeti"
    )

    assert recommendation.result.title == (
        "IA en Europe"
    )

    assert recommendation.result.languages == (
        "fr",
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.match_score
        > 0
    )

    assert (
        "artificial intelligence"
        in recommendation.relevance_reason.lower()
    )

    assert (
        "French World"
        in recommendation.relevance_reason
    )

    assert governance.calls == 1

    assert provider.calls == 1

    |

    |

        self,

        return [
            {
                "title": "Fake Podcast",
                "source": self.provider_id,
                "query": query,
            }
        ]

    """

    async def execute(
        self,

            status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
            output={"ok": True},
        )

    """

    Runtime capability registration.

    The real PodcastDiscoveryExecutor is tested separately.
    """

    @property
    def capability(self) -> CapabilityType:
        return CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY

    async def execute(
        self,

        return CapabilityResult(
            request_id=request.request_id,
            capability=request.capability,
            status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
            output={

            },
        )

"""
Regression tests for the CommerceService payment boundary.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.payment_pass import (
    PaymentPass,
)

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.service import (
    CommerceService,
)


def make_payment_pass() -> PaymentPass:
    """Create a valid demo payment pass."""

    return PaymentPass(
        payment_pass_id="payment-pass-001",
        deal_id="deal-001",
        user_id="user-001",
        product_name="iPhone 17 Pro",
        vendor_name="Demo Vendor",
        amount=999.99,
        currency="EUR",
        checkout_url=(
            "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
        ),
    )


def test_commerce_service_prepares_demo_payment():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    result = CommerceService().prepare_payment(
        payment_pass
    )

    assert result is payment_pass
    assert result.is_ready is True
    assert result.is_demo_only is True
    assert result.payment_executed is False


def test_commerce_service_does_not_change_payment_pass():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    result = CommerceService().prepare_payment(
        payment_pass
    )

    assert result.payment_pass_id == payment_pass.payment_pass_id
    assert result.deal_id == payment_pass.deal_id
    assert result.user_id == payment_pass.user_id
    assert result.amount == payment_pass.amount
    assert result.currency == payment_pass.currency
    assert result.checkout_url == payment_pass.checkout_url


def test_commerce_service_rejects_non_ready_payment_pass():

    class InvalidPaymentPass:
        is_ready = False
        is_demo_only = True

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="PaymentPass must be READY",
    ):
        CommerceService().prepare_payment(
            InvalidPaymentPass()
        )


def test_commerce_service_rejects_non_demo_payment():

    class InvalidPaymentPass:
        is_ready = True
        is_demo_only = False

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="DEMO execution mode",
    ):
        CommerceService().prepare_payment(
            InvalidPaymentPass()
        )

"""
Integration test for:

DealCard
    â†“
CommerceAction
    â†“
CommerceService
"""

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.models import (
    CommerceAction,
    CommerceActionStatus,
    CommerceActionType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.service import (
    CommerceService,
)

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.models import (
    CommerceLink,
    DealCard,
)


def test_deal_can_become_commerce_action():

    link = CommerceLink(
        vendor="Example Vendor",
        destination_url=(
            "https://example.com/product/001"
        ),
    )

    deal = DealCard(
        product_name="Travel Backpack",
        vendor="Example Vendor",
        price=89.0,
        currency="EUR",
        commerce_link=link,
    )

    action = CommerceAction(
        user_id="user-001",
        deal_id=deal.deal_id,
        action_type=(
            CommerceActionType.INITIATE_PURCHASE
        ),
        destination_url=(
            deal.commerce_link.click_url
        ),
    )

    result = CommerceService().initiate(
        action
    )

    assert (
        result.status
        == CommerceActionStatus.REDIRECT
    )

    assert (
        result.deal_id
        == deal.deal_id
    )

    assert (
        result.next_url
        == deal.commerce_link.click_url
    )

"""
Tests for Flash Deal commerce integration.

These tests verify that a FlashDealCard can produce both:
- the existing CommerceAction
- the new demo-only PaymentPass

No payment is executed.
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.flash_deal_commerce import (
    FlashDealCommerce,
)

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.models import (
    CommerceActionType,
)

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.payment_pass import (
    PaymentExecutionMode,
    PaymentPassStatus,
)

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.flash_deal_card import (
    FlashDealCard,
)


def make_card() -> FlashDealCard:
    """Create a deterministic FlashDealCard for tests."""

    return FlashDealCard(
        deal_id="deal-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
        character_message=(
            "Look what I found!"
        ),
        product_name="iPhone 17 Pro",
        product_image_url=(
            "https://example.com/demo/iphone17-pro.jpg"
        ),
        tagline="Pro. Beautiful. Powerful.",
        highlights=(
            "Pro camera system",
            "High-performance chip",
        ),
        current_price=999.99,
        currency="EUR",
        previous_price=1199.00,
        discount_percentage=17.0,
        savings=199.01,
        relevance_reason=(
            "Matches the user's preference for "
            "powerful mobile photography devices."
        ),
        vendor_name="Demo Vendor",
        more_information_url=(
            "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
        ),
        get_deal_url=(
            "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
        ),
    )


def test_flash_deal_commerce_still_creates_existing_action():

    card = make_card()

    action = FlashDealCommerce().create_action(
        user_id="user-001",
        card=card,
    )

    assert action.user_id == "user-001"
    assert action.deal_id == "deal-001"
    assert (
        action.action_type
        is CommerceActionType.INITIATE_PURCHASE
    )
    assert (
        action.destination_url
        == card.get_deal_url
    )


def test_flash_deal_creates_demo_payment_pass():

    card = make_card()

    payment_pass = (
        FlashDealCommerce().create_payment_pass(
            user_id="user-001",
            card=card,
            payment_pass_id="payment-pass-001",
        )
    )

    assert (
        payment_pass.payment_pass_id
        == "payment-pass-001"
    )
    assert payment_pass.user_id == "user-001"
    assert payment_pass.deal_id == card.deal_id
    assert payment_pass.product_name == card.product_name
    assert payment_pass.vendor_name == card.vendor_name
    assert payment_pass.amount == card.current_price
    assert payment_pass.currency == card.currency
    assert (
        payment_pass.checkout_url
        == card.get_deal_url
    )

    assert (
        payment_pass.status
        is PaymentPassStatus.READY
    )

    assert (
        payment_pass.execution_mode
        is PaymentExecutionMode.DEMO
    )

    assert payment_pass.payment_executed is False


def test_flash_deal_payment_pass_preserves_checkout_boundary():

    card = make_card()

    payment_pass = (
        FlashDealCommerce().create_payment_pass(
            user_id="user-001",
            card=card,
        )
    )

    assert (
        payment_pass.checkout_url
        == card.get_deal_url
    )

    assert payment_pass.payment_executed is False


def test_flash_deal_payment_pass_rejects_empty_user():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Commerce user_id cannot be empty",
    ):
        FlashDealCommerce().create_payment_pass(
            user_id="",
            card=make_card(),
        )

"""
Tests for the hackathon PaymentPass.

The PaymentPass is a demo-only checkout handoff.

These tests verify:
- valid construction
- immutable/read-only behaviour
- READY status
- DEMO execution mode
- no executed payment
- validation
- safe checkout URL contract
- deterministic demo rendering
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.commerce.payment_pass import (
    PaymentExecutionMode,
    PaymentPass,
    PaymentPassStatus,
)


def make_payment_pass() -> PaymentPass:
    """Create a valid PaymentPass for tests."""

    return PaymentPass(
        payment_pass_id="payment-pass-001",
        deal_id="deal-001",
        user_id="user-001",
        product_name="iPhone 17 Pro",
        vendor_name="Demo Vendor",
        amount=999.99,
        currency="EUR",
        checkout_url=(
            "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
        ),
    )


def test_payment_pass_creates_valid_demo_handoff():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    assert (
        payment_pass.payment_pass_id
        == "payment-pass-001"
    )
    assert payment_pass.deal_id == "deal-001"
    assert payment_pass.user_id == "user-001"
    assert payment_pass.product_name == "iPhone 17 Pro"
    assert payment_pass.vendor_name == "Demo Vendor"
    assert payment_pass.amount == 999.99
    assert payment_pass.currency == "EUR"
    assert (
        payment_pass.checkout_url
        == "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
    )


def test_payment_pass_is_ready():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    assert payment_pass.status is PaymentPassStatus.READY
    assert payment_pass.is_ready is True


def test_payment_pass_is_demo_only():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    assert (
        payment_pass.execution_mode
        is PaymentExecutionMode.DEMO
    )
    assert payment_pass.is_demo_only is True


def test_payment_pass_never_reports_payment_as_executed():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    assert payment_pass.payment_executed is False


def test_payment_pass_formats_amount():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    assert (
        payment_pass.display_amount()
        == "EUR 999.99"
    )


def test_payment_pass_renders_demo_handoff():

    payment_pass = make_payment_pass()

    output = payment_pass.render_demo()

    assert "PAYMENT PASS" in output
    assert "Product: iPhone 17 Pro" in output
    assert "Vendor: Demo Vendor" in output
    assert "Amount: EUR 999.99" in output
    assert "Payment status: READY" in output
    assert "Execution mode: DEMO" in output
    assert "[ PROCEED TO CHECKOUT ]" in output
    assert "No payment has been executed." in output
    assert (
        "Vendor checkout remains outside "
        "the hackathon demo."
        in output
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "field,value",
    [
        ("payment_pass_id", ""),
        ("deal_id", ""),
        ("user_id", ""),

        ("vendor_name", ""),
        ("currency", ""),
        ("checkout_url", ""),

)
def test_payment_pass_rejects_empty_required_text(
    field: str,
    value: str,
):

    values = {
        "payment_pass_id": "payment-pass-001",
        "deal_id": "deal-001",
        "user_id": "user-001",
        "product_name": "iPhone 17 Pro",

        "amount": 999.99,
        "currency": "EUR",
        "checkout_url": (
            "https://example.com/vendor/iphone17-pro"
        ),
    }

    values[field] = value

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=f"PaymentPass {field} cannot be empty",
    ):
        PaymentPass(**values)

"""
Tests for the hackathon DiscoveryService.

Flow:

DealCard
    +
Memory
    +
CharacterContext
    â†“
DiscoveryService
    â†“
FlashDealCard
"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.models import (
    CommerceLink,
    DealCard,
)

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.service import (
    CharacterContext,
    DiscoveryRequest,
    DiscoveryService,
)

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import (
    MemoryEntry,
    MemoryType,
)


def make_deal() -> DealCard:
    """
    Create deterministic discovery data for tests.
    """

    return DealCard(
        product_name="iPhone 17 Pro",
        vendor="Demo Vendor",
        price=999.99,
        currency="EUR",
        previous_price=1199.00,
        discount_percentage=17.0,
        commerce_link=CommerceLink(
            vendor="Demo Vendor",
            destination_url=(
                "https://example.com/product"
            ),
        ),
        source="test",
        description="Test discovery product.",
    )


def make_request() -> DiscoveryRequest:
    """
    Create a deterministic discovery request.
    """

    return DiscoveryRequest(
        user_id="user-001",
        deal=make_deal(),
        character=CharacterContext(
            character_id="yeti",
            character_name="Yeti",
            message=(
                "Look what I found! "
                "This could be perfect for you."
            ),
        ),
        product_image_url=(
            "https://example.com/product.jpg"
        ),
        tagline="Pro. Beautiful. Powerful.",
        highlights=(
            "Pro camera system",
            "High-performance chip",
            "All-day battery life",
        ),
    )


def make_preference_memory() -> MemoryEntry:
    """
    Create explicit user preference memory.
    """

    return MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content=(
            "prefer powerful mobile photography "
            "devices"
        ),
    )


def test_discovery_service_creates_flash_deal():

    request = make_request()

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request
    )

    assert result.deal_id == request.deal.deal_id

    assert result.product_name == "iPhone 17 Pro"

    assert result.vendor_name == "Demo Vendor"

    assert result.character_id == "yeti"

    assert result.character_name == "Yeti"

    assert result.current_price == 999.99

    assert result.discount_percentage == 17.0


def test_discovery_service_applies_preference_memory():

    request = make_request()

    memory = make_preference_memory()

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request,
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert (
        "powerful mobile photography devices"
        in result.relevance_reason
    )


def test_discovery_service_does_not_require_memory():

    request = make_request()

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request,
        memories=[],
    )

    assert result.relevance_reason == (
        "This discovery may be relevant to your interests."
    )


def test_discovery_service_ignores_non_preference_memory():

    request = make_request()

    non_preference_type = next(
        memory_type
        for memory_type in MemoryType
        if memory_type != MemoryType.PREFERENCE
    )

    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=non_preference_type,
        content=(
            "Discussed photography during the "
            "previous conversation."
        ),
    )

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request,
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert result.relevance_reason == (
        "This discovery may be relevant to your interests."
    )


def test_discovery_service_preserves_deal_identity():

    deal = make_deal()

    request = DiscoveryRequest(
        user_id="user-001",
        deal=deal,
        character=CharacterContext(
            character_id="yeti",
            character_name="Yeti",
            message="I found something for you.",
        ),
        product_image_url=(
            "https://example.com/product.jpg"
        ),
        tagline="A useful discovery.",
        highlights=(
            "Useful",
            "Practical",
        ),
    )

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request
    )

    assert result.deal_id == deal.deal_id


def test_discovery_service_preserves_character_context():

    request = make_request()

    result = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request
    )

    assert result.character_id == "yeti"

    assert result.character_name == "Yeti"

    assert result.character_message == (
        "Look what I found! "
        "This could be perfect for you."
    )


def test_discovery_service_rejects_empty_user_id():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="user_id cannot be empty",
    ):
        DiscoveryRequest(
            user_id="",
            deal=make_deal(),
            character=CharacterContext(
                character_id="yeti",
                character_name="Yeti",
                message="I found something.",
            ),
            product_image_url=(
                "https://example.com/product.jpg"
            ),
            tagline="A useful discovery.",
            highlights=("Useful",),
        )


def test_character_context_rejects_empty_character_id():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="character_id cannot be empty",
    ):
        CharacterContext(
            character_id="",
            character_name="Yeti",
            message="I found something.",
        )


def test_discovery_request_rejects_empty_highlights():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="at least one highlight",
    ):
        DiscoveryRequest(
            user_id="user-001",
            deal=make_deal(),
            character=CharacterContext(
                character_id="yeti",
                character_name="Yeti",
                message="I found something.",
            ),
            product_image_url=(
                "https://example.com/product.jpg"
            ),
            tagline="A useful discovery.",
            highlights=(),
        )

"""
Tests for the hackathon Flash Deal Card presentation contract.

The tests validate the user-facing card described by the
hackathon UX:

Character
    â†“
Product
    â†“
Pricing / Deal
    â†“
Why relevant to you
    â†“
Vendor
    â†“
GET DEAL / MORE INFORMATION

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.flash_deal_card import (
    FlashDealCard,
)

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.models import (
    CommerceLink,
    CommerceLinkType,
    DealCard,
)


def make_deal(
    *,
    affiliate: bool = False,
) -> DealCard:
    link = CommerceLink(
        vendor="eBay",
        destination_url=(
            "https://www.ebay.com/itm/example"
        ),
        link_type=(
            CommerceLinkType.AFFILIATE
            if affiliate
            else CommerceLinkType.DIRECT
        ),
        tracking_url=(
            "https://tracking.example.com/deal/001"
            if affiliate
            else None
        ),
    )

    return DealCard(
        product_name="iPhone 17 Pro",
        vendor="eBay",
        price=999.99,
        currency="EUR",
        previous_price=1199.00,
        discount_percentage=17.0,
        commerce_link=link,
        source="parallel",
        description="Pro smartphone with advanced camera system.",
    )


def test_flash_deal_card_is_created_from_deal():

    deal = make_deal()

    card = FlashDealCard.from_deal(
        deal=deal,
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
        character_message="Look what I found!",
        relevance_reason=(
            "This matches your interest in powerful "
            "mobile photography."
        ),
        product_image_url=(
            "https://example.com/images/iphone17.jpg"
        ),
        tagline="Pro. Beautiful. Powerful.",
        highlights=[
            "Pro camera system",
            "A19 Bionic chip",
            "All-day battery life",
            "6.3-inch Super Retina XDR display",
        ],
    )

    assert card.deal_id == deal.deal_id
    assert card.character_id == "yeti"
    assert card.character_name == "Yeti"

    assert card.product_name == "iPhone 17 Pro"
    assert card.tagline == "Pro. Beautiful. Powerful."

    assert len(card.highlights) == 4

    assert card.current_price == 999.99
    assert card.previous_price == 1199.00
    assert card.discount_percentage == 17.0

    assert card.savings == 199.01

    assert card.vendor_name == "eBay"

    assert (
        card.more_information_url
        == "https://www.ebay.com/itm/example"
    )

    assert (
        card.get_deal_url
        == "https://www.ebay.com/itm/example"
    )

"""
Tests for the FlashDealPresenter.

The presenter must remain a pure presentation layer over
FlashDealCard.
"""

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.flash_deal_demo import (
    build_demo_flash_deal_card,
)

from src.ai_runtime.discovery.flash_deal_presenter import (
    FlashDealPresenter,
)


def test_presenter_renders_character():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "## Yeti" in output

    assert (
        "Look what I found!"
        in output
    )


def test_presenter_renders_product():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "iPhone 17 Pro" in output

    assert (
        "Pro. Beautiful. Powerful."
        in output
    )


def test_presenter_renders_highlights():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "### HIGHLIGHTS" in output

    for highlight in card.highlights:
        assert highlight in output


def test_presenter_renders_verified_pricing():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "### PRICE" in output

    assert (
        f"{card.currency} "
        f"{card.current_price:.2f}"
        in output
    )

    assert (
        f"{card.currency} "
        f"{card.previous_price:.2f}"
        in output
    )

    assert (
        card.display_discount
        in output
    )

    assert (
        card.display_savings
        in output
    )


def test_presenter_renders_personalisation():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert (
        "### WHY THIS IS RELEVANT TO YOU"
        in output
    )

    assert (
        card.relevance_reason
        in output
    )


def test_presenter_renders_vendor():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "### AVAILABLE FROM" in output

    assert card.vendor_name in output


def test_presenter_renders_commerce_actions():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    output = FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert "### ACTIONS" in output

    assert (
        f"[GET DEAL]({card.get_deal_url})"
        in output
    )

    assert (
        "[MORE INFORMATION]"
        f"({card.more_information_url})"
        in output
    )


def test_presenter_does_not_mutate_card():

    card = build_demo_flash_deal_card()

    original = {
        "deal_id": card.deal_id,
        "product_name": card.product_name,
        "price": card.current_price,
        "vendor": card.vendor_name,
        "relevance": card.relevance_reason,
        "get_deal_url": card.get_deal_url,
        "more_information_url": (
            card.more_information_url
        ),
    }

    FlashDealPresenter().render(card)

    assert card.deal_id == original["deal_id"]

    assert (
        card.product_name
        == original["product_name"]
    )

    assert (
        card.current_price
        == original["price"]
    )

    assert (
        card.vendor_name
        == original["vendor"]
    )

    assert (
        card.relevance_reason
        == original["relevance"]
    )

    assert (
        card.get_deal_url
        == original["get_deal_url"]
    )

    assert (
        card.more_information_url
        == original["more_information_url"]
    )

    return DealCard(

        price=89.0,
        currency="EUR",
        previous_price=129.0,
        discount_percentage=31.0,
        commerce_link=link,
        source="parallel",
    )

"""
Tests for AI Runtime Flashcard domain model.

Validates:

- Flashcard creation
- Input validation
- Normalisation
- Immutability

The test does not validate:
- AI generation
- Providers
- Runtime execution
- Persistence
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.learning.flashcard import (
    Flashcard,
)


def test_flashcard_creation() -> None:
    """
    Valid flashcards should be created.
    """

    card = Flashcard(
        front="rÃ©glementation",
        back="regulation",
        example=(
            "La rÃ©glementation europÃ©enne Ã©volue."
        ),
    )

    assert card.front == "rÃ©glementation"

    assert card.back == "regulation"

    assert (
        card.example
        ==
        "La rÃ©glementation europÃ©enne Ã©volue."
    )


def test_flashcard_trims_whitespace() -> None:
    """
    Flashcard values should be normalised.
    """

    card = Flashcard(
        front="  enjeu  ",
        back="  challenge  ",
        example="  Example sentence  ",
    )

    assert card.front == "enjeu"

    assert card.back == "challenge"

    assert (
        card.example
        ==
        "Example sentence"
    )


def test_flashcard_rejects_empty_front() -> None:
    """
    Empty front values are invalid.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="front cannot be empty",
    ):
        Flashcard(
            front=" ",
            back="answer",
        )


def test_flashcard_rejects_empty_back() -> None:
    """
    Empty back values are invalid.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="back cannot be empty",
    ):
        Flashcard(
            front="question",
            back=" ",
        )


def test_flashcard_requires_string_fields() -> None:
    """
    Flashcard fields must be strings.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="front must be a string",
    ):
        Flashcard(
            front=123,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            back="answer",
        )


def test_flashcard_is_immutable() -> None:
    """
    Flashcards are immutable domain objects.
    """

    card = Flashcard(
        front="mot",
        back="word",
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        AttributeError,
    ):
        card.front = "changed"  # type: ignore[misc]

"""
Tests for H3-01 MemoryContextBuilder.

The builder consumes the application-facing
MemoryRecord contract returned by MemoryService.

No LLM, provider, database, or external service is used.
"""

from backend.memory.memory_record import (
    MemoryRecord,
)

from src.ai_runtime.memory.context_builder import (
    DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS,
    DEFAULT_MAX_MEMORY_ITEMS,
    MemoryContextBuilder,
)


def make_memory(
    *,
    user_id: str = "user-001",
    category: str = "preference",
    content: str = (
        "Prefers technology topics."
    ),
) -> MemoryRecord:
    return MemoryRecord(
        user_id=user_id,
        category=category,
        content=content,
        created_at=__import__(
            "datetime"
        ).datetime.now(
            __import__(
                "datetime"
            ).timezone.utc
        ),
    )


def test_empty_memory_returns_empty_context() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI regulation",
        memories=[],
    )

    assert result.is_empty is True
    assert result.entries == ()
    assert result.text == ""


def test_relevant_preference_is_included() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    memory = make_memory(
        content=(
            "Prefers European AI regulation topics."
        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request=(
            "latest European AI regulation"
        ),
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert result.memory_count == 1
    assert result.entries == (memory,)
    assert (
        "European AI regulation"
        in result.text
    )


def test_irrelevant_memory_is_excluded() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    memory = make_memory(
        content=(
            "Prefers hiking and mountain equipment."
        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request=(
            "latest European AI regulation"
        ),
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert result.is_empty is True


def test_relevant_learning_goal_is_included() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    memory = make_memory(
        category="learning_goal",
        content=(
            "Improve French conversation "
            "about technology."
        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="French technology conversation",
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert result.entries == (memory,)


def test_relevant_discovery_context_is_included() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    memory = make_memory(
        category="discovery_context",
        content=(
            "Previously discussed European "
            "AI regulation."
        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI regulation",
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert result.entries == (memory,)


def test_user_isolation_excludes_other_users() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    own_memory = make_memory(
        user_id="user-001",
        content=(
            "Prefers European AI topics."
        ),
    )

    other_memory = make_memory(
        user_id="user-002",
        content=(
            "Prefers European AI topics."
        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI",
        memories=[
            other_memory,
            own_memory,
        ],
    )

    assert result.entries == (own_memory,)


def test_max_memory_items_is_enforced() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder(
        max_memory_items=2,
        max_context_characters=4000,
    )

    memories = [
        make_memory(
            content=(
                f"Prefers technology topic "
                f"{index}."
            ),
        )
        for index in range(5)
    ]

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="technology topic",
        memories=memories,
    )

    assert len(result.entries) == 2


def test_max_context_characters_is_enforced() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder(
        max_memory_items=5,
        max_context_characters=100,
    )

    memory = make_memory(
        content=(
            "Prefers European artificial "
            "intelligence regulation and "

        ),
    )

    result = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",

        ),
        memories=[memory],

    assert len(result.text) <= 100


def test_ordering_is_deterministic() -> None:
    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    first_memory = make_memory(
        content=(
            "Prefers European AI regulation."
        ),
    )

    second_memory = make_memory(
        content=(
            "Interested in European AI policy."
        ),
    )

    memories = [
        first_memory,
        second_memory,
    ]

    first = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI regulation",
        memories=memories,
    )

    second = builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI regulation",
        memories=memories,
    )

    assert first.entries == second.entries
    assert first.text == second.text

    builder = MemoryContextBuilder()

    )

        content="Prefers European AI topics.",
    )

    second = make_memory(
        content="Prefers technology topics.",
    )

    memories = [
        first,
        second,
    ]

    original = list(memories)

    builder.build(
        user_id="user-001",
        request="European AI",
        memories=memories,
    )

    assert memories == original

"""
Tests for the MemoryEntry -> MemoryRecord mapping boundary.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from backend.memory.memory_record import (
    MemoryRecord,
)

from src.ai_runtime.memory.mapper import (
    MemoryMapper,
)

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import (
    MemoryEntry,
    MemoryType,
)


def test_memory_mapper_converts_entry_to_record() -> None:
    """
    MemoryEntry should convert into the application
    MemoryRecord contract.
    """

    created_at = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )

    entry = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Prefers French podcasts about technology.",
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=created_at,
    )

    record = MemoryMapper.to_record(
        entry
    )

    assert isinstance(
        record,
        MemoryRecord,
    )

    assert record.user_id == "user-001"

    assert (
        record.category
        == "preference"
    )

    assert (
        record.content
        == "Prefers French podcasts about technology."
    )

    assert record.created_at == created_at


def test_memory_mapper_rejects_invalid_input() -> None:
    """
    Mapper should reject unsupported objects.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
    ):
        MemoryMapper.to_record(
            "invalid-memory",
        )


def test_memory_mapper_converts_multiple_entries() -> None:
    """
    Multiple MemoryEntry objects should map
    deterministically.
    """

    entries = [
        MemoryEntry(
            user_id="user-001",
            memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
            content="Likes French podcasts.",
        ),
        MemoryEntry(
            user_id="user-001",
            memory_type=MemoryType.DISCOVERY_CONTEXT,
            content="Learning AI vocabulary.",
        ),
    ]

    records = MemoryMapper.to_records(
        entries,
    )

    assert len(records) == 2

    assert records[0].category == (
        "preference"
    )

    assert records[1].category == (
        "discovery_context"
    )

"""
Tests for the hackathon Memory contracts.
"""

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import (
    MemoryEntry,
    MemoryType,
)


def test_memory_entry_creates_valid_preference():

    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Prefers lightweight laptops.",
    )

    assert memory.user_id == "user-001"

    assert (
        memory.memory_type
        == MemoryType.PREFERENCE
    )

    assert (
        memory.content
        == "Prefers lightweight laptops."
    )

    assert memory.memory_id

    assert isinstance(
        memory.created_at,
        datetime,
    )


def test_memory_entry_supports_discovery_context():

    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.DISCOVERY_CONTEXT,
        content="Looking for a laptop under EUR 1000.",
    )

    assert (
        memory.memory_type
        == MemoryType.DISCOVERY_CONTEXT
    )


def test_memory_entry_supports_saved_items():

    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.SAVED_ITEM,
        content="MacBook Air M4",
        metadata={
            "category": "laptop",
        },
    )

    assert (
        memory.memory_type
        == MemoryType.SAVED_ITEM
    )

    assert (
        memory.metadata["category"]
        == "laptop"
    )


def test_memory_requires_user_id():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="user_id cannot be empty",
    ):
        MemoryEntry(
            user_id="",
            memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
            content="Prefers lightweight products.",
        )


def test_memory_requires_content():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="content cannot be empty",
    ):
        MemoryEntry(
            user_id="user-001",
            memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
            content="",
        )


def test_memory_to_dict_is_persistence_safe():

    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Prefers lightweight laptops.",
    )

    data = memory.to_dict()

    assert data["memory_id"] == memory.memory_id

    assert data["user_id"] == "user-001"

    assert (
        data["memory_type"]
        == "preference"
    )

    assert (
        data["content"]
        == "Prefers lightweight laptops."
    )

    assert isinstance(
        data["created_at"],
        str,
    )

    assert isinstance(
        data["updated_at"],
        str,
    )

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import (

def test_memory_service_remembers_preference(
    tmp_path,
):

    store = MemoryStore(
        tmp_path / "memory.db"
    )

    service = MemoryService(
        store=store
    )

    memory = service.remember(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Prefers minimalist products.",
    )

    assert memory.user_id == "user-001"

    assert (
        memory.memory_type
        == MemoryType.PREFERENCE
    )

    assert (
        memory.content
        == "Prefers minimalist products."
    )

    tmp_path,
):

    service = MemoryService(
        store=MemoryStore(
            tmp_path / "memory.db"
        )
    )

    service.remember(
        user_id="user-001",

        content="Likes minimalist design.",

    service.remember(

    tmp_path,

    service = MemoryService(
        store=MemoryStore(
            tmp_path / "memory.db"
        )
    )

    service.remember(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Likes hiking products.",
    )

    service.remember(
        user_id="user-002",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Likes photography products.",

    memories = service.list_for_user(

    tmp_path,
):

    service = MemoryService(
        store=MemoryStore(

        )
    )

    memory = service.remember(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.SAVED_ITEM,
        content="Travel backpack",

from src.ai_runtime.memory.models import MemoryEntry, MemoryType
from src.ai_runtime.podcast.agent import PodcastDiscoveryAgent
from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import LearningContext


def context() -> LearningContext:
    return LearningContext(
        world_id="French World",
        target_language="fr",
        learner_level="B2",
        learning_goal="Learn French through current affairs.",
    )


def test_agent_is_provider_agnostic_and_uses_preferences() -> None:
    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.PREFERENCE,
        content="Prefers technology podcasts.",
        metadata={
            "topics": "artificial intelligence, European regulation",
        },
    )

    intent = PodcastDiscoveryAgent().build_search_intent(
        user_id="user-001",
        learning_context=context(),
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert intent.learning_context.target_language == "fr"
    assert intent.learning_context.world_id == "French World"
    assert "artificial intelligence" in intent.topics
    assert "European regulation" in intent.topics
    assert intent.language_required is True


def test_agent_ignores_non_preference_memory() -> None:
    memory = MemoryEntry(
        user_id="user-001",
        memory_type=MemoryType.DISCOVERY_CONTEXT,
        content="Discussed artificial intelligence.",
    )

    intent = PodcastDiscoveryAgent().build_search_intent(
        user_id="user-001",
        learning_context=context(),
        memories=[memory],
    )

    assert intent.topics == ("French World",)

"""

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.listening import (
    ListeningProposal,
    ListeningProposalAction,
)


def make_proposal() -> ListeningProposal:
    return ListeningProposal(
        user_id="user-001",
        podcast_id="podcast-001",
        podcast_title="L'IA en Europe",
        podcast_url=(
            "https://example.com/podcast/ia-en-europe"
        ),
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
        message=(
            "Would you like to listen to this podcast?"
        ),
        action=ListeningProposalAction.LISTEN,

        ),
        target_language="fr",
        learner_level="B2",
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_id == (
        "podcast-001"
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_title == (
        "L'IA en Europe"
    )

    assert proposal.podcast_url == (
        "https://example.com/podcast/ia-en-europe"
    )

    assert proposal.character_id == "yeti"

    assert proposal.character_name == "Yeti"

    assert proposal.action == (
        ListeningProposalAction.LISTEN
    )

    assert proposal.target_language == "fr"

    assert proposal.learner_level == "B2"


def test_listening_proposal_is_passive():
    proposal = make_proposal()

    assert proposal.is_passive is True


def test_listening_proposal_supports_open_action():
    proposal = ListeningProposal(
        user_id="user-001",
        podcast_id="podcast-001",
        podcast_title="L'IA en Europe",
        podcast_url=(
            "https://example.com/podcast/ia-en-europe"
        ),
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
        message=(
            "You can open this podcast if you want."
        ),
        action=ListeningProposalAction.OPEN,
        reason=(
            "The podcast is relevant to your learning."
        ),
        target_language="fr",
        learner_level="B2",
    )

    assert proposal.action == (
        ListeningProposalAction.OPEN
    )

    assert proposal.is_passive is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "field_name",
    [
        "user_id",
        "podcast_id",
        "podcast_title",
        "podcast_url",
        "character_id",
        "character_name",
        "message",
        "reason",
        "target_language",
        "learner_level",
    ],
)
def test_empty_required_fields_are_rejected(
    field_name: str,
):
    values = {
        "user_id": "user-001",
        "podcast_id": "podcast-001",
        "podcast_title": "L'IA en Europe",
        "podcast_url": (
            "https://example.com/podcast/ia-en-europe"
        ),
        "character_id": "yeti",
        "character_name": "Yeti",
        "message": (
            "Would you like to listen to this podcast?"
        ),
        "action": ListeningProposalAction.LISTEN,
        "reason": (
            "It matches your learning interests."
        ),
        "target_language": "fr",
        "learner_level": "B2",
    }

    values[field_name] = ""

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=f"ListeningProposal {field_name}",
    ):
        ListeningProposal(**values)


def test_invalid_podcast_url_is_rejected():
    values = {
        "user_id": "user-001",
        "podcast_id": "podcast-001",
        "podcast_title": "L'IA en Europe",
        "podcast_url": "javascript:play()",
        "character_id": "yeti",
        "character_name": "Yeti",
        "message": (
            "Would you like to listen to this podcast?"
        ),
        "action": ListeningProposalAction.LISTEN,
        "reason": (
            "It matches your learning interests."
        ),
        "target_language": "fr",
        "learner_level": "B2",
    }

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="podcast_url must use HTTP or HTTPS",
    ):
        ListeningProposal(**values)


def test_listening_proposal_is_immutable():
    proposal = make_proposal()

    with pytest.raises(
        AttributeError,
    ):
        proposal.podcast_title = "Changed"


def test_listening_proposal_does_not_contain_provider_credentials():
    proposal = make_proposal()

    fields = proposal.__dataclass_fields__

    assert "api_key" not in fields

    assert "access_token" not in fields

    assert "client_secret" not in fields

    assert "provider_token" not in fields

import json

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.apple import ApplePodcastProvider
from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import (
    LearningContext,
    PodcastProviderName,
    PodcastSearchIntent,
)
from src.ai_runtime.podcast.spotify import SpotifyPodcastProvider


class FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, payload: dict):
        self.payload = payload

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        return False

    def read(self):
        return json.dumps(self.payload).encode("utf-8")


def intent() -> PodcastSearchIntent:
    return PodcastSearchIntent(
        user_id="user-001",
        learning_context=LearningContext(
            world_id="French World",
            target_language="fr",
            learner_level="B2",
        ),
        topics=("artificial intelligence",),
    )


def test_apple_normalises_language(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "src.ai_runtime.podcast.apple.urlopen",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: FakeResponse(
            {
                "results": [
                    {
                        "kind": "podcast",
                        "collectionId": 123,
                        "collectionName": "IA en France",
                        "artistName": "Demo Publisher",
                        "language": "French",
                        "collectionViewUrl": (
                            "https://podcasts.apple.com/example"
                        ),
                    }
                ]
            }
        ),
    )

    results = ApplePodcastProvider().search(intent())

    assert len(results) == 1
    assert results[0].provider == PodcastProviderName.APPLE
    assert results[0].languages == ("fr",)


def test_spotify_normalises_episode_language(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "src.ai_runtime.podcast.spotify.urlopen",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: FakeResponse(
            {
                "episodes": {
                    "items": [
                        {
                            "id": "episode-001",
                            "name": "IA en Europe",
                            "description": "European AI regulation",
                            "languages": ["fr"],
                            "duration_ms": 1800000,
                            "release_date": "2026-08-10",
                            "external_urls": {
                                "spotify": (
                                    "https://open.spotify.com/episode/episode-001"
                                )
                            },
                            "images": [],
                        }
                    ]
                }
            }
        ),
    )

    results = SpotifyPodcastProvider(
        access_token="test-token"
    ).search(intent())

    assert len(results) == 1
    assert results[0].provider == PodcastProviderName.SPOTIFY
    assert results[0].languages == ("fr",)
    assert results[0].duration_seconds == 1800

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.models import (
    LearningContext,
    PodcastProviderName,
    PodcastSearchIntent,
    PodcastSearchResult,

from src.ai_runtime.podcast.service import PodcastRecommendationService


def intent() -> PodcastSearchIntent:
