        user_id="user-001",
        learning_context=LearningContext(
            world_id="French World",
            target_language="fr",
            learner_level="B2",
        ),
        topics=("artificial intelligence", "European regulation"),
    )


def candidate(title: str, language: str, description: str) -> PodcastSearchResult:
    return PodcastSearchResult(
        provider=PodcastProviderName.APPLE,
        external_id=title,
        title=title,
        description=description,
        publisher="Demo Publisher",
        languages=(language,),
        url="https://example.com/podcast",
    )


def test_wrong_language_is_rejected() -> None:
    ranked = PodcastRecommendationService.rank_candidates(
        candidates=[
            candidate(
                "AI Europe English",
                "en",
                "artificial intelligence European regulation",
            ),
            candidate(
                "IA Europe FranÃ§ais",
                "fr",
                "artificial intelligence European regulation",
            ),
        ],
        intent=intent(),
    )

    assert len(ranked) == 1
    assert ranked[0][0].title == "IA Europe FranÃ§ais"


def test_preferences_rank_candidates_after_language_filter() -> None:
    ranked = PodcastRecommendationService.rank_candidates(
        candidates=[
            candidate("French Daily", "fr", "general culture"),
            candidate(
                "French AI Europe",
                "fr",
                "artificial intelligence and European regulation",
            ),
        ],
        intent=intent(),
    )

    assert ranked[0][0].title == "French AI Europe"


def test_unknown_language_is_rejected() -> None:
    ranked = PodcastRecommendationService.rank_candidates(
        candidates=[
            candidate(
                "Unknown",
                "unknown",
                "artificial intelligence",
            )
        ],
        intent=intent(),
    )

    assert ranked == []

import pytest

from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

from backend.api.main import app
from backend.api import routes


class FakeCompanionService:
    """
    Test double for the application service.

    This test deliberately does not invoke Parallel.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        character,
    ):
        self.character = character
        self.received_context = None
        self.received_use_research = None

    async def interact(
        self,
        context,
        use_research=False,
    ):
        self.received_context = context
        self.received_use_research = (
            use_research
        )

        return {
            "character": self.character.name,
            "conversation": {
                "character": self.character.name,
                "message": (
                    f"{self.character.name}: "
                    f"Test response"
                ),
                "intelligence_context": (
                    "TEST INTELLIGENCE"
                    if use_research
                    else None
                ),
            },
            "research": (
                {
                    "query": context.request,
                    "test": True,
                }
                if use_research
                else None
            ),
            "quality": {
                "quality_score": 1.0,
                "passed": True,
                "findings": [],
                "recommendations": [],
            },
            "memory_count": 0,
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_chat_passes_research_false(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    Verify /chat passes research=False
    to CompanionService.
    """

    captured = {}

    def fake_factory(
        character,
    ):
        service = FakeCompanionService(
            character
        )

        captured["service"] = service

        return service

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        routes,
        "create_companion_service",
        fake_factory,
    )

    transport = ASGITransport(
        app=app
    )

    async with AsyncClient(
        transport=transport,
        base_url="http://test",
    ) as client:

        response = await client.post(
            "/chat",
            json={
                "user_id": "api-test-user",
                "character": "yeti",
                "message": (
                    "Explain artificial intelligence"
                ),
                "research": False,
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()

    service = captured["service"]

    assert (
        service.received_use_research
        is False
    )

    assert (
        service.received_context.user_id
        == "api-test-user"
    )

    assert (
        service.received_context.request
        == "Explain artificial intelligence"
    )

    assert data["character"] == "Yeti"

    assert data["research"] is None

    assert (
        data["conversation"][
            "intelligence_context"
        ]
        is None
    )

    """

    captured = {}

    ) as client:

            json={
                "user_id": "api-test-user",
                "character": "yeti",
                "message": (
                    "What are the latest "

"""

The API endpoint must remain a thin transport boundary.

Architecture:

 |
 v

 |
 v

 v

from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.api.main import app

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilityType,
)


client = TestClient(app)


def test_podcast_discovery_endpoint_exists():
    """
    Verify that the Podcast Discovery endpoint exists.
    """

    response = client.post(
        "/capabilities/podcast/discover",
        json={
            "query": "French learning podcast",
            "target_language": "fr",
            "learner_level": "B2",
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code != 404


def test_podcast_discovery_endpoint_delegates_to_runtime_service():
    """
    Verify that the endpoint delegates execution to the
    ExternalRuntimeService boundary.
    """

    expected_result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="podcast-api-test-001",
        capability=CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
        output={
            "podcast": "French Podcast",
        },
    )

    service = Mock()

    service.execute = AsyncMock(
        return_value=expected_result,
    )

    with patch(
        "backend.api.routes.create_external_runtime_service",
        return_value=service,
    ):
        response = client.post(
            "/capabilities/podcast/discover",
            json={
                "query": "French learning podcast",
                "target_language": "fr",
                "learner_level": "B2",
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 200

    service.execute.assert_awaited_once()


def test_podcast_discovery_endpoint_rejects_missing_query():
    """
    Verify that missing query input is rejected.
    """

    response = client.post(
        "/capabilities/podcast/discover",
        json={
            "target_language": "fr",
            "learner_level": "B2",
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code in (
        400,
        422,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.app.api.privacy_governance import router
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCase,
    PrivacyTriggerType,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_composition import (
    create_privacy_governance_composition,
)


EXPECTED_READ_PATHS = {
    "/api/privacy/governance/summary",
    "/api/privacy/governance/status-chart",
    "/api/privacy/governance/cases",
    "/api/privacy/governance/cases/{case_id}",
}


EXPECTED_DECISION_PATHS = {
    "/api/privacy/governance/cases/{case_id}/approve",
    "/api/privacy/governance/cases/{case_id}/reject",
    "/api/privacy/governance/cases/{case_id}/request-changes",
}


EXPECTED_DEMO_PATHS = {
    "/api/privacy/governance/demo/create-case",
}


def make_app() -> FastAPI:
    """Create a minimal FastAPI application for API adapter tests."""

    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(router)

    return app


def router_paths() -> set[str]:
    """Return all concrete paths declared by the privacy governance router."""

    return {
        route.path
        for route in router.routes
        if getattr(route, "path", None)
    }


def router_get_paths() -> set[str]:
    """Return only GET paths declared by the privacy governance router."""

    return {
        route.path
        for route in router.routes
        if (
            getattr(route, "path", None)
            and "GET" in getattr(route, "methods", set())
        )
    }


def router_post_paths() -> set[str]:
    """Return only POST paths declared by the privacy governance router."""

    return {
        route.path
        for route in router.routes
        if (
            getattr(route, "path", None)
            and "POST" in getattr(route, "methods", set())
        )
    }


def test_api_router_exposes_four_read_endpoints():
    """
    Verify the privacy governance router declares exactly the four
    read-only GET endpoints.

    Decision and development/demo POST endpoints are intentionally excluded
    from this assertion because they are not read-only endpoints.
    """

    assert router_get_paths() == EXPECTED_READ_PATHS


def test_api_router_exposes_human_decision_endpoints():
    """Verify the explicit human governance decision endpoints exist."""

    post_paths = router_post_paths()

    assert EXPECTED_DECISION_PATHS.issubset(
        post_paths
    )


def test_api_router_exposes_controlled_demo_endpoint():
    """Verify the controlled Beta/demo endpoint exists."""

    post_paths = router_post_paths()

    assert EXPECTED_DEMO_PATHS.issubset(
        post_paths
    )


def test_api_router_is_registered_in_fastapi_application():
    """
    Verify the application contains the privacy governance router.

    The installed FastAPI version stores included routers internally,
    so registration is verified through the router's original_router
    reference when necessary.
    """

    app = make_app()

    included_router = next(
        (
            route
            for route in app.routes
            if getattr(route, "original_router", None) is router
        ),
        None,
    )

    assert included_router is not None


def test_composition_shares_registry_instances_with_dashboard_service():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    assert (
        composition.dashboard_service._cases
        is composition.case_registry
    )

    assert (
        composition.dashboard_service._approvals
        is composition.approval_registry
    )


def test_summary_and_chart_are_read_only_and_return_expected_shape():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    composition.case_registry.register(
        PrivacyGovernanceCase(
            case_id="CASE-001",
            title="New processing",
            summary="A controlled processing change.",
            trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
            triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            trigger_source="Processing Registry",
            governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        )
    )

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 1,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    assert composition.dashboard_service.status_chart() == (
        {
            "status": "Pending DPO/GRC",
            "count": 1,
        },
        {
            "status": "Approved",
            "count": 0,
        },
        {
            "status": "Rejected / Blocked",
            "count": 0,
        },
    )


def test_case_list_contains_stable_identifier_and_trigger():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    composition.case_registry.register(
        PrivacyGovernanceCase(
            case_id="CASE-002",
            title="Data mapping change",
            summary="A controlled data-map change.",
            trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.DATA_MAPPING_CHANGE,
            triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            trigger_source="Data Processing Map",
            risk="HIGH",
            validation_status="PASS",
            email_status="SENT",
        )
    )

    row = composition.dashboard_service.case_list()[0]

    assert row["case_id"] == "CASE-002"
    assert row["trigger_type"] == "DATA_MAPPING_CHANGE"
    assert row["validation_status"] == "PASS"
    assert row["email_status"] == "SENT"


def test_unknown_case_is_controlled():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    try:
        composition.dashboard_service.case_detail(
            "DOES-NOT-EXIST"
        )
    except KeyError as exc:
        assert "Governance case not found" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(
            "Unknown case did not raise KeyError"
        )

    app = make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases/DOES-NOT-EXIST"
    )

    assert response.status_code == 404

"""
API route tests.

These tests verify the HTTP/API boundary.

The tests deliberately replace the application service
with deterministic fakes so they never call:

- OpenAI
- Parallel
- external APIs
- real provider infrastructure

Architecture under test:

HTTP
|
v
API Route
|
v
CompanionService
|
v
Application Result
"""

import pytest

from httpx import (
    ASGITransport,
    AsyncClient,
)

from backend.api.main import (
    app,
)

from backend.api import (
    routes,
)


class FakeCompanionService:
    """
    Deterministic CompanionService test double.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        character,
    ) -> None:
        self.character = character
        self.received_context = None
        self.received_use_research = None

    async def interact(
        self,
        context,
        use_research=False,
    ):
        """
        Capture the application request and return
        a deterministic API result.
        """

        self.received_context = context

        self.received_use_research = (
            use_research
        )

        return {
            "character": self.character.name,

            "conversation": {
                "character": self.character.name,
                "message": (
                    f"{self.character.name}: "
                    "Test response"
                ),
                "intelligence_context": (
                    "TEST INTELLIGENCE"
                    if use_research
                    else None
                ),
            },

            "research": (
                {
                    "query": context.request,
                    "test": True,
                }
                if use_research
                else None
            ),

            "quality": {
                "quality_score": 1.0,
                "passed": True,
                "findings": [],
                "recommendations": [],
            },

            "memory_count": 0,
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_chat_passes_research_false(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    /chat should pass research=False to the
    CompanionService.
    """

    captured = {}

    def fake_factory(
        character,
    ):
        service = FakeCompanionService(
            character
        )

        captured["service"] = service

        return service

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        routes,
        "create_companion_service",
        fake_factory,
    )

    transport = ASGITransport(
        app=app
    )

    async with AsyncClient(
        transport=transport,
        base_url="http://test",
    ) as client:

        response = await client.post(
            "/chat",
            json={
                "user_id": "api-test-user",
                "character": "yeti",
                "message": (
                    "Explain artificial intelligence"
                ),
                "research": False,
            },
        )

    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()

    service = captured["service"]

    assert (
        service.received_use_research
        is False
    )

    assert (
        service.received_context.user_id
        == "api-test-user"
    )

    assert (
        service.received_context.request
        == "Explain artificial intelligence"
    )

    assert data["character"] == "Yeti"

    assert data["research"] is None

    assert (
        data["conversation"][
            "intelligence_context"
        ]
        is None
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_chat_passes_research_true(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    /chat should pass research=True to the
    CompanionService.
    """

    captured = {}

    def fake_factory(
        character,
    ):
        service = FakeCompanionService(
            character
        )

        captured["service"] = service

        return service

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        routes,
        "create_companion_service",
        fake_factory,
    )

    transport = ASGITransport(
        app=app
    )

    async with AsyncClient(

        == "TEST INTELLIGENCE"
    )

from backend.app.application.privacy.data_processing_map import (
    DataProcessingMap,
    DataProcessingMapEntry,
)


def test_data_processing_map_registers_entry():
    registry = DataProcessingMap()
    entry = DataProcessingMapEntry(
        map_id="MAP-001",
        processing_id="PA-001",
        source="Telegram",
        input_data=("conversation",),
        runtime_processing=("runtime",),
        pseudonymisation="hash",
        persistence=("event store",),
        destinations=("runtime",),
        third_country_transfer=False,
    )

    registry.add(entry)

    assert registry.get("PA-001") == entry
    assert registry.all() == (entry,)


def test_data_processing_map_rejects_duplicate_processing_id():
    entry = DataProcessingMapEntry(
        map_id="MAP-001",
        processing_id="PA-001",
        source="Telegram",
        input_data=("conversation",),
        runtime_processing=("runtime",),
        pseudonymisation="hash",
        persistence=("event store",),
        destinations=("runtime",),
        third_country_transfer=False,
    )
    registry = DataProcessingMap([entry])

    try:
        registry.add(entry)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert "already exists" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Duplicate processing map was accepted")

"""
Tests for the External Runtime application service.

The production service does not exist yet.

These tests define the required application-layer contract before
implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock

import pytest

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.gateway import (
    CapabilityGateway,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilityType,
)

from backend.services.external_runtime_service import (
    ExternalRuntimeService,
)


def make_request() -> CapabilityRequest:
    """
    Create a minimal external Runtime capability request.
    """

    return CapabilityRequest(
        capability=CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY,
        request_id="application-runtime-test-001",
        payload={
            "query": "French learning podcast",
        },
        requested_by="learning_application",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_external_runtime_service_delegates_to_gateway():
    """
    Verify that the application service delegates execution to
    the injected CapabilityGateway.
    """

    gateway = Mock(
        spec=CapabilityGateway,
    )

    expected_result = CapabilityResult(
        request_id="application-runtime-test-001",
        capability=CapabilityType.PODCAST_DISCOVERY,
        status=CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED,
        output={
            "ok": True,
        },
    )

    gateway.execute = AsyncMock(
        return_value=expected_result,
    )

    service = ExternalRuntimeService(
        gateway=gateway,
    )

    request = make_request()

    result = await service.execute(
        request,
    )

    assert result is expected_result

    gateway.execute.assert_awaited_once_with(
        request,
    )


def test_external_runtime_service_requires_gateway():
    """
    Verify that the application service rejects a missing gateway.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="CapabilityGateway cannot be None",
    ):
        ExternalRuntimeService(
            gateway=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_external_runtime_service_rejects_missing_request():
    """
    Verify that the application service rejects a missing request
    before attempting Runtime execution.
    """

    gateway = Mock(
        spec=CapabilityGateway,
    )

    gateway.execute = AsyncMock()

    service = ExternalRuntimeService(
        gateway=gateway,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="CapabilityRequest cannot be None",
    ):
        await service.execute(
            None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )

    gateway.execute.assert_not_awaited()

"""
Tests for LearningService.

Validates:

LearningService
        |
        v
CapabilityGateway
        |
        v
CapabilityRequest


This test verifies application orchestration only.

It does not test:

- Runtime executors;
- providers;
- persistence;
- LLM calls.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.services.learning_service import (
    LearningService,
)

from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
    CapabilityExecutionStatus,
    CapabilityType,
)


class FakeCapabilityGateway:
    """
    Fake Runtime gateway.

    Captures the capability request submitted
    by the application service.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.received_request = None

    async def execute(
        self,
        request,
    ):
        self.received_request = request

        from src.ai_runtime.capabilities.models import (
            CapabilityResult,
        )

        return CapabilityResult(
            request_id=request.request_id,
            capability=request.capability,
            status=(
                CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
            ),
            output={
                "flashcards": 3,
            },
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_learning_service_creates_flashcard_request():
    """
    LearningService should create a Runtime
    FLASHCARD_GENERATION request.
    """

    gateway = FakeCapabilityGateway()

    service = LearningService(
        capability_gateway=gateway,
    )

    result = await service.generate_flashcards(
        request_id="learning-test-001",
        topic="French vocabulary",
        learner_context=(
            "B2 learner preparing exams"
        ),
    )

    assert result.status == (
        CapabilityExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
    )

    assert gateway.received_request is not None

    assert gateway.received_request.capability == (
        CapabilityType.FLASHCARD_GENERATION
    )

    assert (
        gateway.received_request.payload["topic"]
        == "French vocabulary"
    )

    assert (
        gateway.received_request.payload[
            "learner_context"
        ]
        == "B2 learner preparing exams"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_learning_service_rejects_empty_topic():
    """
    Empty learning topics must fail validation.
    """

    gateway = FakeCapabilityGateway()

    service = LearningService(
        capability_gateway=gateway,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Topic cannot be empty",
    ):
        await service.generate_flashcards(
            request_id="learning-test-002",
            topic="",
        )


def test_learning_service_requires_gateway():
    """
    Gateway dependency is mandatory.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Capability gateway cannot be None",
    ):
        LearningService(
            capability_gateway=None,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.application.content_ingestion.ingestion_service import (
    AcademyContentIngestionService,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.models import (
    IngestionSourceType,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.source_detector import (
    ContentSourceDetector,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.text_normalizer import (
    ContentTextNormaliser,
)


def service():
    return AcademyContentIngestionService()


def test_detects_supported_file_types():
    detector = ContentSourceDetector()

    assert detector.detect("guide.pdf") == IngestionSourceType.PDF
    assert detector.detect("lesson.docx") == IngestionSourceType.DOCX
    assert detector.detect("slides.pptx") == IngestionSourceType.PPTX
    assert detector.detect("questions.xlsx") == IngestionSourceType.XLSX
    assert detector.detect("questions.csv") == IngestionSourceType.CSV
    assert detector.detect("notes.txt") == IngestionSourceType.TXT
    assert detector.detect("notes.md") == IngestionSourceType.MARKDOWN
    assert detector.detect("image.png") == IngestionSourceType.IMAGE
    assert detector.detect("bundle.zip") == IngestionSourceType.ZIP


def test_unknown_file_is_not_silently_classified():
    detector = ContentSourceDetector()

    assert detector.detect("something.bin") == IngestionSourceType.UNKNOWN


def test_pasted_text_is_first_class_source():
    detector = ContentSourceDetector()

    assert (
        detector.detect_pasted_text()
        == IngestionSourceType.PASTED_TEXT
    )


def test_ingests_unstructured_lecture_text():
    text = """
    GRCLecture: 130 - AUDIT FAILURE UNCOVERED A RETAIL CHAINS ACCESS CONTROL COLLAPSE

    Question 2 of 12

    An audit reveals that a retail companyâ€™s IAM system lacks automated alerts
    for abnormal access patterns.

    A Limit system access to business hours only
    B Require quarterly manual reviews of access logs
    C Increase the frequency of employee training sessions
    D Integrate real-time analytics and AI-driven alerts
    """

    result = service().ingest_text(
        text,
        source_id="lecture-130",
        name="GRCLecture 130",
        program_id="cgrc-prep",
    )

    assert result.source.source_type == IngestionSourceType.PASTED_TEXT
    assert result.source.program_id == "cgrc-prep"
    assert "Question 2 of 12" in result.normalised.text
    assert len(result.normalised.blocks) >= 2
    assert "A Limit system access" in result.normalised.text


def test_normalisation_is_loss_minimising():
    text = "A   question\r\n\r\n\r\nB   option"

    result = service().ingest_text(
        text,
        source_id="s1",
    )

    assert result.normalised.text == "A question\n\nB option"


def test_blocks_are_deterministic():
    normaliser = ContentTextNormaliser()

    text = "one\n\ntwo\n\nthree"

    assert normaliser.blocks(text) == (
        "one",
        "two",
        "three",
    )


def test_ingestion_is_deterministic():
    text = "Question\n\nA option\nB option"

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.application.content_ingestion.ingestion_service import (
    AcademyContentIngestionService,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.models import (
    ContentSourceDescriptor,
    IngestionSourceType,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.adapters.registry import (
    ContentExtractionAdapterRegistry,
)


def service():
    return AcademyContentIngestionService()


def descriptor(source_type, name):
    return ContentSourceDescriptor(
        source_id="source-1",
        name=name,
        source_type=source_type,
    )


def test_registry_contains_all_m4104_adapters():
    registry = ContentExtractionAdapterRegistry()

    supported = {
        adapter.supports(
            descriptor(source_type, f"file.{source_type.value}")
        )
        for adapter, source_type in [
            (registry.adapters()[0], IngestionSourceType.TXT),
        ]
    }

    assert supported == {True}

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.PDF, "guide.pdf")
    ) is not None

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.DOCX, "lesson.docx")
    ) is not None

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.PPTX, "slides.pptx")
    ) is not None

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.XLSX, "questions.xlsx")
    ) is not None

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.IMAGE, "image.png")
    ) is not None

    assert registry.adapter_for(
        descriptor(IngestionSourceType.ZIP, "bundle.zip")
    ) is not None

def test_zip_manifest_is_extracted(tmp_path: Path):

    path = tmp_path / "bundle.zip"

        archive.writestr("cgcr/guide.pdf", b"pdf")
        archive.writestr("questions.csv", "q,a")

    result = service().ingest_file(
        path,
        source_id="zip-1",
        program_id="cgrc-prep",
    )

    assert result.source.source_type == IngestionSourceType.ZIP
    assert result.normalised.blocks == (
        "cgcr/guide.pdf",
        "questions.csv",
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from app.application.content_ingestion.models import (
    IngestionSourceType,
    NormalisedContent,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.detector import (
    AcademyContentSemanticDetector,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.models import (
    DetectedContentType,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.service import (
    AcademyContentStructuringService,
)


def content(*blocks: str, source_id: str = "source-1"):
    return NormalisedContent(
        source_id=source_id,
        text="\n\n".join(blocks),
        blocks=tuple(blocks),
        source_type=IngestionSourceType.PASTED_TEXT,
    )


def test_detects_numbered_question():
    result = AcademyContentStructuringService().detect(
        content(
            "Question 2 of 12\n\n"
            "Which strategy should the CISO prioritize?\n\n"
            "A Limit access\n"
            "B Manual reviews\n"
            "C More training\n"
            "D Real-time analytics and AI-driven alerts"
        )
    )

    assert len(result.questions) == 1
    question = result.questions[0]
    assert question.question_text == (
        "Which strategy should the CISO prioritize?"
    )
    assert [option.option_id for option in question.options] == [
        "a", "b", "c", "d"
    ]


def test_detects_question_without_question_number():
    result = AcademyContentStructuringService().detect(
        content(
            "Which statement best describes effective learning?\n"
            "A Reading once\n"
            "B Regular practice with feedback\n"
            "C No review\n"
            "D Memorising everything"
        )
    )

    assert len(result.questions) == 1
    assert result.questions[0].question_text.endswith("learning?")


def test_preserves_all_detected_options():
    result = AcademyContentStructuringService().detect(
        content(
            "Question 1\n"
            "Which is best?\n"
            "A First\n"
            "B Second\n"
            "C Third\n"
            "D Fourth"
        )
    )

    assert len(result.questions[0].options) == 4
    assert [x.text for x in result.questions[0].options] == [
        "First",
        "Second",
        "Third",
        "Fourth",
    ]


def test_detection_does_not_infer_correct_answer():
    result = AcademyContentStructuringService().detect(
        content(
            "Question 1\n"
            "Which is best?\n"
            "A First\n"
            "B Second\n"
            "C Third\n"
            "D Fourth"
        )
    )

    assert not hasattr(result.questions[0], "correct_answer")


def test_detection_does_not_assign_certification_mapping():
    result = AcademyContentStructuringService().detect(
        content(
            "Question 1\n"
            "Which is best?\n"
            "A First\nB Second"
        )
    )

    assert not hasattr(result.questions[0], "certification")
    assert not hasattr(result.questions[0], "exam_domain")


def test_detection_does_not_assign_cefr():

        content(

            "Quelle est la bonne rÃ©ponse?\n"
            "A Une\nB Deux"
        )
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from app.application.content_ingestion.models import (
    IngestionSourceType,
    NormalisedContent,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.detector import (
    AcademyContentSemanticDetector,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.classification.classifier import (
    AcademyContentClassificationService,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.classification.models import (
    ClassificationAuthority,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.semantic.classification.review import (
    AcademyClassificationReviewService,
)


def block(text: str, index: int = 0, source_id: str = "source-1"):
    content = NormalisedContent(
        source_id=source_id,
        text=text,
        blocks=(text,),
        source_type=IngestionSourceType.PASTED_TEXT,
    )
    return AcademyContentSemanticDetector().detect(
        content.source_id,
        content.blocks,
    ).blocks[index]


def test_cgrc_content_gets_explicit_certification_mapping():
    result = AcademyContentClassificationService().classify(
        block(
            "GRCLecture: IAM access control risk management"
        )
    )

    mapping = result.certification_mapping

    assert mapping is not None
    assert mapping.certification == "ISC2 CGRC"


def test_risk_content_gets_risk_domain():
    result = AcademyContentClassificationService().classify(
        block(
            "Question about risk management and risk assessment"
        )
    )

    mapping = result.certification_mapping

    assert mapping is not None
    assert mapping.certification == "ISC2 CGRC"
    assert mapping.exam_domain == "Risk Management"
    assert mapping.sub_domain == "Risk Assessment"


def test_iam_content_gets_iam_topic():
    result = AcademyContentClassificationService().classify(
        block(
            "Question about IAM and access control"
        )
    )

    assert result.certification_mapping is not None
    assert (
        result.certification_mapping.topic
        == "IAM / Access Control"
    )


def test_audit_content_can_be_mapped_without_inventing_domain():
    result = AcademyContentClassificationService().classify(

            "GRCLecture audit failure and access control"
        )
    )

    assert result.certification_mapping.topic == "IAM / Access Control"

            "French Lesson: vocabulary review"
        )
    )

    mapping = result.language_mapping

    assert mapping is not None
    assert mapping.language == "French"
    assert mapping.skill == "Vocabulary"

    )

    assert result.review_required is True

def test_human_verification_changes_only_review_state():

    original = classifier.classify(
        block("Risk management")
    )

    verified = AcademyClassificationReviewService().verify(
        original
    )

    assert verified.authority == ClassificationAuthority.HUMAN_VERIFIED
    assert verified.review_required is False
    assert (
        verified.certification_mapping
        == original.certification_mapping
    )

def test_classification_is_deterministic():
    target = block("Risk management IAM")

    service = AcademyContentClassificationService()

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from app.application.content_ingestion.review.models import (
    ReviewDecision,
    ReviewItem,
    ReviewOption,
    ReviewStatus,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.review.service import (
    AcademyContentReviewService,
)


def item(
    *,
    review_id: str = "review-1",
    question: str | None = "Which option is correct?",
    options: tuple[ReviewOption, ...] = (
        ReviewOption("a", "First"),
        ReviewOption("b", "Second"),
        ReviewOption("c", "Third"),
        ReviewOption("d", "Fourth"),
    ),
) -> ReviewItem:
    return ReviewItem(
        review_id=review_id,
        content_id="content-1",
        source_id="lecture-130",
        source_text="Original source text",
        content_type="question",
        question_text=question,
        options=options,
        certification="ISC2 CGRC",
        exam_domain="Risk Management",
        sub_domain="Risk Assessment",
        topic="IAM / Access Control",
    )


def test_new_review_item_is_pending():
    assert item().status == ReviewStatus.PENDING


def test_submit_adds_item_to_pending_queue():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()

    submitted = service.submit(item())

    assert submitted.review_id == "review-1"
    assert service.pending() == (submitted,)


def test_source_text_is_preserved():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    submitted = service.submit(item())

    assert submitted.source_text == "Original source text"


def test_all_options_are_visible_to_reviewer():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    submitted = service.submit(item())

    assert len(submitted.options) == 4
    assert [option.text for option in submitted.options] == [
        "First",
        "Second",
        "Third",
        "Fourth",
    ]


def test_correct_answer_is_not_required_before_review():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    submitted = service.submit(item())

    assert all(
        option.is_correct is None
        for option in submitted.options
    )


def test_approve_requires_exactly_one_correct_answer():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    service.submit(item())

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="exactly one correct option"):
        service.review(
            "review-1",
            decision=ReviewDecision.APPROVE,
            reviewer_id="admin-1",
        )


def test_reviewer_can_set_authoritative_correct_answer_on_approval():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    service.submit(item())

    options = (
        ReviewOption("a", "First", False, "Not sufficient."),
        ReviewOption("b", "Second", True, "Correct because it meets the requirement."),
        ReviewOption("c", "Third", False, "Does not address the control."),
        ReviewOption("d", "Fourth", False, "Not the best strategy."),
    )

    result = service.review(
        "review-1",
        decision=ReviewDecision.APPROVE,
        reviewer_id="admin-1",
        options=options,
    )

    assert result.status == ReviewStatus.APPROVED
    assert result.reviewer_id == "admin-1"


def test_rejected_item_leaves_pending_queue():
    service = AcademyContentReviewService()
    service.submit(item())

    result = service.review(
        "review-1",
        decision=ReviewDecision.REJECT,
        reviewer_id="admin-1",
        reviewer_note="Source is not sufficiently reliable.",
    )

    assert result.status == ReviewStatus.REJECTED
    assert service.pending() == ()

    service.review(
        "review-1",
        decision=ReviewDecision.REJECT,

    )

    )

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.application.content_ingestion.review.admin_api import (
    create_admin_review_router,
)

    ReviewItem,
    ReviewOption,
)

    AcademyContentReviewQueue,
)
from fastapi import FastAPI


def build_client():
    queue = AcademyContentReviewQueue()
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(create_admin_review_router(queue))

    queue.submit(
        ReviewItem(
            review_id="review-1",
            content_id="content-1",
            source_id="lecture-130",
            source_text="Original source",
            content_type="question",
            question_text="Which strategy should be prioritised?",
            options=(
                ReviewOption("a", "Business hours"),
                ReviewOption("b", "Manual reviews"),
                ReviewOption("c", "Training"),
                ReviewOption("d", "Real-time analytics"),
            ),
            certification="ISC2 CGRC",
            exam_domain="Risk Management",
            sub_domain="Risk Assessment",
            topic="IAM / Access Control",
        )
    )

    return TestClient(app)


def test_pending_endpoint_returns_review_item():
    client = build_client()
    response = client.get("/api/admin/content-review/pending")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert len(response.json()["items"]) == 1
    assert response.json()["items"][0]["review_id"] == "review-1"

    assert response.status_code == 200
    payload = response.json()

    assert payload["source_text"] == "Original source"
    assert len(payload["options"]) == 4
    assert payload["certification"] == "ISC2 CGRC"

    response = client.get("/api/admin/content-review/not-found")

    assert response.status_code == 404

    )

    assert response.status_code == 200

    assert payload["topic"] == "Access Control"
    assert payload["difficulty"] == "Intermediate"


def test_approval_requires_exactly_one_correct_option():

        "/api/admin/content-review/review-1/decision",
        json={
            "reviewer_id": "admin-1",

        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from app.application.content_ingestion.publishing.models import (
    PublicationStatus,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.publishing.repository import (
    ApprovedContentRepository,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.publishing.service import (
    ApprovedContentPublishingService,
)
from app.application.content_ingestion.review.models import (
    ReviewItem,
    ReviewOption,
    ReviewStatus,
)


def approved_review(
    review_id: str = "review-1",
) -> ReviewItem:
    return ReviewItem(
        review_id=review_id,
        content_id="source-content",
        source_id="lecture-130",
        source_text="Original source",
        content_type="question",
        question_text="Which strategy should be prioritised?",
        options=(
            ReviewOption(
                "a",
                "Business hours",
                False,
                "Too restrictive.",
            ),
            ReviewOption(
                "b",
                "Manual reviews",
                False,
                "Reactive only.",
            ),
            ReviewOption(
                "c",
                "Training",
                False,
                "Does not address detection.",
            ),
            ReviewOption(
                "d",
                "Real-time analytics",
                True,
                "Provides detection.",
            ),
        ),
        certification="ISC2 CGRC",
        exam_domain="Risk Management",
        sub_domain="Risk Assessment",
        topic="IAM / Access Control",
        difficulty="Intermediate",
        status=ReviewStatus.APPROVED,
    )


def test_approved_review_becomes_version_one():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    item = service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review(),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    assert item.version == 1
    assert item.status == PublicationStatus.APPROVED
    assert item.source_review_id == "review-1"
    assert len(item.options) == 4
    assert sum(
        option.is_correct
        for option in item.options
    ) == 1


def test_unapproved_review_cannot_cross_boundary():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    review = approved_review()

    review = ReviewItem(
        **{
            **review.__dict__,
            "status": ReviewStatus.REJECTED,
        }
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="only approved",
    ):
        service.approve_to_content(
            review,
            content_id="q-130",
        )


def test_publish_requires_approved_content():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        service.publish("missing")


def test_publish_changes_status():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review(),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    item = service.publish("q-130")

    assert item.status == PublicationStatus.PUBLISHED


def test_second_approval_creates_new_version():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    first = service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review("review-1"),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    second = service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review("review-2"),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    assert first.version == 1
    assert second.version == 2


def test_repository_keeps_versions():
    repository = ApprovedContentRepository()
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService(repository)

    service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review("review-1"),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review("review-2"),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    versions = repository.versions("q-130")

    assert [
        item.version
        for item in versions
    ] == [1, 2]


def test_exactly_one_correct_answer_is_required():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    review = approved_review()

    invalid = ReviewItem(
        **{
            **review.__dict__,
            "options": tuple(
                ReviewOption(
                    option.option_id,
                    option.text,
                    False,
                    option.rationale,
                )
                for option in review.options
            ),
        }
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="exactly one",
    ):
        service.approve_to_content(
            invalid,
            content_id="q-130",
        )


def test_certification_mapping_is_preserved():
    service = ApprovedContentPublishingService()

    item = service.approve_to_content(
        approved_review(),
        content_id="q-130",
    )

    assert item.certification == "ISC2 CGRC"
    assert item.exam_domain == "Risk Management"
    assert item.sub_domain == "Risk Assessment"
    assert item.topic == "IAM / Access Control"
    assert item.difficulty == "Intermediate"

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api.questionnaires.api import QuestionnaireRuntime, create_app


def client(tmp_path: Path) -> TestClient:
    return TestClient(
        create_app(QuestionnaireRuntime(tmp_path / "m4113.sqlite3"))
    )


def test_demo_questionnaire_is_api_backed(tmp_path: Path):
    api = client(tmp_path)

    response = api.get(
        "/api/academy/questionnaires/demo-questionnaire?mode=practice"
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    payload = response.json()
    assert payload["questionnaire_id"] == "demo-questionnaire"
    assert len(payload["questions"]) == 3


def test_completion_returns_real_result_id_and_result_is_readable(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    api = client(tmp_path)

    completion = api.post(
        "/api/academy/questionnaires/demo-questionnaire/complete",
        params={"user_id": "m4113-user", "mode": "practice"},
        json={
            "answers": [
                {"question_id": "demo-q1", "option_id": "a"},
                {"question_id": "demo-q2", "option_id": "a"},
                {"question_id": "demo-q3", "option_id": "a"},
            ]
        },
    )

    assert completion.status_code == 200

    result_id = completion.json()["result_id"]

    assert result_id
    assert result_id != "demo-result"

    result = api.get(
        f"/api/academy/questionnaire-results/{result_id}"
    )

    assert result.status_code == 200

    payload = result.json()

    assert payload["header"]["result_id"] == result_id
    assert payload["performance_summary"]["total_questions"] == 3
    assert payload["performance_summary"]["correct_answers"] == 3
    assert payload["performance_summary"]["score_percentage"] == 100.0


def test_unknown_result_is_not_available(tmp_path: Path):
    api = client(tmp_path)

    response = api.get(
        "/api/academy/questionnaire-results/demo-result"
    )

    assert response.status_code == 404

    return MemoryApprovalService(
        memory_policy=MemoryPolicy(),
    )



def create_candidate(
    *,
    category: str = "grammar_mistake",
    observation: str = (
        "Learner confuses French past tense structures."
    ),
) -> MemoryCandidate:


    return MemoryCandidate(

        candidate_id="candidate-001",

        learner_hash="learner-hash-001",

        category=category,

        observation=observation,

        confidence=0.85,

        evidence_event_ids=[
            "conversation-event-001"
        ],

        metadata={
            "created_by": "test",
        },

        created_at=datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ),

    )



def test_memory_approval_approves_valid_learning_memory():

    service = create_service()


    candidate = create_candidate()


    decision = service.approve(
        candidate
    )


    assert decision["status"] == "approved"


    assert (
        decision["category"]
        ==
        "grammar_mistake"
    )

    service = create_service()

        observation=(

        ),

    )


    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        service.approve(
            candidate
        )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        service.reject(

        )

    candidate = create_candidate()

    )

class FakeSender:

        self.requests = []

def make_change():

        change_id="PCR-EMAIL-001",
        title="Add new learner analytics",

def test_email_escalation_requires_human_approval():
    sender = FakeSender()
    service = PrivacyApprovalEmailService(
        sender=sender,
        approval_recipient="configured-reviewer@example.test",
    )

    request = service.escalate(
        make_change(),
        validation_passed=True,
    )

    assert request.recipient == "configured-reviewer@example.test"
    assert request.change_id == "PCR-EMAIL-001"
    assert request.requires_dpo_approval is True
    assert request.requires_grc_approval is True
    assert len(sender.requests) == 1
    assert "does not itself constitute approval" in request.body


def test_email_escalation_refuses_failed_validation():
    sender = FakeSender()
    service = PrivacyApprovalEmailService(
        sender=sender,
        approval_recipient="configured-reviewer@example.test",
    )

    try:
        service.escalate(make_change(), validation_passed=False)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert "validation" in str(exc).lower()
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Escalation was allowed despite failed validation")

    assert sender.requests == []

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change_detector import (
    PrivacyChangeDetector,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change_assessment import (
    PrivacyChangeAssessmentService,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change_registry import (
    PrivacyChangeRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_gate import (
    PrivacyGovernanceGate,
)


def make_change(**kwargs):
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-001",
        title="Add analytics",
        description="Add learning analytics processing.",
        **kwargs,
    )


def test_detector_identifies_new_processing():
    result = PrivacyChangeDetector().detect(
        {"new_processing_activity": True}
    )
    assert result.privacy_impacting is True
    assert "new processing activity" in result.reasons


def test_detector_allows_non_privacy_technical_change():
    result = PrivacyChangeDetector().detect(
        {"code_refactor_only": True}
    )
    assert result.privacy_impacting is False


def test_assessment_routes_material_change_to_dpo_and_grc():
    change = make_change(purpose_changed=True)
    detection = PrivacyChangeDetector().detect(
        {"purpose_changed": True}
    )
    assessment = PrivacyChangeAssessmentService().assess(change, detection)
    assert assessment.risk == PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM
    assert assessment.dpo_required is True
    assert assessment.grc_required is True
    assert assessment.dpia_screening_required is False


def test_high_risk_change_requires_dpia_screening():
    change = make_change(
        processor_changed=True,
        transfer_changed=True,
    )
    detection = PrivacyChangeDetector().detect(
        {
            "processor_changed": True,
            "transfer_changed": True,
        }
    )
    assessment = PrivacyChangeAssessmentService().assess(change, detection)
    assert assessment.risk == PrivacyChangeRisk.HIGH
    assert assessment.dpia_screening_required is True


def test_gate_blocks_until_dpo_and_grc_approve():
    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(registry=registry)
    change = make_change(
        purpose_changed=True,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    pending = gate.route(
        change,
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )
    assert pending.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    assert gate.can_proceed("PCR-001") is False

    approved = gate.route(
        pending,
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        dpo_approved=True,
        grc_approved=True,
    )
    assert approved.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    assert gate.can_proceed("PCR-001") is True


def test_gate_blocks_failed_automated_validation():
    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(registry=registry)
    change = make_change()

    blocked = gate.route(
        change,
        automated_validation_passed=False,
    )
    assert blocked.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    assert gate.can_proceed("PCR-001") is False

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_composition import (
    create_privacy_governance_composition,
)


def make_change(change_id: str) -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id=change_id,
        title="6G lifecycle test",
        description="Human decision lifecycle test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def test_dpo_then_grc_reaches_approved_with_two_records() -> None:
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change("PCR-6G-LIFE-001"),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-001",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    assert result.case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-001",
        change_id="PCR-6G-LIFE-001",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-6G-LIFE-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO approved.",
    )

    assert (
        composition.case_registry.get(
            "CASE-6G-LIFE-001"
        ).governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-001",
        change_id="PCR-6G-LIFE-001",
        approval_id="APR-GRC-6G-LIFE-001",
        reviewer="GRC Reviewer",
        role="GRC",
        comment="GRC approved.",
    )

    case = composition.case_registry.get("CASE-6G-LIFE-001")
    change = composition.change_registry.get("PCR-6G-LIFE-001")

    assert case.governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision == "APPROVED"
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    assert len(
        composition.approval_registry.for_case(
            "CASE-6G-LIFE-001"
        )
    ) == 2


def test_rejection_reaches_blocked() -> None:
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change("PCR-6G-LIFE-002"),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-002",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    record = composition.case_service.reject(
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-002",
        change_id="PCR-6G-LIFE-002",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-6G-LIFE-002",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="Privacy evidence is insufficient.",
    )

    case = composition.case_registry.get("CASE-6G-LIFE-002")
    change = composition.change_registry.get("PCR-6G-LIFE-002")

    assert record.decision.value == "REJECTED"
    assert case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert case.final_decision == "REJECTED"
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED


def test_request_changes_reaches_blocked() -> None:
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change("PCR-6G-LIFE-003"),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-003",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    record = composition.case_service.request_changes(
        case_id="CASE-6G-LIFE-003",
        change_id="PCR-6G-LIFE-003",
        approval_id="APR-GRC-6G-LIFE-003",
        reviewer="GRC Reviewer",
        role="GRC",
        comment="Additional controls required.",
    )

    case = composition.case_registry.get("CASE-6G-LIFE-003")

    assert record.decision.value == "REQUEST_CHANGES"
    assert case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert case.final_decision == "REQUEST_CHANGES"

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import load_workbook

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_excel_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync,
)


def test_excel_projection_contains_authoritative_case_and_approval_evidence(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    # This is a focused adapter-level smoke test for the final projection.
    # Full API lifecycle tests are in tests/api.
    workbook_path = tmp_path / "tracker.xlsx"

    sync = PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=workbook_path
    )

    assert not workbook_path.exists()

    # Empty registries are a valid initial projection.
    class EmptyCases:
        @staticmethod
        def all():
            return ()

    class EmptyApprovals:
        @staticmethod
        def for_case(case_id):
            return ()

    sync.sync_all(
        case_registry=EmptyCases(),
        approval_registry=EmptyApprovals(),
    )

    assert workbook_path.exists()

    workbook = load_workbook(workbook_path)

    assert "Privacy Governance Cases" in workbook.sheetnames
    assert "Approval Evidence" in workbook.sheetnames
    assert "Governance Dashboard" in workbook.sheetnames

class FakeReminderSender:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = []

    async def send(
        self,
        *,
        recipient: str,
        subject: str,
        body: str,
        html_body: str,
        attachments=None,
    ):
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "recipient": recipient,
                "subject": subject,
                "body": body,
                "html_body": html_body,
                "attachments": attachments,
            }
        )

        return {
            "provider": "fake",
            "status": "accepted",
            "reference": "fake-message-id",
        }


def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-E2E-001",
        title="Beta 1 Privacy Governance Email Test",
        description=(
            "Controlled end-to-end test of the "
            "privacy governance cascade."
        ),
        affected_processing_ids=[],
        affected_data_map_ids=[],
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.DRAFT,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
        metadata={
            "test_type": "controlled_e2e",
        },
    )


def test_pcr_to_case_identity_is_preserved():
    """
    The Privacy Change Registry identity must be preserved when
    the governance case is created.

    Expected:

        PCR-E2E-001
            ↓
        CASE-E2E-001
    """

    change_registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    case_registry = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry()
    approval_registry = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()

    decision_service = PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService(
        case_registry=case_registry,
        change_registry=change_registry,
        approval_registry=approval_registry,
    )

    case_service = PrivacyGovernanceCaseService(
        case_registry=case_registry,
        change_registry=change_registry,
        approval_registry=approval_registry,
        decision_service=decision_service,
    )

    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(
        registry=change_registry,
    )

    flow = PrivacyGovernanceFlowService(
        change_registry=change_registry,
        governance_gate=gate,
        case_service=case_service,
    )

    result = flow.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-E2E-001",
        trigger_source="Controlled E2E Test",
    )

    assert result.change.change_id == (
        "PCR-E2E-001"
    )

    assert result.case.case_id == (
        "CASE-E2E-001"
    )

    assert result.case.change_id == (
        "PCR-E2E-001"
    )

    assert result.case.validation_status == (
        "PASS"
    )

    assert result.case.governance_status == (
        "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )


def test_case_url_builder_uses_authoritative_case_id():
    """
    The frontend URL must be derived from the authoritative
    governance CASE ID, never reconstructed from the PCR ID.
    """

    builder = PrivacyGovernanceCaseURLBuilder(
        app_base_url="http://127.0.0.1:5173",
    )

    url = builder.build(
        "CASE-E2E-001"
    )

    assert url == (
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173/"
        "privacy-governance/CASE-E2E-001"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_privacy_reminder_preserves_case_and_change_identity():
    """
    The reminder must preserve the complete audit cascade:

        PCR-E2E-001
             ↓
        CASE-E2E-001
             ↓
        Reminder
             ↓
        REVIEW THIS CASE
             ↓
        /privacy-governance/CASE-E2E-001
    """

    reminder_sender = FakeReminderSender()

    builder = PrivacyGovernanceCaseURLBuilder(
        app_base_url="http://127.0.0.1:5173",
    )

    from backend.app.application.privacy.email.privacy_governance_reminder_email_service import (
        PrivacyGovernanceReminderEmailService,
    )

    logo_path = Path(
        "backend/app/application/privacy/email/assets/"
        "easychatbot_logo.png"
    )

    service = PrivacyGovernanceReminderEmailService(
        sender=reminder_sender,
        recipient="reviewer@example.test",
        case_url_builder=builder,
        logo_path=logo_path,
    )

    case = type(
        "Case",
        (),
        {
            "case_id": "CASE-E2E-001",
            "change_id": "PCR-E2E-001",
            "title": "Beta 1 Privacy Governance Email Test",
            "summary": (
                "Controlled end-to-end test of the "
                "privacy governance cascade."
            ),
            "risk": "medium",
            "validation_status": "PASS",
            "governance_status": "PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        },
    )()

    result = await service.send_governance_reminder(
        case=case,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative identity
    #
    # The reminder service consumes the authoritative CASE
    # object. Its response does not need to duplicate these
    # identity fields.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert case.change_id == (
        "PCR-E2E-001"
    )

    assert case.case_id == (
        "CASE-E2E-001"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Controlled destination
    #
    # The URL must always be derived from CASE-E2E-001.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    expected_url = (
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173/"
        "privacy-governance/CASE-E2E-001"
    )

    assert result["case_url"] == expected_url

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Delivery
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert result["status"] == (
        "accepted"
    )

    assert result["reference"] == (
        "fake-message-id"
    )

    assert len(reminder_sender.calls) == 1

    email = reminder_sender.calls[0]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Subject identity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        "CASE-E2E-001"
        in email["subject"]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Plain-text identity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        "PCR-E2E-001"
        in email["body"]
    )

    assert (
        "CASE-E2E-001"
        in email["body"]
    )

    assert expected_url in email["body"]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # HTML identity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        "PCR-E2E-001"
        in email["html_body"]
    )

    assert (
        "CASE-E2E-001"
        in email["html_body"]
    )

    assert (
        "REVIEW THIS CASE"
        in email["html_body"]
    )

    assert expected_url in email["html_body"]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Inline logo contract
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    attachments = email["attachments"]

    assert isinstance(
        attachments,
        list,
    )

    assert len(attachments) == 1

    attachment = attachments[0]

    assert attachment["filename"] == (
        "easychatbot_logo.png"
    )

    assert attachment["content_id"] == (
        "easychatbot-governance-logo"
    )

    assert attachment["inline"] is True

    assert attachment["path"] == str(
        logo_path
    )

import pytest

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (

def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-LINK-001",
        title="New learner processing",
        description="Controlled processing change.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.HIGH,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def make_case(
    *,
    change_id: str | None = "PCR-LINK-001",
) -> PrivacyGovernanceCase:
    return PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="CASE-LINK-001",
        title="New learner processing",
        summary="Controlled processing change.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        change_id=change_id,
        risk="HIGH",
        validation_status="PASS",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
    )


def make_service(
    case: PrivacyGovernanceCase | None = None,
):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry()

    cases.register(
        case or make_case()
    )

    changes = PrivacyChangeRegistry()

    changes.register(
        make_change()
    )

    return PrivacyGovernanceCaseChangeLinkService(
        case_registry=cases,
        change_registry=changes,
    )


def test_case_resolves_to_authoritative_change():
    service = make_service()

    link = service.get_link(
        "CASE-LINK-001"
    )

    assert link.case.case_id == "CASE-LINK-001"

    assert (
        link.case.change_id
        == "PCR-LINK-001"
    )

    assert (
        link.change.change_id
        == "PCR-LINK-001"
    )

    assert (
        link.change.title
        == "New learner processing"
    )

    assert (
        link.change.risk
        == PrivacyChangeRisk.HIGH
    )

    assert (
        link.change.status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )


def test_get_change_for_case_returns_registry_object():
    service = make_service()

    change = service.get_change_for_case(
        "CASE-LINK-001"
    )

    assert (
        change.change_id
        == "PCR-LINK-001"
    )


def test_missing_change_relationship_is_controlled():
    service = make_service(
        make_case(change_id=None)
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="no change_id relationship",
    ):
        service.get_link(
            "CASE-LINK-001"
        )


def test_missing_change_is_controlled():
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry()

    cases.register(
        make_case()
    )

    changes = PrivacyChangeRegistry()

    service = PrivacyGovernanceCaseChangeLinkService(
        case_registry=cases,
        change_registry=changes,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        KeyError,
        match="Privacy change not found",
    ):
        service.get_link(
            "CASE-LINK-001"
        )


def test_list_links_preserves_one_to_one_case_change_traceability():
    service = make_service()

    links = service.list_links()

    assert len(links) == 1

    assert (
        links[0].case.case_id
        == "CASE-LINK-001"
    )

    assert (
        links[0].case.change_id
        == "PCR-LINK-001"
    )

    assert (
        links[0].change.change_id
        == "PCR-LINK-001"
    )


def test_link_service_is_read_only():
    service = make_service()

    before = (
        service
        .get_change_for_case(
            "CASE-LINK-001"
        )
        .status
    )

    _ = service.get_link(
        "CASE-LINK-001"
    )

    after = (
        service
        .get_change_for_case(
            "CASE-LINK-001"
        )
        .status
    )

    assert after == before

        description="Case service integration test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def make_case() -> PrivacyGovernanceCase:
    return PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        title="Controlled privacy case",
        summary="Case service integration test.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",

        # Authoritative case â†’ privacy change relationship.
        # This is required by PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService
        # before any DPO/GRC decision can be recorded.
        change_id="PCR-CASE-001",

        risk="MEDIUM",
        validation_status="PASS",
        email_status="SENT",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
    )


def make_service():
    changes = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    changes.register(make_change())

    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry(
        [make_case()]
    )

    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()

    decision_service = PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService(
        approval_registry=approvals,
        change_registry=changes,
        case_registry=cases,
    )

    service = PrivacyGovernanceCaseService(
        case_registry=cases,
        change_registry=changes,
        approval_registry=approvals,
        decision_service=decision_service,
    )

    return (
        service,
        changes,
        cases,
        approvals,
    )


def test_get_case_returns_case_by_identifier():
    service, _, _, _ = make_service()

    assert case.case_id == "CASE-001"
    assert case.title == "Controlled privacy case"
    assert case.change_id == "PCR-CASE-001"

    assert cases[0].case_id == "CASE-001"
    assert cases[0].change_id == "PCR-CASE-001"

def test_approve_delegates_to_decision_service():
    service, changes, cases, approvals = make_service()

    record = service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-CASE-001",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO review completed.",
    )

    assert record.decision == ApprovalDecision.APPROVED
    assert record.case_id == "CASE-001"
    assert record.change_id == "PCR-CASE-001"

    assert len(
        approvals.for_case("CASE-001")
    ) == 1

    # One approval is not sufficient because GRC is also required.
    assert (
        cases.get("CASE-001").governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    assert (
        changes.get("PCR-CASE-001").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )


def test_two_required_approvals_move_case_to_approved():
    service, changes, cases, approvals = make_service()

    service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-CASE-001",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO approved.",
    )

    service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-CASE-001",
        approval_id="APR-GRC-001",
        reviewer="GRC Reviewer",
        role="GRC",
        comment="GRC approved.",
    )

    case = cases.get("CASE-001")
    change = changes.get("PCR-CASE-001")

    assert case.governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None

    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED

    assert len(
        approvals.for_case("CASE-001")
    ) == 2


def test_reject_blocks_case():
    service, changes, cases, approvals = make_service()

    record = service.reject(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-CASE-001",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-001",

    assert record.decision == ApprovalDecision.REJECTED

    assert case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert case.final_decision == "REJECTED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None

    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    assert len(
        approvals.for_case("CASE-001")
    ) == 1

    service, changes, cases, approvals = make_service()

    record = service.request_changes(

        == "REQUEST_CHANGES"

        changes.get("PCR-CASE-001").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    )

    assert len(
        approvals.for_case("CASE-001")
    ) == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (

)

)


def test_all_governance_application_services_share_the_same_registries():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    assert composition.governance_gate._registry is composition.change_registry
    assert composition.case_service._cases is composition.case_registry
    assert composition.case_service._changes is composition.change_registry
    assert composition.case_service._approvals is composition.approval_registry
    assert composition.dashboard_service._cases is composition.case_registry
    assert composition.dashboard_service._approvals is composition.approval_registry
    assert composition.flow_service._changes is composition.change_registry
    assert composition.flow_service._gate is composition.governance_gate
    assert composition.flow_service._cases is composition.case_service


def test_shared_flow_state_is_visible_without_recreating_the_composition():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    change = PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-SHARED-001",
        title="Shared state test",
        description="Shared registry integration test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.LOW,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        change,
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

    assert composition.case_service.get_case(
        result.case.case_id
    ) is composition.case_registry.get(
        result.case.case_id
    )

    assert composition.dashboard_service.case_list()[0]["case_id"] == result.case.case_id

def test_dashboard_exposes_clickable_case_identifier_and_trigger():
    case = PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="PCR-001",
        title="New data mapping",
        summary="A new learner data mapping was registered.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.DATA_MAPPING_CHANGE,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Data Processing Map",
        risk="HIGH",
        validation_status="PASS",
        email_status="SENT",
    )

    service = PrivacyGovernanceDashboardService(

        approval_registry=PrivacyApprovalRegistry(),

    row = service.case_list()[0]
    detail = service.case_detail("PCR-001")

    assert row["trigger_type"] == "DATA_MAPPING_CHANGE"

def test_dashboard_status_chart_contains_governance_status_counts():
    pending = PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="PCR-PENDING",
        title="Pending case",
        summary="Pending review.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
    )
    approved = PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="PCR-APPROVED",
        title="Approved case",
        summary="Approved.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        governance_status="APPROVED",
    )
    blocked = PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="PCR-BLOCKED",
        title="Blocked case",
        summary="Rejected.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        governance_status="BLOCKED",
    )

    service = PrivacyGovernanceDashboardService(
        case_registry=PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry(
            [pending, approved, blocked]
        ),
        approval_registry=PrivacyApprovalRegistry(),
    )

    assert service.status_chart() == (
        {"status": "Pending DPO/GRC", "count": 1},
        {"status": "Approved", "count": 1},
        {"status": "Rejected / Blocked", "count": 1},
    )

def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:

        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,

        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        # Governance integrity link:
        # this case explicitly owns PCR-001.
        change_id="PCR-001",

def make_change_registry() -> PrivacyChangeRegistry:
    """Build the existing application registry using its real contract."""

    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    registry.register(make_change())

    return registry

    PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService,
    PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry,

        [make_case()]
    )
