def test_two_explicit_approvals_move_case_to_approved() -> None:
    service, cases, changes = make_service()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # DPO approval
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    service.record_decision(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-001",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO",
        role="DPO",
        decision=ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
        comment="Reviewed.",
    )

    # One required approval is not sufficient.
    assert (
        cases.get(
            "CASE-001"
        ).governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    assert (
        changes.get(
            "PCR-001"
        ).status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # GRC approval
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    service.record_decision(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        change_id="PCR-001",
        approval_id="APR-GRC-001",
        reviewer="GRC",
        role="GRC",
        decision=ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
        comment="Reviewed.",
    )

    # Both required human approvals are now recorded.
    assert (
        cases.get(
            "CASE-001"
        ).governance_status
        == "APPROVED"
    )

    assert (
        cases.get(
            "CASE-001"
        ).final_decision
        == "APPROVED"
    )

    assert (
        cases.get(
            "CASE-001"
        ).final_decision_at
        is not None
    )

    assert (
        changes.get(
            "PCR-001"
        ).status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    )


def test_rejection_blocks_case() -> None:
    service, cases, changes = make_service()

    service.record_decision(

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import load_workbook

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_record import (
    ApprovalDecision,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_composition import (
    create_privacy_governance_composition,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_excel_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_runtime_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync,
)


def read_sheet_rows(
    workbook_path: Path,
    sheet_name: str,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    workbook = load_workbook(workbook_path)

    worksheet = workbook[sheet_name]

    rows = list(
        worksheet.iter_rows(
            values_only=True
        )
    )

    if not rows:
        return []

    headers = rows[0]

    return [
        dict(zip(headers, row))
        for row in rows[1:]
    ]


def read_dashboard(
    workbook_path: Path,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    workbook = load_workbook(workbook_path)

    worksheet = workbook[
        "Governance Dashboard"
    ]

    return {
        worksheet[f"A{row}"].value:
        worksheet[f"B{row}"].value
        for row in range(
            2,
            worksheet.max_row + 1,
        )
    }


def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-6H-E2E-001",
        title="6H Full Lifecycle Processing",
        description=(
            "End-to-end privacy governance Excel "
            "integration test."
        ),
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def test_full_approved_lifecycle_projects_to_excel(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    """
    Prove the complete 6H lifecycle:

        NEW_PROCESSING
            â†“
        Validation PASS
            â†“
        Governance Case
            â†“
        PENDING_DPO_GRC
            â†“
        DPO approval
            â†“
        GRC approval
            â†“
        APPROVED
            â†“
        Excel evidence

    The application registries remain authoritative.
    Excel is only a downstream evidence projection.
    """

    composition = (
        create_privacy_governance_composition()
    )

    workbook_path = (
        tmp_path
        / "privacy_governance_tracker.xlsx"
    )

    excel_sync = PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=workbook_path,
    )

    runtime_sync = PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync(
        case_service=composition.case_service,
        excel_sync=excel_sync,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Real NEW_PROCESSING enters the governance flow.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    result = (
        composition.flow_service
        .process_new_processing(
            make_change(),
            automated_validation_passed=True,
            case_id="CASE-6H-E2E-001",
            trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        )
    )

    assert (
        result.case.case_id

def test_rejection_lifecycle_projects_blocked_to_excel(
    tmp_path: Path,
):
    """
    Prove:

        Validation PASS
            â†“
        PENDING_DPO_GRC
            â†“
        Human rejection
            â†“
        BLOCKED
            â†“
        Excel evidence
    """

    composition = (
        create_privacy_governance_composition()
    )

    workbook_path = (
        tmp_path
        / "privacy_governance_rejection.xlsx"
    )

    excel_sync = PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=workbook_path,
    )

    runtime_sync = PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync(
        case_service=composition.case_service,
        excel_sync=excel_sync,
    )

    result = (
        composition.flow_service
        .process_new_processing(
            PrivacyChange(
                change_id="PCR-6H-E2E-REJECT-001",
                title="Rejected processing",
                description=(
                    "6H rejection lifecycle."
                ),
                risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
                dpo_required=True,
                grc_required=True,
            ),
            automated_validation_passed=True,
            case_id="CASE-6H-E2E-REJECT-001",
            trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        )
    )

    assert (
        result.case.governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    runtime_sync.sync_case(
        "CASE-6H-E2E-REJECT-001"
    )

    record = (
        composition.case_service.reject(
            case_id="CASE-6H-E2E-REJECT-001",
            change_id="PCR-6H-E2E-REJECT-001",
            approval_id="APR-6H-REJECT-001",
            reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
            role="DPO",
            comment=(
                "Rejected during 6H E2E test."
            ),
        )
    )

    assert (
        record.decision
        == ApprovalDecision.REJECTED
    )

    case = (
        composition.case_registry
        .get("CASE-6H-E2E-REJECT-001")
    )

    assert (
        case.governance_status
        == "BLOCKED"
    )

    assert (
        case.final_decision
        == "REJECTED"
    )

    runtime_sync.sync_decision(
        "CASE-6H-E2E-REJECT-001"
    )

    case_rows = read_sheet_rows(
        workbook_path,
        "Privacy Governance Cases",
    )

    assert len(case_rows) == 1

    assert (
        case_rows[0]["Governance Status"]
        == "BLOCKED"
    )

    assert (
        case_rows[0]["Final Decision"]
        == "REJECTED"
    )

    approval_rows = read_sheet_rows(
        workbook_path,
        "Approval Evidence",
    )

    assert len(approval_rows) == 1

    assert (
        approval_rows[0]["Approval ID"]
        == "APR-6H-REJECT-001"
    )

    assert (
        approval_rows[0]["Decision"]
        == "REJECTED"
    )

    dashboard = read_dashboard(
        workbook_path
    )

    assert dashboard["Total Cases"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Pending DPO/GRC"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Approved"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Blocked"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Approval Records"] == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import load_workbook

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_record import (
    ApprovalDecision,
    PrivacyApprovalRecord,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_registry import (
    PrivacyApprovalRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCase,
    PrivacyTriggerType,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case_registry import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_excel_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync,
)


def make_case(status: str) -> PrivacyGovernanceCase:
    return PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="CASE-LIFECYCLE-001",
        title="Lifecycle test",
        summary="Lifecycle projection.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        risk="MEDIUM",
        validation_status="PASS",
        email_status="SENT",
        governance_status=status,
    )


def make_approval(
    approval_id: str,
    role: str,
    decision: ApprovalDecision,
) -> PrivacyApprovalRecord:
    return PrivacyApprovalRecord(
        approval_id=approval_id,
        case_id="CASE-LIFECYCLE-001",
        change_id="PCR-LIFECYCLE-001",
        reviewer=f"{role} Reviewer",
        role=role,
        decision=decision,
        comment="Lifecycle decision.",
        decided_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


def read_dashboard(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    ws = load_workbook(path)["Governance Dashboard"]
    return {
        ws[f"A{row}"].value: ws[f"B{row}"].value
        for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1)
    }


def test_dpo_plus_grc_projects_approved_state(tmp_path: Path):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry([make_case("APPROVED")])
    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()
    approvals.register(
        make_approval("APR-DPO", "DPO", ApprovalDecision.APPROVED)
    )
    approvals.register(
        make_approval("APR-GRC", "GRC", ApprovalDecision.APPROVED)
    )

    sync = PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=tmp_path / "tracker.xlsx"
    )
    sync.sync_all(
        case_registry=cases,
        approval_registry=approvals,
    )

    dashboard = read_dashboard(tmp_path / "tracker.xlsx")

    assert dashboard["Total Cases"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Pending DPO/GRC"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Approved"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Blocked"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Approval Records"] == 2


def test_rejection_projects_blocked_state(tmp_path: Path):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry([make_case("BLOCKED")])
    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()
    approvals.register(
        make_approval(
            "APR-DPO",
            "DPO",
            ApprovalDecision.REJECTED,
        )
    )

    sync = PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=tmp_path / "tracker.xlsx"
    )

        case_registry=cases,

    dashboard = read_dashboard(tmp_path / "tracker.xlsx")

    assert dashboard["Total Cases"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Pending DPO/GRC"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Approved"] == 0
    assert dashboard["Blocked"] == 1
    assert dashboard["Approval Records"] == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import load_workbook

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_record import (
    ApprovalDecision,
    PrivacyApprovalRecord,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_registry import (
    PrivacyApprovalRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCase,
    PrivacyTriggerType,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case_registry import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_excel_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync,
)


def make_case(
    *,
    case_id: str = "CASE-001",
    status: str = "PENDING_DPO_GRC",
) -> PrivacyGovernanceCase:
    return PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id=case_id,
        title="New learner processing",
        summary="Controlled privacy governance case.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        risk="MEDIUM",
        validation_status="PASS",
        email_status="SENT",
        governance_status=status,
    )


def make_approval(
    approval_id: str,
    *,
    case_id: str = "CASE-001",
    role: str = "DPO",
    decision: ApprovalDecision = ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
) -> PrivacyApprovalRecord:
    return PrivacyApprovalRecord(
        approval_id=approval_id,
        case_id=case_id,
        change_id="PCR-001",
        reviewer=f"{role} Reviewer",
        role=role,
        decision=decision,
        comment=f"{role} decision recorded.",
        decided_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


def make_sync(tmp_path: Path) -> PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync:
    return PrivacyGovernanceExcelSync(
        workbook_path=tmp_path / "EasyChatBot_Project_Control_Center.xlsx",
    )


def test_case_is_projected_to_excel(tmp_path: Path):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry([make_case()])
    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()

    make_sync(tmp_path).sync_all(
        case_registry=cases,
        approval_registry=approvals,
    )

    workbook = load_workbook(
        tmp_path / "EasyChatBot_Project_Control_Center.xlsx"
    )
    ws = workbook["Privacy Governance Cases"]

    assert ws["A2"].value == "CASE-001"
    assert ws["I2"].value == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"


def test_approval_is_projected_to_excel(tmp_path: Path):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry([make_case()])
    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()
    approvals.register(make_approval("APR-DPO-001"))

    make_sync(tmp_path).sync_all(
        case_registry=cases,
        approval_registry=approvals,
    )

    workbook = load_workbook(
        tmp_path / "EasyChatBot_Project_Control_Center.xlsx"
    )
    ws = workbook["Approval Evidence"]

    assert ws["A2"].value == "APR-DPO-001"
    assert ws["B2"].value == "CASE-001"
    assert ws["E2"].value == "DPO"
    assert ws["F2"].value == "APPROVED"


def test_dashboard_counts_are_projected(tmp_path: Path):
    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry([
        make_case(case_id="CASE-001", status="APPROVED"),
        make_case(case_id="CASE-002", status="BLOCKED"),

    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()
    approvals.register(make_approval("APR-001", case_id="CASE-001"))
    approvals.register(

    values = {

    assert values["Approved"] == 1
    assert values["Blocked"] == 1
    assert values["Approval Records"] == 2

    assert "Capability Tracker" in workbook.sheetnames

    assert "Approval Evidence" in workbook.sheetnames
    assert "Governance Dashboard" in workbook.sheetnames

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_composition import (
    create_privacy_governance_composition,
)


def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-FLOW-001",
        title="New learner processing",
        description="A new learner processing activity requires governance.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def test_new_processing_pass_creates_pending_governance_case_in_shared_registry():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

    assert result.change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    assert result.case.case_id == "CASE-PCR-FLOW-001"
    assert result.case.trigger_type.value == "NEW_PROCESSING"
    assert result.case.validation_status == "PASS"
    assert result.case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    assert composition.case_registry.get(
        "CASE-PCR-FLOW-001"
    ) is result.case

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 1,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 0,

def test_dpo_and_grc_approvals_update_the_same_case_seen_by_dashboard():

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

        case_id=result.case.case_id,
        change_id="PCR-FLOW-001",
        approval_id="APR-FLOW-DPO-001",

        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO approved.",
    )

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary()["pending"] == 1
    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary()["approved"] == 0

    composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id=result.case.case_id,
        change_id="PCR-FLOW-001",
        approval_id="APR-FLOW-GRC-001",
        reviewer="GRC Reviewer",
        role="GRC",
        comment="GRC approved.",
    )

    assert composition.case_registry.get(
        result.case.case_id
    ).governance_status == "APPROVED"

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 1,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 2,
    }


def test_rejected_case_is_blocked_and_visible_to_dashboard():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

        change_id="PCR-FLOW-001",
        approval_id="APR-FLOW-DPO-REJECT",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="Additional remediation required.",
    )

    assert composition.case_registry.get(
        result.case.case_id
    ).governance_status == "BLOCKED"

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 1,
        "approval_records": 1,
    }


def test_failed_validation_blocks_change_and_creates_blocked_case():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=False,
    )

    assert result.change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    assert result.case.validation_status == "FAIL"
    assert result.case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary()["blocked"] == 1


def test_flow_is_idempotent_for_same_case_identifier():
    composition = create_privacy_governance_composition()

    first = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

    second = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
    )

    assert second.case is first.case
    assert len(composition.case_registry.all()) == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

)

)

)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ValidationResult:
    status: str


class FakeValidationService:
    """Deterministic validation service for gate tests."""

    def __init__(self, status: str = "PASS") -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.calls = 0

    def validate(self) -> ValidationResult:
        self.calls += 1
        return ValidationResult(
            status=self.status,
        )


class FakeApprovalEmailSender:
    """Application-boundary fake for approval email delivery."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.requests = []

    async def send(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)

        return {
            "status": "accepted",
            "message_id": "MSG-APPROVAL-001",
            "reference": "MSG-APPROVAL-001",
            "case_id": request.case_id,
            "change_id": request.change_id,
        }


def make_change(
    *,
    change_id: str = "PCR-GATE-001",
    dpo_required: bool = True,
    grc_required: bool = True,
) -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id=change_id,
        title="Controlled privacy change",
        description="Privacy governance gate test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=dpo_required,
        grc_required=grc_required,
    )


def make_registry(
    change: PrivacyChange,
) -> PrivacyChangeRegistry:
    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()
    registry.register(change)
    return registry


def make_gate(
    *,
    change: PrivacyChange | None = None,
    validation_status: str = "PASS",
):
    if change is None:
        change = make_change()

    registry = make_registry(change)

    validation_service = FakeValidationService(
        status=validation_status,
    )

    sender = FakeApprovalEmailSender()

    approval_email_service = PrivacyApprovalEmailService(
        sender=sender,
        approval_recipient="dpo@example.test",
    )

    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(
        registry=registry,
        validation_service=validation_service,
        approval_email_service=approval_email_service,
    )

    return (
        gate,
        registry,
        validation_service,
        sender,
    )


def test_route_blocks_when_validation_fails():
    change = make_change()

    gate, registry, validation, sender = make_gate(
        change=change,
        validation_status="FAIL",
    )

    result = gate.route_and_escalate.__wrapped__ if False else None

    # Synchronous route() uses the configured validation service
    # as the authoritative validation source.
    result = gate.route(change)

    assert result.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    stored = registry.get("PCR-GATE-001")

    assert stored.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    assert validation.calls == 1

    # route() must not send an email.
    assert sender.requests == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_route_and_escalate_blocks_when_validation_fails():
    change = make_change()

    gate, registry, validation, sender = make_gate(
        change=change,
        validation_status="FAIL",
    )

    result = await gate.route_and_escalate(
        change,
    )

    assert result.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    stored = registry.get("PCR-GATE-001")

    assert stored.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    assert validation.calls == 1

    # Failed validation must never trigger governance email.
    assert sender.requests == []

class FakeApprovalEmailSender:
    """Deterministic synchronous test double; no real email is sent."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.requests = []

    def send(self, request) -> None:
        """Record the email request without sending a real email."""
        self.requests.append(request)


class FakeValidationResult:
    def __init__(self, status: str) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.checks = 16
        self.passed = 16 if status == "PASS" else 15
        self.failures = () if status == "PASS" else ("privacy gap",)


class FakePrivacyValidationService:
    def __init__(self, status: str) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.calls = 0

    def validate(self) -> FakeValidationResult:
        self.calls += 1
        return FakeValidationResult(self.status)


def make_change(
    *,
    dpo_required: bool = True,
    grc_required: bool = True,
) -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-TEST-001",
        title="Test privacy-impacting change",
        description="Controlled governance gate test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        dpo_required=dpo_required,
        grc_required=grc_required,
    )


def make_gate(
    *,
    validation_status: str,
    sender: FakeApprovalEmailSender,
):
    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()

    validation = FakePrivacyValidationService(
        validation_status
    )

    email_service = PrivacyApprovalEmailService(
        sender=sender,
        approval_recipient="davdbarbero1999@gmail.com",
    )

    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(
        registry=registry,
        validation_service=validation,
        approval_email_service=email_service,
    )

    return gate, registry, validation


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pass_dpo_grc_required_sends_email_and_remains_pending():
    sender = FakeApprovalEmailSender()

    gate, registry, validation = make_gate(
        validation_status="PASS",
        sender=sender,
    )

    result = await gate.route_and_escalate(
        make_change(
            dpo_required=True,
            grc_required=True,
        )
    )

    assert result.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC

    assert len(sender.requests) == 1

    request = sender.requests[0]

    assert request.recipient == "davdbarbero1999@gmail.com"
    assert request.requires_dpo_approval is True
    assert request.requires_grc_approval is True

    # Email delivery must never equal governance approval.
    assert result.status != PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED

    assert gate.can_proceed(
        "PCR-TEST-001"
    ) is False

    assert validation.calls == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_operational_followup import (
    create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_policy import (
    GovernanceReminderPolicy,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_scheduler import (
    InMemoryGovernanceReminderState,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Case:
    case_id: str
    change_id: str
    title: str
    risk: str
    validation_status: str
    governance_status: str
    triggered_at: datetime
    dpo_required: bool = True
    grc_required: bool = True


class Registry:
    def __init__(self, cases):
        self._cases = list(cases)

    def all(self):
        return list(self._cases)


class FakeEmail:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent = []

    def send_reminder(self, *, case, proposal):
        self.sent.append((case, proposal))


def make_case(status: str = "PENDING_DPO_GRC") -> Case:
    return Case(
        case_id="CASE-6J-OPS-001",
        change_id="PCR-6J-OPS-001",
        title="Operational follow-up test",
        risk="MEDIUM",
        validation_status="PASS",
        governance_status=status,
        triggered_at=datetime(
            2026, 8, 22, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc
        ),
    )


def test_existing_scheduler_can_invoke_operational_followup():
    email = FakeEmail()
    job = create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up(
        case_registry=Registry([make_case()]),
        reminder_state=InMemoryGovernanceReminderState(),
        email_sender=email,
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24),
            repeat_after=timedelta(hours=24),
        ),
    )

    result = job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert result.scanned == 1
    assert result.reminded == 1
    assert result.case_ids_reminded == ("CASE-6J-OPS-001",)
    assert len(email.sent) == 1


def test_followup_does_not_make_a_governance_decision():
    case = make_case()
    email = FakeEmail()
    job = create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up(
        case_registry=Registry([case]),
        reminder_state=InMemoryGovernanceReminderState(),
        email_sender=email,
    )

    job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert email.sent[0][1].decision_options == (
        "APPROVE",
        "REJECT",
        "REQUEST_CHANGES",
    )


def test_terminal_cases_are_not_followed_up():
    email = FakeEmail()
    job = create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up(
        case_registry=Registry([
            make_case("APPROVED"),
            make_case("BLOCKED"),
        ]),
        reminder_state=InMemoryGovernanceReminderState(),
        email_sender=email,
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=1),
        ),
    )

    result = job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert result.scanned == 2
    assert result.reminded == 0
    assert email.sent == []


def test_second_scheduler_invocation_is_idempotent_within_beta_state():
    email = FakeEmail()
    state = InMemoryGovernanceReminderState()
    job = create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up(
        case_registry=Registry([make_case()]),
        reminder_state=state,
        email_sender=email,
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24),
            repeat_after=timedelta(hours=24),
        ),
    )

    first = job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )
    second = job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert first.reminded == 1
    assert second.reminded == 0
    assert len(email.sent) == 1


def test_job_is_read_only_against_case_registry():
    case = make_case()
    email = FakeEmail()
    job = create_privacy_governance_operational_follow_up(
        case_registry=Registry([case]),
        reminder_state=InMemoryGovernanceReminderState(),
        email_sender=email,
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=1),
        ),
    )

    job.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert case.change_id == "PCR-6J-OPS-001"

        validation_status="PASS",
        governance_status=status,
        triggered_at=datetime(2026, 8, 22, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
    )


def test_overdue_pending_case_sends_one_reminder():
    case = make_case()
    email = FakeEmail()
    state = InMemoryGovernanceReminderState()
    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=type("Registry", (), {"all": lambda self: [case]})(),
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24)),
        reminder_state=state,
        email_sender=email,
    )

    result = scheduler.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert result.reminded == 1
    assert result.case_ids_reminded == ("CASE-6J-001",)
    assert len(email.sent) == 1
    assert email.sent[0][1].decision_options == (
        "APPROVE", "REJECT", "REQUEST_CHANGES"
    )

    email = FakeEmail()
    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=type("Registry", (), {"all": lambda self: [case]})(),
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(reminder_after=timedelta(hours=1)),
        reminder_state=InMemoryGovernanceReminderState(),
        email_sender=email,
    )

    result = scheduler.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert result.reminded == 0
    assert email.sent == []


def test_repeated_run_is_suppressed_until_repeat_window():
    case = make_case()
    email = FakeEmail()
    state = InMemoryGovernanceReminderState()
    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=type("Registry", (), {"all": lambda self: [case]})(),
        policy=GovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24),
            repeat_after=timedelta(hours=24),
        ),
        reminder_state=state,
        email_sender=email,
    )

    first = scheduler.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )
    second = scheduler.run_once(
        now=datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert first.reminded == 1
    assert second.reminded == 0
    assert len(email.sent) == 1

    proposal = build_decision_proposal(make_case())
    assert proposal.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert proposal.decision_options == (
        "APPROVE", "REJECT", "REQUEST_CHANGES"
    )
    assert "No decision is made by the scheduler" in proposal.summary

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.app.api.privacy_governance import router
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def reset_runtime_composition():
    """
    Keep each test isolated while preserving the production singleton model.

    Production code uses the process-wide composition.
    Tests reset that composition between scenarios.
    """

    reset_privacy_governance_composition_for_tests()

    yield

    reset_privacy_governance_composition_for_tests()


def make_app() -> FastAPI:
    """Create a minimal FastAPI application using the real governance router."""

    application = FastAPI()

    application.include_router(
        router,
    )

    return application


def make_change(
    *,
    change_id: str = "PCR-CONSISTENCY-001",
) -> PrivacyChange:
    """Create a deterministic privacy-impacting change for the test."""

    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id=change_id,
        title="New learner processing",
        description=(
            "A new learner processing activity requiring "
            "privacy governance review."
        ),
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


def test_runtime_and_api_share_the_same_governance_state():
    """
    Prove that the real runtime flow and the FastAPI API observe
    the same process-wide governance composition.

    Flow:

        NEW_PROCESSING
              â†“
        Validation PASS
              â†“
        PENDING_DPO_GRC
              â†“
        Dashboard
              â†“
        FastAPI API
              â†“
        DPO approval
              â†“
        GRC approval
              â†“
        APPROVED
    """

    composition = get_privacy_governance_composition()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Submit a real NEW_PROCESSING through the runtime flow.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Runtime state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert result.change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC

    assert result.case.case_id == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001"
    assert result.case.validation_status == "PASS"
    assert result.case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Dashboard service must see the same case.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    dashboard_cases = composition.dashboard_service.case_list()

    assert len(dashboard_cases) == 1

    assert dashboard_cases[0]["case_id"] == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001"
    assert (
        dashboard_cases[0]["governance_status"]
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 1,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. FastAPI must read the SAME runtime state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    application = make_app()
    client = TestClient(application)

    summary_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/summary",
    )

    assert summary_response.status_code == 200

    assert summary_response.json() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 1,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. API case list must contain the same case.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    cases_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases",
    )

    assert cases_response.status_code == 200

    cases = cases_response.json()

    assert len(cases) == 1

    assert cases[0]["case_id"] == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001"
    assert cases[0]["title"] == "New learner processing"
    assert cases[0]["trigger_type"] == "NEW_PROCESSING"
    assert cases[0]["validation_status"] == "PASS"
    assert cases[0]["governance_status"] == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. API detail must resolve the same case.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    detail_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases/CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
    )

    assert detail_response.status_code == 200

    detail = detail_response.json()

    assert detail["case_id"] == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001"
    assert detail["governance_status"] == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert detail["validation_status"] == "PASS"

    assert detail["trigger"]["type"] == "NEW_PROCESSING"
    assert detail["trigger"]["source"] == "Processing Registry"

    assert detail["approval_history"] == []

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Record DPO approval through the application service.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    dpo_record = composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
        change_id="PCR-CONSISTENCY-001",
        approval_id="APR-CONSISTENCY-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO review completed.",
    )

    assert dpo_record.decision.value == "APPROVED"

    # DPO approval alone is not enough because GRC is required.

    assert (
        composition.case_registry.get(
            "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
        ).governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Record GRC approval.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    grc_record = composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
        change_id="PCR-CONSISTENCY-001",
        approval_id="APR-CONSISTENCY-GRC-001",
        reviewer="GRC Reviewer",
        role="GRC",
        comment="GRC review completed.",
    )

    assert grc_record.decision.value == "APPROVED"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. Runtime must now be APPROVED.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    case = composition.case_registry.get(
        "CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
    )

    change = composition.change_registry.get(
        "PCR-CONSISTENCY-001",
    )

    assert case.governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None

    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Dashboard must see APPROVED state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 1,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 2,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. API must see the same APPROVED state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    summary_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/summary",
    )

    assert summary_response.status_code == 200

    assert summary_response.json() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 1,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 2,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 12. API detail must expose both approval records.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    detail_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases/CASE-CONSISTENCY-001",
    )

    assert detail_response.status_code == 200

    detail = detail_response.json()

    assert detail["governance_status"] == "APPROVED"
    assert detail["final_decision"] == "APPROVED"

    history = detail["approval_history"]

    assert len(history) == 2

    assert history[0]["approval_id"] == "APR-CONSISTENCY-DPO-001"
    assert history[0]["reviewer"] == "DPO Reviewer"
    assert history[0]["role"] == "DPO"
    assert history[0]["decision"] == "APPROVED"

    assert history[1]["approval_id"] == "APR-CONSISTENCY-GRC-001"
    assert history[1]["reviewer"] == "GRC Reviewer"
    assert history[1]["role"] == "GRC"
    assert history[1]["decision"] == "APPROVED"


def test_runtime_and_api_share_blocked_state_after_validation_failure():
    """
    Prove that validation failure propagates consistently through:

        Runtime â†’ Case Registry â†’ Dashboard â†’ FastAPI
    """

    composition = get_privacy_governance_composition()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Process a NEW_PROCESSING with validation failure.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(
            change_id="PCR-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001",
        ),
        automated_validation_passed=False,
        case_id="CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Runtime state must be BLOCKED.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert result.change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED

    assert result.case.case_id == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001"
    assert result.case.validation_status == "FAIL"
    assert result.case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Shared registries must contain BLOCKED state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        composition.change_registry.get(
            "PCR-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001",
        ).status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    )

    assert (
        composition.case_registry.get(
            "CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001",
        ).governance_status
        == "BLOCKED"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Dashboard must expose BLOCKED state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert composition.dashboard_service.summary() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 1,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. FastAPI must expose the same BLOCKED state.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    application = make_app()
    client = TestClient(application)

    summary_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/summary",
    )

    assert summary_response.status_code == 200

    assert summary_response.json() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 1,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. API case list must expose the blocked case.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    cases_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases",
    )

    assert cases_response.status_code == 200

    cases = cases_response.json()

    assert len(cases) == 1

    assert cases[0]["case_id"] == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001"
    assert cases[0]["validation_status"] == "FAIL"
    assert cases[0]["governance_status"] == "BLOCKED"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. API detail must expose blocked state and no approvals.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    detail_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases/"
        "CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001",
    )

    assert detail_response.status_code == 200

    detail = detail_response.json()

    assert detail["case_id"] == "CASE-CONSISTENCY-BLOCKED-001"
    assert detail["validation_status"] == "FAIL"
    assert detail["governance_status"] == "BLOCKED"
    assert detail["approval_history"] == []

def test_runtime_pass_flow_is_visible_through_api_and_reaches_approved():
    composition = get_privacy_governance_composition()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Submit a real NEW_PROCESSING through the runtime flow.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    result = composition.flow_service.process_new_processing(
        make_change(),
        automated_validation_passed=True,
        case_id="CASE-E2E-001",
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Validation PASS.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert result.case.validation_status == "PASS"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Governance case starts PENDING_DPO_GRC.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert result.case.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. The same case is visible through the dashboard service.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    dashboard_cases = composition.dashboard_service.case_list()

    assert len(dashboard_cases) == 1
    assert dashboard_cases[0]["case_id"] == "CASE-E2E-001"
    assert dashboard_cases[0]["governance_status"] == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. The API reads the SAME runtime composition.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    app = make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    summary_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/summary",
    )

    assert summary_response.status_code == 200
    assert summary_response.json() == {
        "total_cases": 1,
        "pending": 1,
        "approved": 0,
        "blocked": 0,
        "approval_records": 0,
    }

    cases_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases",
    )

    assert cases_response.status_code == 200

    cases = cases_response.json()

    assert len(cases) == 1
    assert cases[0]["case_id"] == "CASE-E2E-001"
    assert cases[0]["trigger_type"] == "NEW_PROCESSING"
    assert cases[0]["governance_status"] == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Verify case detail is exposed by the API.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    detail_response = client.get(
        "/api/privacy/governance/cases/CASE-E2E-001",
    )

    assert detail_response.status_code == 200

    detail = detail_response.json()

    assert detail["case_id"] == "CASE-E2E-001"
    assert detail["trigger"]["type"] == "NEW_PROCESSING"
    assert detail["governance_status"] == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert detail["approval_history"] == []

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. DPO approval.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    dpo_record = composition.case_service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-E2E-001",
        change_id="PCR-E2E-001",
        approval_id="APR-E2E-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO approval completed.",
    )

    assert dpo_record.decision == ApprovalDecision.APPROVED

        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    grc_record = composition.case_service.approve(

        change_id="PCR-E2E-001",
        approval_id="APR-E2E-GRC-001",

        "CASE-E2E-001",
    )

    change = composition.change_registry.get(
        "PCR-E2E-001",
    )

    assert case.governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    assert final_detail["governance_status"] == "APPROVED"
    assert final_detail["final_decision"] == "APPROVED"
    assert len(final_detail["approval_history"]) == 2

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,

def test_runtime_bridge_writes_to_the_same_composition_seen_by_dashboard():
    reset_privacy_governance_composition_for_tests()

    try:
        composition = get_privacy_governance_composition()

        change = PrivacyChange(
            change_id="PCR-RUNTIME-001",
            title="Runtime integration test",
            description="A real privacy governance event.",
            risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
            status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
            dpo_required=True,
            grc_required=True,
        )

        result = process_new_processing_governance(
            change,
            automated_validation_passed=True,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_registry import (
    PrivacyApprovalRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChange,
    PrivacyChangeRisk,
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change_registry import (
    PrivacyChangeRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCase,
    PrivacyTriggerType,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case_registry import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_case_service import (
    PrivacyGovernanceCaseService,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_decision_service import (
    PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_runtime_sync import (
    PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync,
)


class FakeExcelSync:
    """Deterministic Excel synchronization test double."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.case_rows: list[PrivacyGovernanceCase] = []
        self.approval_case_ids: list[str] = []

    def sync_case(
        self,
        case: PrivacyGovernanceCase,
    ) -> None:
        self.case_rows.append(case)

    def sync_approval(
        self,
        case_id: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.approval_case_ids.append(case_id)


def make_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id="PCR-SYNC-001",
        title="Runtime sync test",
        description="Runtime Excel synchronization test.",
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )


def make_case() -> PrivacyGovernanceCase:
    return PrivacyGovernanceCase(
        case_id="CASE-SYNC-001",
        title="Runtime sync test",
        summary="Runtime Excel synchronization test.",
        trigger_type=PrivacyTriggerType.NEW_PROCESSING,
        triggered_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        trigger_source="Processing Registry",
        change_id="PCR-SYNC-001",
        risk="MEDIUM",
        validation_status="PASS",
        email_status="SENT",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
    )


def make_service() -> PrivacyGovernanceCaseService:
    changes = PrivacyChangeRegistry()

    changes.register(
        make_change()
    )

    cases = PrivacyGovernanceCaseRegistry()

    cases.register(
        make_case()
    )

    approvals = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()

    decision_service = PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService(
        approval_registry=approvals,
        change_registry=changes,
        case_registry=cases,
    )

    return PrivacyGovernanceCaseService(
        case_registry=cases,
        change_registry=changes,
        approval_registry=approvals,
        decision_service=decision_service,
    )


def test_sync_case_projects_authoritative_case():
    excel = FakeExcelSync()
    service = make_service()

    runtime_sync = PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync(
        case_service=service,
        excel_sync=excel,
    )

    result = runtime_sync.sync_case(
        "CASE-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert result.case_id == "CASE-SYNC-001"
    assert result.change_id == "PCR-SYNC-001"
    assert result.title == "Runtime sync test"
    assert result.risk == "MEDIUM"
    assert result.validation_status == "PASS"
    assert result.governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"

    assert len(
        excel.case_rows
    ) == 1

    projected_case = excel.case_rows[0]

    assert (
        projected_case.case_id
        == "CASE-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert (
        projected_case.change_id
        == "PCR-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert (
        projected_case.governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )


def test_sync_decision_projects_case_and_approval_evidence():
    excel = FakeExcelSync()
    service = make_service()

    runtime_sync = PrivacyGovernanceRuntimeSync(
        case_service=service,
        excel_sync=excel,
    )

    approval = service.approve(
        case_id="CASE-SYNC-001",
        change_id="PCR-SYNC-001",
        approval_id="APR-SYNC-DPO-001",
        reviewer="DPO Reviewer",
        role="DPO",
        comment="DPO approval recorded.",
    )

    assert approval.case_id == "CASE-SYNC-001"
    assert approval.change_id == "PCR-SYNC-001"

    result = runtime_sync.sync_decision(
        "CASE-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert result.case_id == "CASE-SYNC-001"
    assert result.change_id == "PCR-SYNC-001"

    assert len(
        excel.case_rows
    ) == 1

    projected_case = excel.case_rows[0]

    assert (
        projected_case.case_id
        == "CASE-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert (
        projected_case.change_id
        == "PCR-SYNC-001"
    )

    assert (
        projected_case.governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    assert excel.approval_case_ids == [
        "CASE-SYNC-001"
    ]

from __future__ import annotations


import pytest


from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_identifier_service import (
    PrivacyIdentifierService,

def test_same_identifier_generates_same_hash():

    service = PrivacyIdentifierService(
        secret="test-secret",
    )


    first = (
        service.pseudonymize_identifier(
            "1092959244"
        )
    )


    second = (
        service.pseudonymize_identifier(
            "1092959244"
        )
    )


    assert first == second



def test_different_identifiers_generate_different_hashes():

    service = PrivacyIdentifierService(
        secret="test-secret",
    )


    david = (
        service.pseudonymize_identifier(
            "1092959244"
        )
    )


    brother = (
        service.pseudonymize_identifier(
            "2222222222"
        )
    )


    assert david != brother



def test_hash_does_not_contain_original_identifier():

    service = PrivacyIdentifierService(
        secret="test-secret",
    )


    result = (
        service.pseudonymize_identifier(
            "1092959244"
        )
    )


    assert "1092959244" not in result



def test_empty_identifier_rejected():

    service = PrivacyIdentifierService(
        secret="test-secret",
    )


    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        service.pseudonymize_identifier("")

from backend.app.application.privacy.processing_activity import ProcessingActivity
from backend.app.application.privacy.processing_registry import ProcessingRegistry


def activity() -> ProcessingActivity:
    return ProcessingActivity(
        processing_id="PA-001",
        name="Test processing",
        purpose="Test purpose",
        data_categories=("conversation",),
        data_subjects=("learner",),
        source=("Telegram",),
        destinations=("runtime",),
        legal_basis="test",
        retention_id="RET-001",
        data_map_id="MAP-001",
        dpia_screening_id="DPIA-001",
        gdpr_references=("GDPR Art. 5",),
        security_controls=("access control",),
    )


def test_registry_registers_and_retrieves_activity():
    registry = ProcessingRegistry()
    item = activity()
    registry.register(item)

    assert registry.get("PA-001") is item
    assert registry.ids() == {"PA-001"}


def test_registry_rejects_duplicate_processing_id():
    registry = ProcessingRegistry([activity()])

    try:
        registry.register(activity())
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert "already registered" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Duplicate processing ID was accepted")

"""
Runtime API route integration tests.

Validates:

HTTP
 |
 v
FastAPI API Route
 |
 v
ExternalRuntimeService
 |
 v
CapabilityGateway
 |
 v
Runtime Response

The test uses controlled fakes.

It does not call:
- Parallel API
- Gemini
- Google Cloud
- external providers
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.api.main import (
    create_app,
)

from backend.api import routes

from backend.services.external_runtime_service import (
    ExternalRuntimeService,
)


class FakeRuntimeGateway:
    """
    Controlled Runtime gateway for API testing.
    """

    async def execute(
        self,
        context,
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "request_id": "test-runtime-request",
            "capability": "live_intelligence",
            "status": "completed",
            "output": {
                "results": [
                    {
                        "title": "AI News Result",
                        "source": "fake-provider",
                    }
                ]
            },
        }


def create_test_runtime_service() -> ExternalRuntimeService:
    """
    Create ExternalRuntimeService using
    a controlled gateway.
    """

    return ExternalRuntimeService(
        gateway=FakeRuntimeGateway(),
    )


def test_runtime_execute_api_route():
    """
    Validate:

    POST /runtime/execute

        ->
    ExternalRuntimeService

        ->
    Runtime Result
    """

    original_factory = (
        routes.create_external_runtime_service
    )

    routes.create_external_runtime_service = (
        create_test_runtime_service
    )

    try:
        app = create_app()

        client = TestClient(
            app,
        )

        response = client.post(
            "/runtime/execute",
            json={
                "capability": (
                    "live_intelligence"
                ),
                "payload": {
                    "query": (
                        "latest AI news"
                    ),
                },
                "user_id": (
                    "runtime-api-test-user"
                ),
            },
        )

    finally:
        routes.create_external_runtime_service = (
            original_factory
        )

    assert response.status_code == 200

    body = response.json()

    assert (
        body["status"]
        == "completed"
    )

    assert (
        body["capability"]
        == "live_intelligence"
    )

    assert (
        body["request_id"]
        == "test-runtime-request"
    )

    assert (
        body["output"]["results"][0]["source"]
        == "fake-provider"
    )


def test_runtime_execute_requires_capability():
    """
    Validate API transport validation.
    """

    app = create_app()

    client = TestClient(
        app,
    )

    response = client.post(
        "/runtime/execute",
        json={
            "payload": {},
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 422

FILE: C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\tests\application\privacy\test_privacy_governance_decision_hardening.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

import pytest

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_record import (
    ApprovalDecision,
    PrivacyApprovalRecord,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_approval_registry import (
    PrivacyApprovalRegistry,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_change import (
    PrivacyChangeStatus,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_decision_service import (
    PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FakeChange:
    change_id: str
    dpo_required: bool
    grc_required: bool
    status: PrivacyChangeStatus


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FakeCase:
    case_id: str
    change_id: str
    governance_status: str
    final_decision: str | None = None
    final_decision_at: datetime | None = None


class FakeChangeRegistry:
    def __init__(self, changes: list[FakeChange]) -> None:
        self._changes = {
            change.change_id: change
            for change in changes
        }

    def get(self, change_id: str) -> FakeChange:
        return self._changes[change_id]

    def update(self, change: FakeChange) -> None:
        self._changes[change.change_id] = change


class FakeCaseRegistry:
    def __init__(self, cases: list[FakeCase]) -> None:
        self._cases = {
            case.case_id: case
            for case in cases
        }

    def get(self, case_id: str) -> FakeCase:
        return self._cases[case_id]

    def update(self, case: FakeCase) -> None:
        self._cases[case.case_id] = case


def _build_service(
    *,
    change_id: str = "CHANGE-A",
    case_id: str = "CASE-A",
    dpo_required: bool = True,
    grc_required: bool = True,
    governance_status: str = "PENDING_DPO_GRC",
) -> tuple[
    PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService,
    FakeChangeRegistry,
    FakeCaseRegistry,
    PrivacyApprovalRegistry,
]:
    change_registry = FakeChangeRegistry(
        [
            FakeChange(
                change_id=change_id,
                dpo_required=dpo_required,
                grc_required=grc_required,
                status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
            )
        ]
    )

    case_registry = FakeCaseRegistry(
        [
            FakeCase(
                case_id=case_id,
                change_id=change_id,
                governance_status=governance_status,
            )
        ]
    )

    approval_registry = PrivacyApprovalRegistry()

    service = PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService(
        approval_registry=approval_registry,
        change_registry=change_registry,
        case_registry=case_registry,
    )

    return (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    )


def _approve(
    service: PrivacyGovernanceDecisionService,
    *,
    case_id: str,
    change_id: str,
    approval_id: str,
    reviewer: str,
    role: str,
) -> PrivacyApprovalRecord:
    return service.record_decision(
        case_id=case_id,
        change_id=change_id,
        approval_id=approval_id,
        reviewer=reviewer,
        role=role,
        decision=ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
        comment=f"{role} approval",
    )


def test_dpo_and_grc_required_reach_approved_only_after_both_approvals() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    dpo_record = _approve(
        service,
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-001",
        reviewer="dpo@example.test",
        role="DPO",
    )

    assert dpo_record.decision == ApprovalDecision.APPROVED
    assert case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    assert (
        change_registry.get("CHANGE-A").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )
    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 1

    grc_record = _approve(
        service,
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-GRC-001",
        reviewer="grc@example.test",
        role="GRC",
    )

    assert grc_record.decision == ApprovalDecision.APPROVED

    case = case_registry.get("CASE-A")
    change = change_registry.get("CHANGE-A")

    assert case.governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision == "APPROVED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 2


def test_rejection_blocks_governance_case() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    record = service.record_decision(
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-REJECT-001",
        reviewer="dpo@example.test",
        role="DPO",
        decision=ApprovalDecision.REJECTED,
        comment="Rejected during privacy review.",
    )

    assert record.decision == ApprovalDecision.REJECTED

    case = case_registry.get("CASE-A")
    change = change_registry.get("CHANGE-A")

    assert case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert case.final_decision == "REJECTED"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 1


def test_request_changes_blocks_governance_case() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    record = service.record_decision(
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-DPO-CHANGES-001",
        reviewer="dpo@example.test",
        role="DPO",
        decision=ApprovalDecision.REQUEST_CHANGES,
        comment="Additional safeguards are required.",
    )

    assert record.decision == ApprovalDecision.REQUEST_CHANGES

    case = case_registry.get("CASE-A")
    change = change_registry.get("CHANGE-A")

    assert case.governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert case.final_decision == "REQUEST_CHANGES"
    assert case.final_decision_at is not None
    assert change.status == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 1


def test_case_and_change_mismatch_is_rejected() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
    )

    # Add a different change that does NOT belong to CASE-A.
    change_registry.update(
        FakeChange(
            change_id="CHANGE-B",
            dpo_required=True,
            grc_required=True,
            status=PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC,
        )
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="does not belong to governance case CASE-A",
    ):
        service.record_decision(
            case_id="CASE-A",
            change_id="CHANGE-B",
            approval_id="APR-MISMATCH-001",
            reviewer="dpo@example.test",
            role="DPO",
            decision=ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
            comment="Should never be recorded.",
        )

    assert approval_registry.all() == ()

    assert (
        case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status
        == "PENDING_DPO_GRC"
    )

    assert (
        change_registry.get("CHANGE-B").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )


def test_finalized_approved_case_cannot_receive_another_decision() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        dpo_required=False,
        grc_required=False,
    )

    first = _approve(
        service,
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-APPROVED-001",
        reviewer="dpo@example.test",
        role="DPO",
    )

    assert first.decision == ApprovalDecision.APPROVED
    assert case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status == "APPROVED"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="already has a final decision",
    ):
        service.record_decision(
            case_id="CASE-A",
            change_id="CHANGE-A",
            approval_id="APR-LATE-REJECT-001",
            reviewer="grc@example.test",
            role="GRC",
            decision=ApprovalDecision.REJECTED,
            comment="This must not overwrite the final decision.",
        )

    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 1
    assert (
        approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")[0].approval_id
        == "APR-APPROVED-001"
    )

    assert (
        case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status
        == "APPROVED"
    )

    assert (
        change_registry.get("CHANGE-A").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    )


def test_finalized_blocked_case_cannot_receive_another_decision() -> None:
    (
        service,
        change_registry,
        case_registry,
        approval_registry,
    ) = _build_service(
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
    )

    first = service.record_decision(
        case_id="CASE-A",
        change_id="CHANGE-A",
        approval_id="APR-BLOCKED-001",
        reviewer="dpo@example.test",
        role="DPO",
        decision=ApprovalDecision.REJECTED,
        comment="Privacy rejection.",
    )

    assert first.decision == ApprovalDecision.REJECTED
    assert case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status == "BLOCKED"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="already has a final decision",
    ):
        service.record_decision(
            case_id="CASE-A",
            change_id="CHANGE-A",
            approval_id="APR-LATE-APPROVAL-001",
            reviewer="grc@example.test",
            role="GRC",
            decision=ApprovalDecision.APPROVED,
            comment="This must not reopen the case.",
        )

    assert len(approval_registry.for_case("CASE-A")) == 1
    assert (
        case_registry.get("CASE-A").governance_status
        == "BLOCKED"
    )
    assert (
        change_registry.get("CHANGE-A").status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.BLOCKED
    )

def test_recommendation_is_generated_from_comparison_evidence() -> None:
    """
    Validate that provider comparison evidence can
    produce an optimisation recommendation.
    """

    comparison_service = (
        ProviderComparisonService()
    )

    optimisation_service = (
        CapabilityOptimisationService()
    )

    events = [
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=800,
            cost="0.010",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=850,
            cost="0.010",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=1400,
            cost="0.015",
            success=False,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=1300,
            cost="0.015",
            success=True,
        ),
    ]

    comparisons = comparison_service.compare(
        events=events
    )

    recommendation = (
        optimisation_service
        .recommend_from_comparisons(
            capability="conversation",
            current_provider="gemini",
            current_model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            comparisons=comparisons,
        )
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.capability
        == "conversation"
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.current_provider
        == "gemini"
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.current_model
        == "gemini-2.5-flash"
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.recommended_provider
        == "openai"
    )

    assert (
        recommendation.recommended_model
        == "gpt-5-mini"
    )

    assert recommendation.confidence > 0.0

    assert recommendation.confidence <= 99.0

    assert (
        "strongest observed"
        in recommendation.reason
    )


def test_optimisation_is_capability_specific() -> None:
    """
    Validate that optimisation does not mix unrelated
    capabilities.

    Conversation evidence makes OpenAI stronger.

    Summarisation evidence makes Gemini stronger.

    The optimiser must evaluate each capability
    independently.
    """

    comparison_service = (
        ProviderComparisonService()
    )

    optimisation_service = (
        CapabilityOptimisationService()
    )

    events = [
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=800,
            cost="0.010",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="conversation",
            latency_ms=1400,
            cost="0.015",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="summarisation",
            latency_ms=600,
            cost="0.006",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="ollama",
            model="gemma4",
            capability="summarisation",
            latency_ms=1500,
            cost="0.000",
            success=True,
        ),
    ]

    comparisons = comparison_service.compare(
        events=events
    )

    conversation_recommendation = (
        optimisation_service
        .recommend_from_comparisons(
            capability="conversation",
            current_provider="gemini",
            current_model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            comparisons=comparisons,
        )
    )

    summarisation_recommendation = (
        optimisation_service
        .recommend_from_comparisons(
            capability="summarisation",
            current_provider="ollama",
            current_model="gemma4",
            comparisons=comparisons,
        )
    )

    assert (
        conversation_recommendation.capability
        == "conversation"
    )

    assert (
        summarisation_recommendation.capability
        == "summarisation"
    )

    assert (
        conversation_recommendation
        .recommended_provider
        == "openai"
    )

    assert (
        summarisation_recommendation
        .recommended_provider
        == "gemini"
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center escalation history tests.

Validates the read-only application contract used by
the Operations Center.

Coverage:

- complete escalation history;
- individual workflow retrieval;
- status filtering;
- pending approval;
- approved history;
- rejected history;
- pending notification;
- status counts;
- pending approval detection.

The service must not mutate workflow state.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_history_service import (
    EscalationHistoryService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_repository import (
    InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_service import (
    EscalationWorkflow,
    EscalationWorkflowStatus,
)


def create_workflow(
    *,
    escalation_id: str,
    status: EscalationWorkflowStatus,
    minute: int,
) -> EscalationWorkflow:
    """
    Create deterministic workflow history data.
    """

    return EscalationWorkflow(
        escalation_id=escalation_id,
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            minute,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        notification_recipient=(
            "operations@example.com"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        notification_subject=(
            "EasyChatBot AI Operations Escalation"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        approved_at=(
            datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                15,
                minute,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            )
            if status
            == EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .APPROVED
            else None
        ),
        rejected_at=(
            datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                15,
                minute,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            )
            if status
            == EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .REJECTED
            else None
        ),
        decision_reason=(
            "Operations decision recorded."
            if status
            in (
                EscalationWorkflowStatus.APPROVED,
                EscalationWorkflowStatus.REJECTED,
            )
            else None
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> (
    tuple[
        EscalationHistoryService,
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
    ]
):
    """
    Create a history service and repository.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository()
    )

    service = EscalationHistoryService(
        repository=repository
    )

    return service, repository


def populate_repository(
    repository: InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
) -> None:
    """
    Populate deterministic escalation history.
    """

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-001",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            ),
            minute=30,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-002",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .AWAITING_APPROVAL
            ),
            minute=31,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-003",

"""

        |
        v

        |

        |

Prepared Human Notification

No provider routing is changed.

No escalation is approved automatically.
