from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.email_notification_adapter import (
    InMemoryEmailNotificationAdapter,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_notification_service import (
    EscalationNotificationService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.models import (
    EscalationSeverity,
    EscalationType,
    ProviderEscalation,
)


def create_escalation() -> ProviderEscalation:
    """
    Create a deterministic provider failure escalation.
    """

    return ProviderEscalation(
        escalation_id="esc-001",
        escalation_type=(
            EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.HIGH
        ),
        provider="openai",
        capability="conversation",
        message=(
            "Provider openai is currently unavailable. "
            "Affected capabilities: conversation. "
            "Consecutive health failures: 3."
        ),
        recommendation=(
            "Review alternative providers for "
            "conversation workloads. "
            "Human approval is required."
        ),
        created_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            34,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> (
    EscalationNotificationService
):
    """
    Create the notification service with the in-memory
    email adapter.
    """

    adapter = (
        InMemoryEmailNotificationAdapter()
    )

    return EscalationNotificationService(
        email_adapter=adapter
    )


def test_escalation_notification_is_prepared() -> None:
    """
    Validate preparation of a human escalation
    notification.
    """

    service = create_service()

    result = (
        service.prepare_escalation_notification(
            escalation=create_escalation(),
            recipient="operations@example.com",
        )
    )

    assert (
        result.escalation_id
        == "esc-001"
    )

    assert (
        result.recipient
        == "operations@example.com"
    )

    assert (
        "AI Operations Escalation"
        in result.subject
    )

    assert (
        "HIGH"
        in result.subject
    )

    assert (
        "esc-001"
        in result.body
    )

    assert (
        "provider_failure"
        in result.body
    )

    assert (
        "openai"
        in result.body
    )

    assert (
        "conversation"
        in result.body
    )

        InMemoryEscalationRepository()
    )

"""

Escalation Repository
        |

EscalationTypeService

EscalationTypeSummary

AI Operations Center

"""

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_repository import (
    InMemoryEscalationRepository,

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_service import (
    EscalationService,
)

    EscalationTypeService,

    EscalationSeverity,
    EscalationStatus,
    EscalationType,
)


def create_services() -> tuple[
    EscalationService,
    EscalationTypeService,
    InMemoryEscalationRepository,
]:
    """
    Create the escalation services and repository.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryEscalationRepository()
    )

    escalation_service = EscalationService(
        repository=repository,
    )

    type_service = EscalationTypeService(
        repository=repository,
    )

    return (
        escalation_service,
        type_service,
        repository,
    )


def test_summary_contains_all_escalation_types() -> None:
    """
    Validate that every supported escalation type
    is represented, including types with zero incidents.
    """

    (
        _,
        type_service,
        _,
    ) = create_services()

    summaries = (
        type_service.get_summary()
    )

    types = tuple(
        summary.escalation_type
        for summary in summaries
    )

    assert types == tuple(
        EscalationType
    )

    assert len(summaries) == len(
        EscalationType
    )


def test_summary_counts_escalations_by_type() -> None:
    """
    Validate aggregation of escalation counts.
    """

    (
        escalation_service,
        type_service,
        _,
    ) = create_services()

    escalation_service.create_escalation(
        escalation_type=(
            EscalationType.COST_SPIKE
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.MEDIUM
        ),
        provider="openai",
        capability="conversation",
        message="Cost increased.",
    )

    escalation_service.create_escalation(
        escalation_type=(
            EscalationType.COST_SPIKE
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.HIGH
        ),
        provider="openai",
        capability="research",
        message="Research cost increased.",
    )

    escalation_service.create_escalation(
        escalation_type=(
            EscalationType.QUALITY_DROP
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.HIGH
        ),
        provider="gemini",
        capability="summarisation",
        message="Quality decreased.",
    )

    summaries = (
        type_service.get_summary()
    )

    summary_by_type = {
        summary.escalation_type: summary
        for summary in summaries
    }

    assert (
        summary_by_type[
            EscalationType.COST_SPIKE
        ].total_count
        == 2
    )

    assert (
        summary_by_type[
            EscalationType.QUALITY_DROP
        ].total_count
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        summary_by_type[
            EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
        ].total_count
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        summary_by_type[
            EscalationType.LATENCY_DEGRADATION
        ].total_count
        == 0
    )


def test_summary_counts_only_open_and_acknowledged_as_active() -> None:
    """
    Validate that resolved and dismissed escalations
    are excluded from active counts.
    """

    (
        escalation_service,
        type_service,
        repository,
    ) = create_services()

    open_escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.CRITICAL
            ),
            provider="ollama",
            capability="conversation",
            message="Provider unavailable.",
        )
    )

    acknowledged_escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.HIGH
            ),
            provider="ollama",
            capability="research",
            message="Provider degraded.",
        )
    )

    resolved_escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.HIGH
            ),
            provider="ollama",
            capability="conversation",
            message="Provider was unavailable.",
        )
    )

    dismissed_escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.MEDIUM
            ),
            provider="ollama",
            capability="research",
            message="Transient provider issue.",
        )
    )

    repository.clear()

    repository.save(
        open_escalation
    )

    repository.save(
        acknowledged_escalation.__class__(
            escalation_id=(
                acknowledged_escalation.escalation_id
            ),
            escalation_type=(
                acknowledged_escalation.escalation_type
            ),
            severity=(
                acknowledged_escalation.severity
            ),

                acknowledged_escalation.provider
            ),
            capability=(
                acknowledged_escalation.capability
            ),
            message=(
                acknowledged_escalation.message
            ),
            recommendation=(
                acknowledged_escalation.recommendation
            ),
            created_at=(
                acknowledged_escalation.created_at
            ),
            status=(
                EscalationStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED
            ),
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        resolved_escalation.__class__(
            escalation_id=(
                resolved_escalation.escalation_id
            ),
            escalation_type=(
                resolved_escalation.escalation_type
            ),
            severity=(
                resolved_escalation.severity
            ),
            provider=(
                resolved_escalation.provider
            ),
            capability=(
                resolved_escalation.capability
            ),
            message=(
                resolved_escalation.message
            ),
            recommendation=(
                resolved_escalation.recommendation
            ),
            created_at=(
                resolved_escalation.created_at
            ),
            status=(
                EscalationStatus.RESOLVED
            ),
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        dismissed_escalation.__class__(
            escalation_id=(
                dismissed_escalation.escalation_id
            ),
            escalation_type=(
                dismissed_escalation.escalation_type
            ),
            severity=(
                dismissed_escalation.severity
            ),
            provider=(
                dismissed_escalation.provider
            ),
            capability=(
                dismissed_escalation.capability
            ),
            message=(
                dismissed_escalation.message
            ),
            recommendation=(
                dismissed_escalation.recommendation
            ),
            created_at=(
                dismissed_escalation.created_at
            ),
            status=(
                EscalationStatus.DISMISSED
            ),
        )
    )

    summaries = (
        type_service.get_summary()
    )

    summary_by_type = {
        summary.escalation_type: summary
        for summary in summaries
    }

    provider_failure = summary_by_type[
        EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
    ]

    assert provider_failure.total_count == 4

    assert provider_failure.active_count == 2


def test_empty_repository_returns_zero_counts() -> None:
    """
    Validate the empty Operations Center state.
    """

    (
        _,
        type_service,
        _,
    ) = create_services()

    summaries = (
        type_service.get_summary()
    )

    for summary in summaries:
        assert summary.total_count == 0
        assert summary.active_count == 0


def test_type_service_is_read_only() -> None:
    """
    Validate that generating the summary does not
    modify repository data.
    """

    (
        escalation_service,
        type_service,
        repository,
    ) = create_services()

    escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.QUALITY_DROP
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.HIGH
            ),
            provider="openai",
            capability="conversation",
            message="Quality decreased.",
        )
    )

    type_service.get_summary()

    stored = repository.get_by_id(
        escalation.escalation_id
    )

    assert stored is not None

    assert (
        stored.escalation_id
        == escalation.escalation_id
    )

    assert (
        stored.status
        == EscalationStatus.OPEN
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center escalation workflow
repository tests.

Validates:

EscalationWorkflowService
        |
        v
EscalationWorkflowRepository
        |
        v
In-Memory Persistence
        |
        v
Escalation History

The repository does not:

- make business decisions;
- send notifications;
- approve escalations;
- modify Runtime routing;
- execute provider changes.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_repository import (
    InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_service import (
    EscalationWorkflow,
    EscalationWorkflowStatus,
)


def create_workflow(
    *,
    escalation_id: str = "esc-001",
    status: EscalationWorkflowStatus = (
        EscalationWorkflowStatus.PENDING_NOTIFICATION
    ),
    created_at: datetime | None = None,
) -> EscalationWorkflow:
    """
    Create a deterministic workflow record.
    """

    if created_at is None:
        created_at = datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            30,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )

    return EscalationWorkflow(
        escalation_id=escalation_id,
        status=status,
        created_at=created_at,
        notification_recipient=None,
        notification_subject=None,
        approved_at=None,
        rejected_at=None,
        decision_reason=None,
    )


def create_repository() -> (
    InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository
):
    """
    Create a fresh repository.
    """

    return InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository()


def test_workflow_can_be_saved_and_retrieved() -> None:
    """
    Validate basic persistence and retrieval.
    """

    repository = create_repository()

    workflow = create_workflow()

    repository.save(workflow)

    retrieved = repository.get(
        "esc-001"
    )

    assert retrieved is not None

    assert (
        retrieved.escalation_id
        == "esc-001"
    )

    assert (
        retrieved.status
        == EscalationWorkflowStatus
        .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
    )

    assert (
        retrieved.created_at
        == workflow.created_at
    )

        ),
        rejected_at=None,
        decision_reason=(

        ),
    )

    retrieved = repository.get(
        "esc-001"
    )

    assert retrieved is not None

    assert (
        retrieved.status
        == EscalationWorkflowStatus
        .APPROVED
    )

    assert (
        retrieved.notification_recipient
        == "operations@example.com"
    )

    assert (

        == "Approved by Operations."

    )

def test_multiple_workflows_can_be_persisted() -> None:
    """
    Validate multiple independent workflow records.
    """

    repository = create_repository()

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-001"
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-002"
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-003"
        )
    )

    workflows = repository.get_all()

    assert len(workflows) == 3

    assert {
        workflow.escalation_id
        for workflow in workflows
    } == {
        "esc-001",
        "esc-002",
        "esc-003",
    }


def test_workflows_are_returned_in_creation_order() -> None:
    """
    Validate deterministic history ordering.
    """

    repository = create_repository()

    first_time = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        14,
        14,
        30,
        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    second_time = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        14,
        14,
        31,
        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    third_time = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        14,
        14,
        32,
        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-003",
            created_at=third_time,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-001",
            created_at=first_time,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-002",
            created_at=second_time,
        )
    )

    workflows = repository.get_all()

    assert [
        workflow.escalation_id
        for workflow in workflows
    ] == [
        "esc-001",
        "esc-002",
        "esc-003",
    ]

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center escalation workflow tests.

Validates the human-in-the-loop lifecycle:

Escalation
    |
    v
PENDING_NOTIFICATION
    |
    v
AWAITING_APPROVAL
    |
    +------------------+
    |                  |
    v                  v
 APPROVED           REJECTED

Approval records a human decision only.

It does NOT execute provider changes,
modify Runtime routing, or perform failover.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.email_notification_adapter import (
    InMemoryEmailNotificationAdapter,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_notification_service import (
    EscalationNotificationService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_service import (
    EscalationWorkflowService,
    EscalationWorkflowStatus,
)

from app.application.provider_management.models import (
    EscalationSeverity,
    EscalationType,
    ProviderEscalation,
)


def create_escalation() -> ProviderEscalation:
    """
    Create a deterministic escalation.
    """

    return ProviderEscalation(
        escalation_id="esc-001",
        escalation_type=(
            EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.HIGH
        ),
        provider="openai",
        capability="conversation",
        message=(
            "Provider openai is currently unavailable."
        ),
        recommendation=(
            "Review alternative providers for "
            "conversation workloads."
        ),
        created_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            34,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> EscalationWorkflowService:
    """
    Create a workflow service using the in-memory
    notification adapter.
    """

    adapter = (
        InMemoryEmailNotificationAdapter()
    )

    notification_service = (
        EscalationNotificationService(
            email_adapter=adapter
        )
    )

    return EscalationWorkflowService(
        notification_service=(
            notification_service
        )
    )


def test_workflow_starts_pending_notification() -> None:
    """
    Validate initial workflow state.
    """

    service = create_service()

    workflow = service.create_workflow(
        escalation=create_escalation()
    )

    assert (
        workflow.escalation_id
        == "esc-001"
    )

    assert (
        workflow.status
        == EscalationWorkflowStatus
        .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
    )

    assert (
        workflow.notification_recipient
        is None
    )

    assert (
        workflow.approved_at
        is None
    )

    assert (
        workflow.rejected_at
        is None
    )


def test_notification_moves_workflow_to_awaiting_approval() -> None:
    """
    Validate notification preparation and workflow
    transition.
    """

    service = create_service()

    escalation = create_escalation()

    service.create_workflow(
        escalation=escalation
    )

    notification = (
        service.prepare_notification(

            recipient="operations@example.com",
        )
    )

    assert (

        == "operations@example.com"
    )

    workflow = service.get_workflow(

    )

    assert workflow is not None

        == EscalationWorkflowStatus
        .AWAITING_APPROVAL
    )

    assert (

        == "operations@example.com"
    )

    assert (
        workflow.notification_subject
        is not None
    )

            EscalationType.LATENCY_DEGRADATION
        ),
        severity=(
            EscalationSeverity.MEDIUM
        ),
        provider="gemini",
        capability="summarisation",
        message="Latency degraded.",
        recommendation="Review provider performance.",
        created_at=datetime.now(
            timezone.utc
        ),
    )

    service.create_workflow(
        escalation=first
    )

    service.create_workflow(
        escalation=second
    )

    workflows = service.list_workflows()

    assert len(workflows) == 2

    assert {
        workflow.escalation_id
        for workflow in workflows
    } == {
        "esc-001",
        "esc-002",
    }


def test_notification_then_approval_preserves_audit_data() -> None:
    """

    """
    Validate escalation lifecycle filtering.

    Resolved and dismissed escalations must not
    appear in the active dashboard count.
    """

    usage_repository = (
        InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
    )

    escalation_repository = (
        InMemoryEscalationRepository()
    )

    usage_repository.save(
        create_usage_event(
            provider="openai",
        )
    )

    escalation_service = EscalationService(
        repository=escalation_repository,
    )

    escalation = (
        escalation_service.create_escalation(
            escalation_type=(
                EscalationType.PROVIDER_FAILURE
            ),
            severity=(
                EscalationSeverity.CRITICAL
            ),
            provider="openai",
            capability="conversation",
            message="Provider unavailable.",
        )
    )

    resolved_escalation = (
        escalation.__class__(
            escalation_id=(
                escalation.escalation_id
            ),
            escalation_type=(
                escalation.escalation_type
            ),
            severity=(
                escalation.severity
            ),
            provider=(
                escalation.provider
            ),
            capability=(
                escalation.capability
            ),
            message=(
                escalation.message
            ),
            recommendation=(
                escalation.recommendation
            ),
            created_at=(
                escalation.created_at
            ),
            status=(
                EscalationStatus.RESOLVED
            ),
        )
    )

    escalation_repository.clear()

    escalation_repository.save(
        resolved_escalation
    )

    service = create_dashboard_service(
        usage_repository,
        escalation_repository,
    )

    dashboard = (
        service.generate_dashboard()
    )

    assert dashboard.active_escalations == 0

    assert (
        dashboard.high_priority_escalations
        == 0
    )

"""

import asyncio

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthStatus,
)

from backend.providers.health.ollama_cloud_health_probe import (
    OllamaCloudHealthProbe,
)


def test_cloud_probe_identity() -> None:
    probe = OllamaCloudHealthProbe(
        api_key="test-key",
        model="gpt-oss:120b",
    )

    assert probe.provider == "ollama"
    assert probe.model == "gpt-oss:120b"
    assert probe.capability == "cloud_llm"


def test_cloud_probe_success() -> None:
    probe = OllamaCloudHealthProbe(
        api_key="test-key",
    )

    probe._request_chat = lambda: {
        "model": "gpt-oss:120b",
        "message": {
            "role": "assistant",
            "content": "HEALTH_OK",
        },
        "done": True,
    }

    observation = asyncio.run(
        probe.check()
    )

    assert (
        observation.provider
        == "ollama"
    )

    assert (
        observation.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
    )

    assert (
        observation.error_type
        is None
    )

    assert (
        observation.latency_ms
        >= 0
    )


def test_cloud_probe_rejects_empty_response() -> None:
    probe = OllamaCloudHealthProbe(
        api_key="test-key",
    )

    probe._request_chat = lambda: {
        "model": "gpt-oss:120b",
        "message": {
            "role": "assistant",
            "content": "",
        },
        "done": True,
    }

    observation = asyncio.run(
        probe.check()
    )

    assert (
        observation.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        observation.error_type
        == "ValueError"
    )


def test_cloud_probe_handles_failure() -> None:
    probe = OllamaCloudHealthProbe(
        api_key="test-key",
    )

    def fail():
        raise ConnectionError(
            "Cloud unavailable"
        )

    probe._request_chat = fail

    observation = asyncio.run(
        probe.check()
    )

    assert (
        observation.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        observation.error_type
        == "ConnectionError"
    )

    assert (
        observation.consecutive_failures
        == 1
    )


def test_cloud_probe_requires_api_key() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,

    ):
        OllamaCloudHealthProbe(
            api_key="",
        )

"""
Tests for the operational event repository.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event import (
    OperationalEvent,
    OperationalEventSeverity,
    OperationalEventType,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event_repository import (
    InMemoryOperationalEventRepository,
)


def create_event(
    *,
    minute: int,
    message: str,
) -> OperationalEvent:
    """
    Create deterministic operational event data.
    """

    return OperationalEvent.create(
        event_type=(
            OperationalEventType
            .AGENT_EXECUTION_FAILED
        ),
        severity=(
            OperationalEventSeverity.ERROR
        ),
        source="external_agent_runtime",
        component="conversation_agent",
        occurred_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            16,
            12,
            minute,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        message=message,
        correlation_id="run-001",
        metadata={
            "provider": "openai",
        },
    )


def test_repository_starts_empty() -> None:
    """
    Validate initial repository state.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    assert repository.get_all() == ()


def test_repository_saves_and_retrieves_event() -> None:
    """
    Validate persistence and retrieval by event ID.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    event = create_event(
        minute=1,
        message="Execution failed.",
    )

    repository.save(event)

    assert (
        repository.get_by_id(
            event.event_id
        )
        == event
    )


def test_repository_returns_none_for_unknown_event() -> None:
    """
    Validate unknown event lookup.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    event = create_event(
        minute=1,
        message="Execution failed.",
    )

    assert (
        repository.get_by_id(
            event.event_id
        )
        is None
    )


def test_repository_orders_events_deterministically() -> None:
    """
    Validate chronological event retrieval.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    second = create_event(
        minute=2,
        message="Second event.",
    )

    first = create_event(
        minute=1,
        message="First event.",
    )

    repository.save(second)
    repository.save(first)

    events = repository.get_all()

    assert events == (
        first,
        second,
    )


def test_repository_replaces_event_with_same_id() -> None:
    """
    Validate repository identity semantics.

    Operational events normally have unique IDs. If the same
    ID is persisted again, the repository retains the latest
    supplied representation.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    event = create_event(
        minute=1,
        message="Original event.",
    )

    repository.save(event)
    repository.save(event)

    events = repository.get_all()

    assert len(events) == 1
    assert events[0] == event


def test_none_event_is_rejected() -> None:
    """
    Validate repository input protection.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Operational event cannot be None.",
    ):
        repository.save(
            None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


def test_none_event_id_is_rejected() -> None:
    """
    Validate event ID input protection.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=(
            "Operational event ID cannot be None."
        ),
    ):
        repository.get_by_id(None)


def test_clear_removes_all_events() -> None:
    """
    Validate repository reset behaviour.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    repository.save(
        create_event(
            minute=1,
            message="Execution failed.",
        )
    )

    repository.clear()

    assert repository.get_all() == ()

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center operational event service tests.

Validates the generic application boundary:

OperationalEvent
        |
        v
OperationalEventService
        |
        v
OperationalEventRepository

The service must:

- reject invalid dependencies;
- reject invalid events;
- persist immutable operational facts through
  the repository abstraction;
- retrieve events by ID;
- return events in repository order;
- expose an isolated clear operation.

The service must NOT:

- know about providers;
- know about incidents;
- execute Runtime operations;
- execute agents;
- perform autonomous actions;
- access persistence infrastructure directly.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import UUID

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event import (
    OperationalEvent,
    OperationalEventSeverity,
    OperationalEventType,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event_repository import (
    InMemoryOperationalEventRepository,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event_service import (
    OperationalEventService,
)


def create_event(
    *,
    event_type: OperationalEventType = (
        OperationalEventType.PROVIDER_HEALTH_CHANGED
    ),
    severity: OperationalEventSeverity = (
        OperationalEventSeverity.INFO
    ),
    source: str = "test",
    component: str = "test_component",
    minute: int = 0,
    correlation_id: str | None = "correlation-001",
    metadata: dict[str, object] | None = None,
) -> OperationalEvent:
    """
    Create a deterministic operational event.
    """

    return OperationalEvent.create(
        event_type=event_type,
        severity=severity,
        source=source,
        component=component,
        occurred_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            minute,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        message="Operational event test.",
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        metadata=(
            metadata
            if metadata is not None
            else {
                "test": True,
            }
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> (
    tuple[
        OperationalEventService,
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository,
    ]
):
    """
    Create a service with an isolated in-memory repository.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryOperationalEventRepository()
    )

    service = OperationalEventService(
        repository=repository,
    )

    return service, repository


def test_service_requires_repository() -> None:
    """
    Validate the composition dependency boundary.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=(
            "Operational event repository "
            "cannot be None."
        ),
    ):
        OperationalEventService(
            repository=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


def test_record_rejects_none_event() -> None:
    """
    Validate required event input.
    """

    service, _ = create_service()

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Operational event cannot be None.",
    ):
        service.record(
            None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


def test_record_persists_and_returns_same_event() -> None:
    """
    Validate immutable event persistence.

    The service must return the exact event supplied by
    the caller after successful persistence.
    """

    service, repository = create_service()

    event = create_event()

    result = service.record(event)

                .PROVIDER_HEALTH_CHANGED

                .PROVIDER_RECOVERED

                OperationalEventType
                .AGENT_EXECUTION_FAILED
            ),
            severity=(
                OperationalEventSeverity.ERROR
            ),
            minute=3,
        ),
    )

    for event in events:
        service.record(event)

    result = service.list_events()

    assert result == events

from datetime import datetime, timezone

def create_observation(
    *,
    observed_at: datetime,
    consecutive_failures: int,
) -> ProviderHealthObservation:
    """
    Create deterministic provider health evidence.
    """

    return ProviderHealthObservation(
        provider="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability="conversation",
        status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
        observed_at=observed_at,
        latency_ms=5000,
        consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures,
        consecutive_successes=0,
        error_type="provider_unavailable",
        error_message="Provider health probe failed.",
    )

        OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
    )

    """

        create_operations_center_composition()
    )

    assert (
        composition.health_application_service
        is not None
    )


def test_health_observation_flows_through_shared_composition() -> None:
    """
    Validate that health ingestion and dashboard provider
    intelligence use the same composed health state.
    """

    composition = (
        create_operations_center_composition()
    )

    timestamps = (
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            0,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            1,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            2,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )

    composition.health_application_service.observe(
        create_observation(
            observed_at=timestamps[0],
            consecutive_failures=1,
        )
    )

    composition.health_application_service.observe(
        create_observation(
            observed_at=timestamps[1],
            consecutive_failures=2,
        )
    )

    result = (
        composition.health_application_service.observe(
            create_observation(
                observed_at=timestamps[2],
                consecutive_failures=3,
            )
        )
    )

    assert result.incident is not None

    dashboard = (
        composition.dashboard_api
        .get_dashboard()
    )

    providers = dashboard[
        "active_providers"
    ]

    assert len(providers) == 1

    assert (
        providers[0]["provider"]
        == "openai"
    )

    assert (
        providers[0]["model"]
        == "gpt-5-mini"
    )


def test_dashboard_api_backward_compatibility() -> None:
    """
    Validate the existing dashboard composition entry point.
    """

    api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    assert isinstance(
        api,
        OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center dashboard API tests.

Validates the thin API adapter boundary.

The API adapter must:

- delegate to the dashboard facade;
- expose the facade result unchanged;
- reject invalid provider input;
- reject a missing facade dependency;
- avoid introducing business logic;
- remain read-only.
"""

from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.operations_center_dashboard_facade import (
    OperationsCenterDashboardFacade,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operations_center_dashboard_service import (
    ActiveProvider,
)

from app.interfaces.provider_management.operations_center_dashboard_api import (
    OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
)


def create_active_providers() -> tuple[
    ActiveProvider,
    ...
]:
    """
    Create deterministic provider data.
    """

    return (
        ActiveProvider(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capabilities=(
                "conversation",
                "reasoning",
            ),
        ),
        ActiveProvider(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capabilities=(
                "summarisation",
            ),
        ),
    )


def create_facade_mock() -> Mock:
    """
    Create a facade test double.
    """

    facade = Mock(
        spec=OperationsCenterDashboardFacade
    )

    facade.get_dashboard.return_value = {
        "system_confidence": 85.0,
        "monitoring_status": "incident",
        "active_providers": [
            {
                "provider": "openai",
                "model": "gpt-5-mini",
                "capabilities": [
                    "conversation",
                    "reasoning",
                ],
                "active": True,
            }
        ],
        "active_escalations": 1,
        "pending_approvals": 1,
        "approved_escalations": 0,
        "rejected_escalations": 0,
        "pending_notifications": 0,
        "total_escalations": 1,
    }

    return facade


def test_api_delegates_to_facade() -> None:
    """
    Validate that dashboard generation is delegated to the
    application facade.
    """

    facade = create_facade_mock()

    api = OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
        facade=facade
    )

    providers = create_active_providers()

    result = api.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=providers
    )

    facade.get_dashboard.assert_called_once_with(
        active_providers=providers,
    )

    assert result == (
        facade.get_dashboard.return_value
    )


def test_api_returns_facade_result_unchanged() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the API adapter does not transform or
    alter the application contract.
    """

    facade = create_facade_mock()

    expected = {
        "system_confidence": 100.0,
        "monitoring_status": "healthy",
        "active_providers": [],
        "active_escalations": 0,
        "pending_approvals": 0,
        "approved_escalations": 0,
        "rejected_escalations": 0,
        "pending_notifications": 0,
        "total_escalations": 0,
    }

    facade.get_dashboard.return_value = (
        expected
    )

    api = OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
        facade=facade
    )

    result = api.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=()
    )

    assert result is expected


def test_api_rejects_none_active_providers() -> None:
    """
    Validate required provider input.
    """

    facade = create_facade_mock()

    api = OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
        facade=facade
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Active providers cannot be None.",
    ):
        api.get_dashboard(
            active_providers=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )

    facade.get_dashboard.assert_not_called()


def test_api_rejects_none_facade() -> None:
    """
    Validate dependency injection.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=(
            "Operations Center dashboard facade "
            "cannot be None."
        ),
    ):
        OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
            facade=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


def test_api_does_not_add_business_logic() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the API simply exposes the facade contract.

    The API must not calculate confidence, classify incidents,
    or interpret escalation state itself.
    """

    facade = create_facade_mock()

    facade.get_dashboard.return_value = {
        "system_confidence": 55.0,
        "monitoring_status": "incident",
        "active_providers": [],
        "active_escalations": 3,
        "pending_approvals": 2,
        "approved_escalations": 1,
        "rejected_escalations": 1,
        "pending_notifications": 1,
        "total_escalations": 5,
    }

    api = OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
        facade=facade
    )

    result = api.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=()
    )

    assert result[
        "system_confidence"
    ] == 55.0

    assert result[
        "active_escalations"
    ] == 3

    assert result[
        "pending_approvals"
    ] == 2

    assert result[
        "monitoring_status"
    ] == "incident"

    facade.get_dashboard.assert_called_once()


def test_api_is_read_only() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the API adapter only reads through the
    facade and has no mutation operation.
    """

    facade = create_facade_mock()

    api = OperationsCenterDashboardAPI(
        facade=facade
    )

    result = api.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=()
    )

    assert result is not None

    assert not hasattr(
        api,
        "approve",
    )

    assert not hasattr(
        api,
        "reject",
    )

    assert not hasattr(
        api,
        "update_provider",
    )

    assert not hasattr(
        api,
        "change_routing",
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center dashboard composition tests.

Validates the composition root for the Operations Center.

The composition must assemble:

Provider Health Monitor
        |
        v
Operations Center Provider Service
        |
        v
Dashboard Service
        |
        v
Dashboard Facade
        |
        v
Dashboard API

- preserve the existing Dashboard API contract.

    OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
)

    create_operations_center_dashboard_api,
)


def create_empty_dashboard(
    api: OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
) -> dict:
    """
    Build a deterministic empty dashboard using the current
    Dashboard API contract.

    Provider health integration is intentionally tested in
    a separate vertical slice.
    """

    return api.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=()
    )


def test_dashboard_composition_creates_api() -> None:

    )

        api,
        OperationsCenterDashboardAPI,
    )


def test_dashboard_composition_returns_usable_api() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the composed API can build a dashboard.

    No provider observations have been submitted yet, so the

    This test verifies the composition root without changing
    the existing Dashboard API contract.
    """

    api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    result = create_empty_dashboard(
        api
    )

    assert isinstance(
        result,
        dict,
    )

        result["system_confidence"]

    )

    assert (
        result["monitoring_status"]
        == "healthy"
    )

    assert (
        result["active_providers"]
        == []
    )

    assert (
        result["active_escalations"]
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result["pending_approvals"]
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result["approved_escalations"]
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result["rejected_escalations"]
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result["pending_notifications"]
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result["total_escalations"]
        == 0
    )


def test_dashboard_composition_is_read_only() -> None:
    """
    Validate that composing the dashboard does not itself
    perform provider operations or create operational state.
    """

    first_api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    second_api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    first_result = (
        create_empty_dashboard(
            first_api
        )
    )

    second_result = (
        create_empty_dashboard(
            second_api
        )
    )

    assert (
        first_result
        == second_result
    )


def test_dashboard_composition_creates_independent_instances() -> None:

    first_api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    second_api = (
        create_operations_center_dashboard_api()
    )

    )

"""

Validates the presentation-facing dashboard contract.

The facade must:

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_history_service import (

def create_workflow(
    *,
    escalation_id: str,
    status: EscalationWorkflowStatus,
    minute: int,
) -> EscalationWorkflow:
    """
    Create deterministic workflow data.
    """

    return EscalationWorkflow(
        escalation_id=escalation_id,
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            minute,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        notification_recipient=(
            "operations@example.com"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        notification_subject=(
            "EasyChatBot AI Operations Escalation"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        approved_at=None,
        rejected_at=None,
        decision_reason=None,
    )


def create_service() -> (
    tuple[
        OperationsCenterDashboardFacade,
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
    ]
):
    """
    Create the facade with its application dependencies.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository()
    )

    history_service = (
        EscalationHistoryService(
            repository=repository
        )
    )

    dashboard_service = (
        OperationsCenterDashboardService(
            history_service=history_service
        )
    )

    facade = OperationsCenterDashboardFacade(
        dashboard_service=dashboard_service
    )

    return facade, repository

def test_facade_result_is_json_safe() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the complete dashboard result consists
    only of JSON-compatible primitive/container values.

    This deliberately avoids importing a JSON framework so
    the application layer remains infrastructure-independent.
    """

    facade, repository = create_service()

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-001",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .AWAITING_APPROVAL
            ),
            minute=30,
        )
    )

    result = facade.get_dashboard(
        active_providers=(
            create_active_providers()
        )
    )

    def assert_json_safe(
        value: object,
    ) -> None:
        if value is None:
            return

        if isinstance(
            value,
            (
                str,
                int,
                float,
                bool,
            ),
        ):
            return

        if isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                assert_json_safe(item)
            return

        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for key, item in value.items():
                assert isinstance(
                    key,
                    str,
                )
                assert_json_safe(item)
            return

        raise AssertionError(
            "Dashboard contains a non-JSON-safe "
            f"value: {type(value)!r}"
        )

    assert_json_safe(result)


def test_facade_does_not_expose_internal_workflow_objects() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the presentation boundary returns plain
    dictionaries rather than internal workflow objects.
    """

    facade, repository = create_service()

    )

            value,
            EscalationWorkflow,
        )
        for value in result.values()
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center dashboard service tests.

Validates the read-only dashboard contract used by the
Operations Center.

Coverage:

- system confidence;
- monitoring status;
- active providers;
- active escalations;
- pending approvals;
- approved escalations;
- rejected escalations;
- pending notifications;
- total escalation counts.

The dashboard service must not modify workflow state.

Confidence model:

- 100 when there are no escalations;
- subtract 15 points per active escalation;
- pending approval is informational and is not
  penalised a second time;
- confidence cannot fall below 0.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_history_service import (
    EscalationHistoryService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_repository import (
    InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
)

from app.application.provider_management.escalation_workflow_service import (
    EscalationWorkflow,
    EscalationWorkflowStatus,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operations_center_dashboard_service import (
    ActiveProvider,
    MonitoringStatus,
    OperationsCenterDashboardService,
)


def create_workflow(
    *,
    escalation_id: str,
    status: EscalationWorkflowStatus,
    minute: int,
) -> EscalationWorkflow:
    """
    Create deterministic workflow data.
    """

    return EscalationWorkflow(
        escalation_id=escalation_id,
        status=status,
        created_at=datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            minute,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        notification_recipient=(
            "operations@example.com"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        notification_subject=(
            "EasyChatBot AI Operations Escalation"
            if status
            != EscalationWorkflowStatus
            .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            else None
        ),
        approved_at=(
            datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                15,
                minute,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            )
            if status
            == EscalationWorkflowStatus.APPROVED
            else None
        ),
        rejected_at=(
            datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                15,
                minute,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            )
            if status
            == EscalationWorkflowStatus.REJECTED
            else None
        ),
        decision_reason=(
            "Operations decision recorded."
            if status
            in (
                EscalationWorkflowStatus.APPROVED,
                EscalationWorkflowStatus.REJECTED,
            )
            else None
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> (
    tuple[
        OperationsCenterDashboardService,
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository,
    ]
):
    """
    Create a dashboard service and repository.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryEscalationWorkflowRepository()
    )

    history_service = (
        EscalationHistoryService(
            repository=repository
        )
    )

    dashboard_service = (
        OperationsCenterDashboardService(
            history_service=history_service
        )
    )

    return dashboard_service, repository

def test_multiple_workflow_states_are_aggregated() -> None:
    """
    Validate the complete dashboard aggregation.

    Active workflows:

        1 pending notification
        2 awaiting approval

    Therefore:

        active escalations = 3

    Confidence:

        100 - (3 * 15) = 55
    """

    service, repository = create_service()

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-001",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .PENDING_NOTIFICATION
            ),
            minute=30,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-002",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .AWAITING_APPROVAL
            ),
            minute=31,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-003",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .AWAITING_APPROVAL
            ),
            minute=32,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-004",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .APPROVED
            ),
            minute=33,
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_workflow(
            escalation_id="esc-005",
            status=(
                EscalationWorkflowStatus
                .REJECTED
            ),
            minute=34,
        )
    )

    dashboard = service.build_dashboard(
        active_providers=(
            create_active_providers()
        )
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.pending_notifications
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.pending_approvals
        == 2
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.active_escalations
        == 3
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.approved_escalations
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.rejected_escalations
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.total_escalations
        == 5
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.monitoring_status
        == MonitoringStatus.INCIDENT
    )

    assert (
        dashboard.system_confidence
        == 55.0
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center operational events API tests.

Validates the read-only application boundary for operational
event history.

The API must:
- require OperationalEventService;
- retrieve events through the application service;
- serialize OperationalEvent objects into stable dictionaries;
- serialize UUIDs and datetimes safely;
- serialize enum values as strings;
- preserve structured metadata;
- preserve event ordering;
- remain read-only.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event import (
    OperationalEvent,
    OperationalEventSeverity,
    OperationalEventType,
)
from app.application.provider_management.operational_event_service import (
    OperationalEventService,
)
from app.application.provider_management.operations_center_operational_events_api import (
    OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI,
)


def create_event(
    *,
    event_type: OperationalEventType = (
        OperationalEventType.PROVIDER_HEALTH_CHANGED
    ),
    severity: OperationalEventSeverity = (
        OperationalEventSeverity.INFO
    ),
    minute: int = 0,
    provider: str = "openai",
    correlation_id: str | None = "incident-001",
) -> OperationalEvent:
    """Create deterministic operational event data."""

    return OperationalEvent.create(
        event_type=event_type,
        severity=severity,
        source="provider_management",
        component="ProviderIncidentService",
        occurred_at=datetime(
            2026, 8, 15, 14, minute, tzinfo=timezone.utc
        ),
        message="Operational event test.",
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        metadata={
            "provider": provider,
            "environment": "test",
        },
    )


def create_service_mock(
    events: tuple[OperationalEvent, ...],
) -> Mock:
    """Create a controlled OperationalEventService test double."""

    service = Mock(spec=OperationalEventService)
    service.list_events.return_value = events
    return service


def test_api_requires_operational_event_service() -> None:
    """Validate the dependency boundary."""

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Operational event service cannot be None.",
    ):
        OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
            operational_event_service=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )


def test_list_events_delegates_to_operational_event_service() -> None:
    """Validate event retrieval delegation."""

    event = create_event()
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    api.list_events()

    service.list_events.assert_called_once_with()


def test_list_events_returns_empty_list_when_no_events_exist() -> None:
    """Validate empty operational-event history."""

    service = create_service_mock(())

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    assert api.list_events() == []


def test_list_events_serializes_event_identity() -> None:
    """Validate UUID serialization."""

    event = create_event()
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    result = api.list_events()

    assert result[0]["event_id"] == str(event.event_id)
    assert isinstance(result[0]["event_id"], str)


def test_list_events_serializes_enum_values() -> None:
    """Validate event type and severity serialization."""

    event = create_event(
        event_type=OperationalEventType.PROVIDER_INCIDENT_CREATED,
        severity=OperationalEventSeverity.CRITICAL,
    )
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    result = api.list_events()

    assert result[0]["event_type"] == "provider_incident_created"
    assert result[0]["severity"] == "critical"
    assert isinstance(result[0]["event_type"], str)
    assert isinstance(result[0]["severity"], str)


def test_list_events_serializes_datetime() -> None:
    """Validate timezone-aware timestamp serialization."""

    event = create_event(minute=7)
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,

def test_api_does_not_write_events() -> None:

    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    api.list_events()

    service.list_events.assert_called_once_with()

    assert not hasattr(api, "record")
    assert not hasattr(api, "create")
    assert not hasattr(api, "delete")


def test_serialized_event_is_json_safe() -> None:
    """Validate that the response contains JSON-safe values."""

    event = create_event(
        event_type=OperationalEventType.AGENT_EXECUTION_FAILED,
        severity=OperationalEventSeverity.ERROR,
    )
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    result = api.list_events()

    def assert_json_safe(value: object) -> None:
        if value is None:
            return

        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
            return

        if isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                assert_json_safe(item)
            return

        if isinstance(value, dict):
            for key, item in value.items():
                assert isinstance(key, str)
                assert_json_safe(item)
            return

        raise AssertionError(
            "Response contains a non-JSON-safe "
            f"value: {type(value)!r}"
        )

    assert_json_safe(result)


def test_serialized_event_does_not_expose_internal_objects() -> None:
    """Validate that UUIDs and enums do not cross the API boundary."""

    event = create_event()
    service = create_service_mock((event,))

    api = OperationsCenterOperationalEventsAPI(
        operational_event_service=service,
    )

    result = api.list_events()

    assert isinstance(result[0]["event_id"], str)
    assert isinstance(result[0]["event_type"], str)
    assert isinstance(result[0]["severity"], str)
    assert not isinstance(
        result[0]["event_type"],
        OperationalEventType,
    )
    assert not isinstance(
        result[0]["severity"],
        OperationalEventSeverity,
    )

            8,

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider comparison tests.

Validates:

Provider Usage Events
        |
        v
ProviderComparisonService
        |
        v
Provider / Model / Capability Analytics
        |
        v
Capability Optimisation Evidence

The comparison service is analytical only.

It does not:

- change provider routing;
- execute providers;
- approve recommendations;
- send notifications.
"""

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_comparison_service import (
    ProviderComparisonService,
)

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.models import (
    ProviderUsageEvent,
)


def create_event(
    *,
    provider: str,
    model: str,
    capability: str,
    input_tokens: int,
    output_tokens: int,
    latency_ms: int,
    cost: str,
    success: bool = True,
) -> ProviderUsageEvent:
    """
    Create deterministic provider usage data.
    """

    return ProviderUsageEvent(
        provider=provider,
        model=model,
        capability=capability,
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=input_tokens,
        output_tokens=output_tokens,
        latency_ms=latency_ms,
        estimated_cost=Decimal(cost),
        quality_score=95.0,
        success=success,
    )


def test_compare_groups_provider_model_and_capability() -> None:
    """
    Validate that comparison analytics keep provider,
    model and capability dimensions separate.
    """

    service = ProviderComparisonService()

    events = [
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=1000,
            output_tokens=500,
            latency_ms=800,
            cost="0.010",
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=1200,
            output_tokens=600,
            latency_ms=1000,
            cost="0.012",
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=900,
            output_tokens=400,
            latency_ms=700,
            cost="0.007",
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="summarisation",
            input_tokens=900,
            output_tokens=300,
            latency_ms=600,
            cost="0.006",
        ),
    ]

    comparisons = service.compare(
        events=events
    )

    assert len(comparisons) == 3

    keys = {
        (
            comparison.provider,
            comparison.model,
            comparison.capability,
        )
        for comparison in comparisons
    }

    assert keys == {
        (
            "openai",
            "gpt-5-mini",
            "conversation",
        ),
        (
            "gemini",
            "gemini-2.5-flash",
            "conversation",
        ),
        (
            "gemini",
            "gemini-2.5-flash",
            "summarisation",
        ),
    }


def test_compare_calculates_operational_metrics() -> None:
    """
    Validate token, latency, success and cost calculations.
    """

    service = ProviderComparisonService()

    events = [
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=1000,
            output_tokens=500,
            latency_ms=800,
            cost="0.010",
            success=True,
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=1200,
            output_tokens=600,
            latency_ms=1000,
            cost="0.012",
            success=False,
        ),
    ]

    comparisons = service.compare(
        events=events
    )

    assert len(comparisons) == 1

    comparison = comparisons[0]

    assert comparison.provider == "openai"

    assert comparison.model == "gpt-5-mini"

    assert comparison.capability == "conversation"

    assert comparison.total_requests == 2

    assert comparison.successful_requests == 1

    assert comparison.success_rate == 50.0

    assert comparison.total_input_tokens == 2200

    assert comparison.total_output_tokens == 1100

    assert comparison.total_tokens == 3300

    assert comparison.average_latency_ms == 900.0

    assert comparison.total_cost == Decimal(
        "0.022"
    )

    assert comparison.average_cost_per_request == (
        Decimal("0.011")
    )


def test_compare_capability_filters_other_capabilities() -> None:
    """
    Validate capability-specific comparison.

    This is critical for adaptive optimisation:
    conversation performance must not be mixed with
    summarisation performance.
    """

    service = ProviderComparisonService()

    events = [
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=1000,
            output_tokens=500,
            latency_ms=800,
            cost="0.010",
        ),
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",

            capability="conversation",
            input_tokens=900,
            output_tokens=400,
            latency_ms=700,
            cost="0.007",
        ),

            provider="gemini",
            model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            capability="summarisation",
            input_tokens=800,
            output_tokens=300,
            latency_ms=600,
            cost="0.006",

    comparisons = (

    }

def test_none_events_are_rejected() -> None:
    """
    Validate required usage-event input.
    """

"""
Tests for ProviderHealthApplicationService.

The tests verify that the application service coordinates
the existing provider health monitor and incident service
without creating a second health-state authority.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_application_service import (
    ProviderHealthApplicationService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthObservation,
    ProviderHealthStatus,
    ProviderHealthTransition,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_monitor_service import (
    ProviderHealthMonitorService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_incident_service import (
    InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository,
    ProviderIncidentService,
)


def create_observation(
    *,
    observed_at: datetime,
    consecutive_failures: int,
) -> ProviderHealthObservation:
    """
    Create deterministic provider health evidence.
    """

    return ProviderHealthObservation(
        provider="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability="conversation",
        status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
        observed_at=observed_at,
        latency_ms=5000,
        consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures,
        consecutive_successes=0,
        error_type="provider_unavailable",
        error_message="Provider health probe failed.",
    )


def create_service() -> (
    ProviderHealthApplicationService
):
    """
    Create the application service using the existing health
    monitor as the single health-state owner.
    """

    health_monitor = (
        ProviderHealthMonitorService()
    )

    incident_repository = (
        InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository()
    )

    incident_service = (
        ProviderIncidentService(
            repository=incident_repository
        )
    )

    return (
        ProviderHealthApplicationService(
            health_monitor=health_monitor,
            incident_service=incident_service,
        )
    )

    )

def test_unavailable_transition_creates_incident() -> None:
    """
    Validate the complete health-to-incident application flow.
    """

    service = create_service()

    timestamps = (
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            0,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            1,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            2,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )

    first = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            observed_at=timestamps[0],
            consecutive_failures=1,
        )
    )

    second = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            observed_at=timestamps[1],
            consecutive_failures=2,
        )
    )

    assert second.incident is None

    assert (

        == ProviderHealthTransition.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (

        is not None
    )

        third.incident.provider
        == "openai"
    )

        third.incident.is_open
        is True
    )

def create_incident(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    status: ProviderHealthStatus = (
        ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    ),
    consecutive_failures: int = 3,
    capabilities: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "conversation",
    ),
) -> ProviderIncident:
    """
    Create a deterministic provider incident.
    """

    started_at = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        14,
        14,

        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    observed_at = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        14,
        14,
        35,
        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    return ProviderIncident(
        incident_id="incident-001",
        provider=provider,
        status=status,
        started_at=started_at,

        recovered_at=None,

        consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures,

    )

def create_observation(
    latency_ms: int = 100,

    return ProviderHealthObservation(
        provider="ollama",
        model="gpt-oss:120b",

        status=ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY,
        observed_at=datetime.now(

    )


def test_save_and_retrieve_observation():

    repository = (
        ProviderHealthHistoryRepository()
    )

    repository.save(
        observation
    )

    result = repository.get_all()

    assert len(result) == 1

    assert (

        == "ollama"
    )


def test_latest_returns_latest_provider_observation():

    repository = (
        ProviderHealthHistoryRepository()
    )

    repository.save(
        create_observation(
            latency_ms=100
        )
    )

    repository.save(
        create_observation(
            latency_ms=200
        )
    )

    latest = repository.latest(
        "ollama"
    )

    assert latest is not None

    assert (
        latest.latency_ms
        == 200
    )

        == ()
    )

    )

        create_observation()
    )

    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider health monitor tests.

Validates the vertical flow:

ProviderHealthObservation
        |
        v
ProviderHealthService
        |
        v
ProviderHealthMonitorService
        |
        v
ProviderHealthReadModel

The monitor must:

- delegate health calculation;
- retain latest observation metadata;
- expose provider health read models;
- support multiple providers;
- preserve provider/model/capability attribution;
- track provider failure and recovery;
- remain read-only from an operational perspective.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthObservation,
    ProviderHealthStatus,
    ProviderHealthTransition,
)

    ProviderHealthMonitorService,
)

    consecutive_successes: int = 0,
) -> ProviderHealthObservation:

    )

def test_unavailable_provider_is_exposed() -> None:
    """
    Validate three consecutive failures produce an
    unavailable provider projection.
    """

    service = ProviderHealthMonitorService()

    timestamps = (
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            30,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            31,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            32,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )

    for index, timestamp in enumerate(
        timestamps,
        start=1,
    ):
        service.observe(
            create_observation(
                provider="openai",
                model="gpt-5-mini",
                capability="conversation",
                status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
                observed_at=timestamp,
                consecutive_failures=index,
            )
        )

    result = service.get_provider_health(
        "openai"
    )

    assert result is not None

    assert (
        result.status
        == "unavailable"
    )

    assert (
        result.consecutive_failures
        == 3
    )

    assert (
        result.unavailable_since
        == timestamps[-1]
    )


def test_recovery_updates_provider_health() -> None:
    """
    Validate successful recovery updates the read model.

    Provider outage:

        10:32

    Provider recovery:

        10:39

    The current health contract treats the first healthy
    observation as recovery.
    """

    service = ProviderHealthMonitorService()

    recovery_time = datetime(
        2026,
        8,
        15,
        10,
        39,
        tzinfo=timezone.utc,
    )

    failure_timestamps = (
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            30,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            31,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
        datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            10,
            32,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        ),
    )

    failure_transitions = []

    for index, timestamp in enumerate(
        failure_timestamps,
        start=1,
    ):
        failure_transitions.append(
            service.observe(
                create_observation(
                    provider="openai",
                    model="gpt-5-mini",
                    capability="conversation",
                    status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
                    observed_at=timestamp,
                    consecutive_failures=index,
                )
            )
        )

    assert (
        failure_transitions[-1].transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    recovery_transition = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY,
            observed_at=recovery_time,
            consecutive_successes=1,
        )
    )

    assert (
        recovery_transition.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.RECOVERED
    )

    result = service.get_provider_health(
        "openai"
    )

    assert result is not None

    assert (
        result.status
        == "healthy"
    )

    assert (
        result.consecutive_failures
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        result.consecutive_successes
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        result.last_success_at
        == recovery_time
    )

    assert (
        result.unavailable_since
        is None
    )

    assert (
        result.degraded_since
        is None
    )
