"""
Tests for the EasyChatBot provider health probe runner.

The tests use fake probes and never call external providers.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_application_service import (
    ProviderHealthApplicationService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_probe_runner import (
    ProviderHealthProbeRunner,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthObservation,
    ProviderHealthStatus,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_monitor_service import (
    ProviderHealthMonitorService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_incident_service import (
    InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository,
    ProviderIncidentService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthStatus,
)


class FakeProbe:
    """
    Deterministic provider health probe.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        provider: str = "openai",
        model: str = "gpt-5-mini",
        capability: str = "conversation",
        status: ProviderHealthStatus = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
        ),
        error: Exception | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._provider = provider
        self._model = model
        self._capability = capability
        self._status = status
        self._error = error

    @property
    def provider(self) -> str:
        return self._provider

    @property
    def model(self) -> str | None:
        return self._model

    @property
    def capability(self) -> str | None:
        return self._capability

    async def check(
        self,
    ) -> ProviderHealthObservation:
        if self._error is not None:
            raise self._error

        return ProviderHealthObservation(
            provider=self._provider,
            model=self._model,
            capability=self._capability,
            status=self._status,
            observed_at=datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                16,
                10,
                0,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            ),
            latency_ms=125,
            consecutive_failures=0,
            consecutive_successes=1,
        )


def create_runner(
    probes,
) -> ProviderHealthProbeRunner:
    """
    Build the runner using the real application boundary.
    """

    monitor = (
        ProviderHealthMonitorService()
    )

    incident_repository = (
        InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository()
    )

    incident_service = (
        ProviderIncidentService(
            repository=incident_repository
        )
    )

    health_application_service = (
        ProviderHealthApplicationService(
            health_monitor=monitor,
            incident_service=incident_service,
        )
    )

    return ProviderHealthProbeRunner(
        health_application_service=(
            health_application_service
        ),
        probes=probes,
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_runner_submits_healthy_observation() -> None:
    """
    A successful probe must flow through the existing
    ProviderHealthApplicationService.
    """

    runner = create_runner(
        [
            FakeProbe(
                provider="openai",
            )
        ]
    )

    results = await runner.run_all()

    assert len(results) == 1

    result = results[0]

    assert (
        result.observation.provider
        == "openai"
    )

    assert (
        result.observation.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
    )

    assert (
        result.observation.latency_ms
        == 125
    )

    assert (
        result.application_result.provider
        == "openai"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_runner_supports_multiple_providers() -> None:
    """
    Multiple provider probes must remain isolated.
    """

    runner = create_runner(
        [
            FakeProbe(
                provider="openai",
                model="gpt-5-mini",
            ),
            FakeProbe(
                provider="gemini",
                model="gemini-2.5-flash",
            ),
            FakeProbe(
                provider="parallel",
                model=None,
                capability="search",
            ),
            FakeProbe(
                provider="ollama",
                model="gemma4",
            ),
        ]
    )

    results = await runner.run_all()

    assert [
        result.observation.provider
        for result in results
    ] == [
        "openai",
        "gemini",
        "parallel",
        "ollama",
    ]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_probe_failure_becomes_unavailable_observation() -> None:
    """
    A provider probe exception must become a controlled
    provider-independent unavailable observation.
    """

    runner = create_runner(
        [
            FakeProbe(
                provider="ollama",
                model="gemma4",
                error=RuntimeError(
                    "Ollama service unavailable"
                ),
            )
        ]
    )

    results = await runner.run_all()

    assert len(results) == 1

    observation = (
        results[0].observation
    )

    assert (
        observation.provider
        == "ollama"
    )

    assert (
        observation.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        observation.error_type
        == "RuntimeError"
    )

    assert (
        observation.error_message
        == "Ollama service unavailable"
    )

    assert (
        observation.consecutive_failures
        == 1
    )


def test_runner_rejects_duplicate_providers() -> None:
    """

- reject mismatched provider state;
- remain free of health calculation logic.
"""

    return ProviderHealthObservation(

        observed_at=datetime(
            2026,

        latency_ms=1800,
        error_type="provider_timeout",

        10,
        30,

    return ProviderHealthState(
        provider="openai",
        status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
        checked_at=checked_at,
        consecutive_failures=2,
        consecutive_successes=0,
        last_success_at=None,
        last_failure_at=last_failure_at,
        degraded_since=degraded_since,
        unavailable_since=None,
    )

"""
Tests for ProviderHealthRefreshService.

The refresh service is an orchestration boundary. These tests verify
that it delegates to the existing ProviderHealthProbeRunner and
returns the runner result unchanged.

No external provider is called.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_refresh_service import (
    ProviderHealthRefreshService,
)


class FakeProbeRunner:
    """Minimal test double for ProviderHealthProbeRunner."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = 0
        self.result = (
            "provider-health-result",
        )

    async def run_all(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.result


def test_refresh_delegates_to_probe_runner() -> None:
    runner = FakeProbeRunner()

    service = ProviderHealthRefreshService(
        probe_runner=runner,
    )

    result = asyncio.run(
        service.refresh()
    )

    assert runner.calls == 1
    assert result == runner.result


def test_refresh_service_rejects_missing_runner() -> None:
    try:
        ProviderHealthRefreshService(
            probe_runner=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert (
            str(exc)
            == "Provider health probe runner cannot be None."
        )
    else:
        raise AssertionError(
            "Expected ValueError for missing probe runner."
        )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider health tests.

Validates:

Provider Health Observation
        |
        v
ProviderHealthService
        |
        +----------------------+
        |                      |
        v                      v
Provider Health State   Health Transition
        |                      |
        +----------+-----------+
                   |
                   v
          Provider Incident
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthObservation,
    ProviderHealthStatus,
    ProviderHealthTransition,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_service import (
    ProviderHealthService,
)


def create_observation(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    status: ProviderHealthStatus = (
        ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
    ),
    observed_at: datetime | None = None,
    capability: str | None = "conversation",
    consecutive_failures: int = 0,
    consecutive_successes: int = 1,
) -> ProviderHealthObservation:
    """
    Create deterministic provider health evidence.
    """

    if observed_at is None:
        observed_at = datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            32,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )

    return ProviderHealthObservation(
        provider=provider,
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability=capability,
        status=status,
        observed_at=observed_at,
        latency_ms=800,
        consecutive_failures=(
            consecutive_failures
        ),
        consecutive_successes=(
            consecutive_successes
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> ProviderHealthService:
    """
    Create a fresh health service.
    """

    return ProviderHealthService()


def test_first_failure_creates_degraded_state() -> None:
    """
    Validate that the first failure produces a degraded
    provider state rather than an immediate outage.
    """

    service = create_service()

    event = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=1,
            consecutive_successes=0,
        )
    )

    state = service.get_state("openai")

    assert state is not None

    assert (
        state.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED
    )

    assert (
        event.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.DEGRADED
    )

    assert (
        event.current_status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED
    )

    assert (
        event.consecutive_failures
        == 1
    )


def test_three_consecutive_failures_create_unavailable_state() -> None:
    """
    Validate the outage threshold.

    Three consecutive failures must move the provider
    from degraded to unavailable.
    """

    service = create_service()

    first = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=1,
            consecutive_successes=0,
        )
    )

    second = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=2,
            consecutive_successes=0,
            observed_at=datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                14,
                33,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            ),
        )
    )

    third = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=3,
            consecutive_successes=0,
            observed_at=datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                14,
                34,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            ),
        )
    )

    state = service.get_state("openai")

    assert state is not None

    assert (
        first.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.DEGRADED
    )

    assert (
        second.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.DEGRADED
    )

    assert (
        third.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        state.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        state.consecutive_failures
        == 3
    )

    assert (
        state.unavailable_since
        == datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            34,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )
    )


def test_successful_observation_recovers_provider() -> None:
    """
    Validate provider recovery.

    A successful observation after an outage returns
    the provider to healthy state and generates a
    recovered transition.
    """

    service = create_service()

    service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=1,
            consecutive_successes=0,
        )
    )

    service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=2,
            consecutive_successes=0,
        )
    )

    service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED,
            consecutive_failures=3,
            consecutive_successes=0,
        )
    )

    recovery = service.observe(
        create_observation(
            status=ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY,
            consecutive_failures=0,
            consecutive_successes=1,
            observed_at=datetime(
                2026,
                8,
                14,
                14,
                35,
                tzinfo=timezone.utc,
            ),
        )
    )

    state = service.get_state("openai")

    assert state is not None

    assert (
        state.status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
    )

    assert (
        recovery.transition
        == ProviderHealthTransition.RECOVERED
    )

    assert (
        recovery.previous_status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    )

    assert (
        recovery.current_status
        == ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
    )

    assert (
        state.last_success_at
        == datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            35,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )
    )

    assert (
        state.unavailable_since
        is None
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider incident tests.

Validates:

Provider Health
        |
        v
Health Transition
        |
        v
Provider Incident Service
        |
        +----------------------+
        |                      |
        v                      v
Open Incident             Recover Incident
        |                      |
        +----------+-----------+
                   |
                   v
             Downtime History

Operational integration:

Provider Incident Service
        |
        +------------------------------+
        |                              |
        v                              v
Incident Repository          Operational Event Service
                                      |
                                      v
                              Operations Center

The incident service does not:

- execute providers;
- change Runtime routing;
- send emails;
- approve recommendations;
- perform autonomous failover.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.provider_operational_event_service import (
    ProviderOperationalEventService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthStatus,
    ProviderHealthTransition,
    ProviderHealthTransitionEvent,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_incident_service import (
    InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository,
    ProviderIncidentService,
)


def create_transition(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    transition: ProviderHealthTransition = (
        ProviderHealthTransition.UNAVAILABLE
    ),
    occurred_at: datetime | None = None,
    consecutive_failures: int = 3,
    consecutive_successes: int = 0,
    capabilities: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "conversation",
    ),
) -> ProviderHealthTransitionEvent:
    """
    Create a deterministic health transition.
    """

    if occurred_at is None:
        occurred_at = datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            14,
            14,
            32,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )

    if transition == (
        ProviderHealthTransition.UNAVAILABLE
    ):
        previous_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED
        )
        current_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
        )

    elif transition == (
        ProviderHealthTransition.RECOVERED
    ):
        previous_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
        )
        current_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
        )

    elif transition == (
        ProviderHealthTransition.DEGRADED
    ):
        previous_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.HEALTHY
        )
        current_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.DEGRADED
        )

    else:
        previous_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.UNKNOWN
        )
        current_status = (
            ProviderHealthStatus.UNKNOWN
        )

    return ProviderHealthTransitionEvent(
        provider=provider,
        transition=transition,
        previous_status=previous_status,
        current_status=current_status,
        occurred_at=occurred_at,
        consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures,
        consecutive_successes=consecutive_successes,
        affected_capabilities=capabilities,
    )


def create_service(
    *,
    operational_event_service: (
        ProviderOperationalEventService | None
    ) = None,
) -> ProviderIncidentService:
    """
    Create an incident service with an in-memory repository.

    The operational event service is optional so that the
    existing incident tests continue to exercise the incident
    service independently from the Operations Center.
    """

    repository = (
        InMemoryProviderIncidentRepository()
    )

    return ProviderIncidentService(
        repository=repository,
        operational_event_service=(
            operational_event_service
        ),
    )


def create_operational_event_mock() -> Mock:
    """
    Create a deterministic operational event service double.
    """

    return Mock(
        spec=ProviderOperationalEventService,
    )

"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider operational event tests.

Validates the provider-specific adapter between:

Provider Incident
        |
        v
ProviderOperationalEventService
        |
        v
OperationalEventService
        |
        v
OperationalEvent

The adapter must:

- create PROVIDER_INCIDENT_CREATED events;
- create PROVIDER_RECOVERED events;
- preserve incident correlation;
- preserve provider metadata;
- delegate persistence to OperationalEventService;
- reject invalid input;
- remain read-only with respect to provider state.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from unittest.mock import Mock

import pytest

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event import (
    OperationalEvent,
    OperationalEventSeverity,
    OperationalEventType,
)

from app.application.provider_management.operational_event_service import (
    OperationalEventService,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthStatus,
    ProviderIncident,
)

from app.application.provider_management.provider_operational_event_service import (
    ProviderOperationalEventService,
)


def create_incident(
    *,
    incident_id: str = "incident-001",
    provider: str = "openai",
    status: ProviderHealthStatus = (
        ProviderHealthStatus.UNAVAILABLE
    ),
    started_at: datetime | None = None,
    recovered_at: datetime | None = None,
    capabilities: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "conversation",
    ),
    consecutive_failures: int = 3,
) -> ProviderIncident:
    """
    Create deterministic provider incident data.
    """

    if started_at is None:
        started_at = datetime(
            2026,
            8,
            15,
            14,
            0,
            tzinfo=timezone.utc,
        )

    return ProviderIncident(
        incident_id=incident_id,
        provider=provider,
        status=status,
        started_at=started_at,
        last_observed_at=(
            recovered_at
            if recovered_at is not None
            else started_at
        ),
        recovered_at=recovered_at,
        affected_capabilities=capabilities,
        consecutive_failures=consecutive_failures,
        resolution_message=(
            "Provider recovered."
            if recovered_at is not None
            else None
        ),
    )


def create_service() -> tuple[
    ProviderOperationalEventService,
    Mock,
]:
    """
    Create the provider operational event adapter with a
    controlled generic operational event service.
    """

    operational_event_service = Mock(
        spec=OperationalEventService,
    )

    operational_event_service.record.side_effect = (
        lambda event: event
    )

    service = ProviderOperationalEventService(
        operational_event_service=(
            operational_event_service
        )
    )

    return (
        service,
        operational_event_service,
    )


def test_incident_created_creates_operational_event() -> None:
    """
    Validate provider incident creation mapping.
    """

    service, _ = create_service()

    incident = create_incident()

    result = service.record_incident_created(
        incident=incident,
    )

    assert isinstance(
        result,
        OperationalEvent,
    )

"""
===============================================================================

File
----
tests/application/voice/test_voice_asset_repository_integration.py


Purpose
-------
Regression tests for voice asset repository integration.


Architecture Flow
-----------------

Voice Registry

        |

        v

Voice Asset Repository

        |

        v

Voice Runtime / Generation


Validated Behaviour
-------------------

âœ“ Voice assets can be stored

âœ“ Voice assets can be retrieved

âœ“ Character identity is preserved

âœ“ Language versioning is preserved

âœ“ Provider references are preserved

âœ“ Missing assets fail safely


Engineering Principles
----------------------

- Clean Architecture
- Repository abstraction
- Asset traceability
- Provider independence


===============================================================================
"""


from __future__ import annotations


from dataclasses import dataclass





# ============================================================================
# Domain Simulation
# ============================================================================


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VoiceAsset:

    asset_id: str

    character_id: str

    language_code: str

    voice_identity_id: str

    provider_name: str

    version: str

    artifact_uri: str





# ============================================================================
# Repository Simulation
# ============================================================================


class FakeVoiceAssetRepository:
    """
    Voice asset persistence boundary.
    """


    def __init__(self):

        self.assets = {}



    def save(
        self,
        asset: VoiceAsset,
    ):

        self.assets[

            asset.asset_id

        ] = asset



    def get(
        self,
        asset_id: str,
    ):

        return self.assets.get(
            asset_id
        )





# ============================================================================
# Application Service
# ============================================================================


class VoiceAssetRepositoryService:
    """
    Application service coordinating
    voice asset storage and retrieval.
    """


    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        repository,
    ):

        self._repository = repository



    def register_asset(
        self,
        *,
        asset: VoiceAsset,
    ):

        self._repository.save(
            asset
        )

        return asset



    def retrieve_asset(
        self,
        *,
        asset_id: str,
    ):


        asset = self._repository.get(
            asset_id
        )


        if asset is None:

            raise ValueError(
                "Voice asset not found."
            )


        return asset





# ============================================================================
# Fixtures
# ============================================================================


def create_service():


    repository = FakeVoiceAssetRepository()


    service = VoiceAssetRepositoryService(

        repository=repository,

    )


    return service





def create_asset():


    return VoiceAsset(

        asset_id="asset-clara-fr-v1",

        character_id="clara",

        language_code="fr-FR",

        voice_identity_id="voice-clara-fr",

        provider_name="openai",

        version="v1",

        artifact_uri=(
            "storage://voices/clara/fr/v1"
        ),

    )





# ============================================================================
# Tests
# ============================================================================


def test_voice_asset_can_be_registered():


    service = create_service()


    result = service.register_asset(

        asset=create_asset()

    )


    assert result.asset_id == (
        "asset-clara-fr-v1"
    )


    assert result.character_id == (
        "clara"
    )





def test_voice_asset_can_be_retrieved():


    service = create_service()


    service.register_asset(

        asset=create_asset()

    )


    result = service.retrieve_asset(

        asset_id="asset-clara-fr-v1"

    )


    assert result.voice_identity_id == (

        "voice-clara-fr"

    )





def test_asset_preserves_language_information():


    service = create_service()


    service.register_asset(

        asset=create_asset()

    )


    result = service.retrieve_asset(

        asset_id="asset-clara-fr-v1"

    )


    assert result.language_code == (

        "fr-FR"

    )


    assert result.version == "v1"





def test_asset_preserves_provider_reference():


    service = create_service()


    service.register_asset(

        asset=create_asset()

    )


    result = service.retrieve_asset(

        asset_id="asset-clara-fr-v1"

    )


    assert result.provider_name == (

        "openai"

    )





def test_missing_voice_asset_fails_safely():


    service = create_service()


    try:

        service.retrieve_asset(

            asset_id="missing"

        )


        assert False, (

    except ValueError as exc:

# ============================================================================
# Fake Quality Evaluation Boundary
# ============================================================================


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VoiceQualityResult:
    """
    Result returned by quality evaluation.
    """

    score: float

    passed: bool

    metadata: dict





class FakeVoiceQualityEvaluator:
    """
    Fake quality evaluator boundary.

    Production implementation can later connect
    to the Quality Management framework.
    """


    def __init__(self):

        self.received_audio = None

        self.received_metadata = None



    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        audio,
        metadata,
    ):

        self.received_audio = audio

        self.received_metadata = metadata


        return VoiceQualityResult(

            score=95.0,

            passed=True,

            metadata=metadata,

        )





class FailingVoiceQualityEvaluator:
    """
    Fake failing evaluator.
    """


    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        audio,
        metadata,
    ):

        raise RuntimeError(
            "Quality evaluation unavailable."
        )





# ============================================================================
# Tests
# ============================================================================

    result = evaluator.evaluate(

        audio=b"generated-audio",

        metadata={

            "character_id": "clara",

            "language": "French",

        },

    )


    assert evaluator.received_audio == (
        b"generated-audio"
    )


    assert result.passed is True

    metadata = {

        audio=b"audio",

        metadata=metadata,

    )


    assert (
        result.metadata
        ==
        metadata
    )


    assert (
        evaluator.received_metadata
        ==
        metadata
    )





def test_voice_quality_score_is_traceable():

    evaluator = FakeVoiceQualityEvaluator()


    result = evaluator.evaluate(

        audio=b"audio",

        metadata={

            "trace_id": "trace-001"

        },

    )


    assert result.score == 95.0


    assert (
        result.metadata["trace_id"]
        ==
        "trace-001"
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.app.interfaces.telegram.beta_telegram_private_chat_gate import (
    BetaTelegramPrivateChatGate,
)


class FakeBetaAccessService:
    """Minimal Beta access boundary used by these E2E-style tests."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        approved: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self.approved = approved
        self.calls: list[dict] = []
        self.authorization_calls: list[int] = []

    async def validate_and_bind(
        self,
        *,
        token: str,
        telegram_id: int,
        chat_id: int,
    ):
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "token": token,
                "telegram_id": telegram_id,
                "chat_id": chat_id,
            }
        )

        if not self.approved:
            raise PermissionError(
                "Beta access is not approved."
            )

        return object()

    async def authorize_private_chat(
        self,
        telegram_user_id: int,
    ) -> None:
        """Match the existing BetaPrivateChatGate contract."""

        self.authorization_calls.append(
            telegram_user_id
        )

        if not self.approved:
            raise PermissionError(
                "Beta access is not approved."
            )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_beta_telegram_access_binds_approved_user():
    access = FakeBetaAccessService(
        approved=True,
    )

    result = await access.validate_and_bind(
        token="beta-token",
        telegram_id=123,
        chat_id=456,
    )

    assert result is not None

    assert access.calls == [
        {
            "token": "beta-token",
            "telegram_id": 123,
            "chat_id": 456,
        }
    ]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_beta_telegram_access_rejects_unapproved_user():
    access = FakeBetaAccessService(
        approved=False,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        PermissionError,
        match="Beta access is not approved",
    ):
        await access.validate_and_bind(
            token="beta-token",
            telegram_id=123,
            chat_id=456,
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_beta_telegram_access_does_not_select_world():
    access = FakeBetaAccessService(
        approved=True,
    )

    await access.validate_and_bind(
        token="beta-token",
        telegram_id=123,
        chat_id=456,
    )

    # WS-01 contract:
    # Telegram identity binding does not onboard or select a World.
    assert not hasattr(
        access,
        "select_world",
    )

    assert not hasattr(
        access,
        "change_world",
    )

    assert not hasattr(
        access,
        "switch_world",
    )


def test_private_chat_gate_requires_service():
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="beta_access_service",
    ):
        BetaTelegramPrivateChatGate(
            beta_access_service=None,
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_chat_gate_blocks_group_chat():
    access = FakeBetaAccessService(
        approved=True,
    )

    gate = BetaTelegramPrivateChatGate(
        beta_access_service=access,
    )

    allowed = await gate.authorize(
        telegram_user_id=123,
        chat_type="group",
    )

    assert allowed is False

    # The gate must reject the transport boundary before
    # asking the Beta access service to authorize the user.
    assert access.authorization_calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_private_chat_gate_allows_private_chat_for_approved_user():
    access = FakeBetaAccessService(
        approved=True,
    )

    gate = BetaTelegramPrivateChatGate(
        beta_access_service=access,
    )

    allowed = await gate.authorize(
        telegram_user_id=123,
        chat_type="private",
    )

    assert allowed is True

    assert access.authorization_calls == [
        123
    ]

            user_prompt=" ",
        )


def test_conversation_request_rejects_blank_context():

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="conversation_context cannot be blank",
    ):
        ConversationRequest(
            system_instruction="You are helpful.",
            user_prompt="Explain AI",
            conversation_context=" ",
        )


def test_conversation_request_summary_is_safe():

    request = ConversationRequest(
        system_instruction="You are helpful.",
        user_prompt="Explain AI.",
        conversation_context="Private context.",
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
    )

    summary = request.summary()

    assert summary["character_id"] == "yeti"

    assert summary["character_name"] == "Yeti"

    assert summary["has_context"] == "True"

    assert "Private context." not in summary

    assert "Explain AI." not in summary

"""
Tests for APScheduler adapter boundary.

Uses fake scheduler to avoid infrastructure dependency.
"""

import pytest


from backend.cybersecurity.scheduler.cybersecurity_apscheduler_adapter import (
    CybersecurityAPSchedulerAdapter,
)


class FakeScheduler:

    def __init__(self):
        self.jobs = []
        self.running = False


    def add_job(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.jobs.append(kwargs)


    def start(self):
        self.running = True


    def shutdown(self):
        self.running = False



class FakeWorkflow:

    async def create_daily_report(self, data=None):
        return data


    async def create_weekly_report(self, data=None):
        return data



def test_apscheduler_registers_jobs():

    scheduler = FakeScheduler()

    adapter = CybersecurityAPSchedulerAdapter(
        scheduler=scheduler,
        workflow_service=FakeWorkflow(),
    )

    adapter.register_jobs()

    assert len(scheduler.jobs) == 2



@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_runtime_with_scheduler_adapter():

    scheduler = FakeScheduler()

    adapter = CybersecurityAPSchedulerAdapter(
        scheduler=scheduler,
        workflow_service=FakeWorkflow(),
    )

    from backend.cybersecurity.scheduler.cybersecurity_scheduler_runtime import (
        CybersecuritySchedulerRuntime,
    )

    runtime = CybersecuritySchedulerRuntime(
        adapter
    )

    await runtime.start()

    assert runtime.status()["started"] is True

    await runtime.stop()

    assert runtime.status()["started"] is False

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_history import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_policy import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_scheduler import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Case:
    case_id: str
    governance_status: str
    triggered_at: datetime
    title: str = "New learner data processing"
    change_id: str = "PCR-001"
    risk: str = "MEDIUM"
    validation_status: str = "PASS"


class FakeRegistry:
    def __init__(self, cases):
        self._cases = tuple(cases)

    def all(self):
        return self._cases

    def get(self, case_id):
        return next(c for c in self._cases if c.case_id == case_id)


class FakeEmail:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = 0

    async def send_governance_reminder(self, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return {
            "status": "sent",
            "reference": f"MSG-{self.calls}",
            "case_url": (
                "http://127.0.0.1:5173/privacy-governance/"
                f"{kwargs['case'].case_id}"
            ),
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_due_pending_case_sends_once_within_cooldown():
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-001",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(hours=25),
    )
    email = FakeEmail()

    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=FakeRegistry([case]),
        policy=PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24),
            cooldown=timedelta(hours=24),
        ),
        history=PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory(),
        email_service=email,
    )

    first = await scheduler.run(now=now)
    second = await scheduler.run(
        now=now + timedelta(hours=1),
    )

    assert first[0].status == "REMINDER_SENT"
    assert second[0].status == "NOT_DUE"
    assert email.calls == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approved_case_never_sends():
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-APPROVED",
        governance_status="APPROVED",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=5),
    )
    email = FakeEmail()

    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=FakeRegistry([case]),
        policy=PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(),
        ),
        history=PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory(),
        email_service=email,
    )

    result = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert result[0].status == "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
    assert email.calls == 0


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_blocked_case_never_sends():
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-BLOCKED",
        governance_status="BLOCKED",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=5),
    )
    email = FakeEmail()

    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=FakeRegistry([case]),
        policy=PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(),
        ),
        history=PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory(),
        email_service=email,
    )

    result = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert result[0].status == "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
    assert email.calls == 0

============================================================
"""
Cybersecurity Delivery Control tests.

Validates the human governance kill switch for
cybersecurity notification delivery.

Tests:
- initial active state;
- pause;
- paused status;
- resume;
- restored active state.
"""

from __future__ import annotations


from backend.cybersecurity.control.cybersecurity_delivery_control import (
    CybersecurityDeliveryControl,
)


def test_delivery_control_starts_active() -> None:
    control = CybersecurityDeliveryControl()

    assert control.is_paused() is False

    status = control.status()

    assert status["paused"] is False
    assert status["reason"] is None


def test_delivery_control_pause_blocks_delivery() -> None:
    control = CybersecurityDeliveryControl()

    control.pause(
        reason="Security incident investigation",
    )

    assert control.is_paused() is True

    status = control.status()

    assert status["paused"] is True
    assert (
        status["reason"]
        == "Security incident investigation"
    )
    assert status["changed_at"] is not None


def test_delivery_control_resume_restores_delivery() -> None:
    control = CybersecurityDeliveryControl()

    control.pause(
        reason="Emergency stop",
    )

    assert control.is_paused() is True

    control.resume()

    assert control.is_paused() is False

    status = control.status()

    assert status["paused"] is False
    assert status["reason"] is None
    assert status["changed_at"] is not None


def test_delivery_control_can_be_paused_and_resumed_multiple_times() -> None:
    control = CybersecurityDeliveryControl()

    control.pause(
        reason="First emergency stop",
    )

    assert control.is_paused() is True

    control.resume()

    assert control.is_paused() is False

    control.pause(
        reason="Second emergency stop",
    )

    assert control.is_paused() is True

    status = control.status()

    assert status["reason"] == "Second emergency stop"

"""
Tests for the cybersecurity email provider manager.
"""

import pytest

from backend.cybersecurity.email.email_provider_manager import (
    EmailProviderManager,
)


class FakeEmailProvider:

    provider_id = "fake"

    async def send(
        self,
        subject: str,
        content: dict,
    ) -> dict:

        return {
            "provider": self.provider_id,
            "status": "accepted",
            "message_id": "test-message-id",
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_provider_manager_uses_injected_provider():

    provider = FakeEmailProvider()

    manager = EmailProviderManager(
        provider=provider,
    )

    result = await manager.send(
        "Test subject",
        {
            "recipient": "test@example.com",
        },
    )

    assert result["provider"] == "fake"
    assert result["status"] == "accepted"
    assert result["message_id"] == "test-message-id"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_provider_manager_reports_provider_not_configured(
    monkeypatch,
):

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        EmailProviderManager,
        "_build_default_provider",
        staticmethod(
            lambda: None
        ),
    )

    manager = EmailProviderManager()

    result = await manager.send(
        "Test subject",
        {
            "recipient": "test@example.com",
        },
    )

    assert result == {
        "status": "provider_not_configured",
    }


def test_provider_manager_builds_resend_provider_when_configured():

    manager = EmailProviderManager()

    assert manager.provider is not None

    assert (
        manager.provider.provider_id
        == "resend"
    )


def test_provider_manager_status_when_resend_is_configured():

    manager = EmailProviderManager()

    status = manager.status()

    assert status["provider"] == "resend"
    assert status["configured"] is True
    assert status["available"] is True
    assert status["status"] == "ready"


def test_provider_manager_status_when_provider_is_not_configured(
    monkeypatch,
):

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        EmailProviderManager,
        "_build_default_provider",
        staticmethod(
            lambda: None
        ),
    )

    manager = EmailProviderManager()

    status = manager.status()

    assert status["provider"] is None
    assert status["configured"] is False
    assert status["available"] is False
    assert status["status"] == "not_configured"


def test_provider_manager_status_does_not_expose_credentials():

    manager = EmailProviderManager()

    status = manager.status()

    assert "api_key" not in status
    assert "resend_api_key" not in status
    assert "secret" not in status
    assert "password" not in status

    async def send(self, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(kwargs)
        return {
            "status": "sent",
            "message_id": "MSG-001",
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio

    )

        "easychatbot-governance-logo"

    assert "Possible decisions:" not in call["html_body"]
    assert "ACTION REQUIRED" not in call["html_body"]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest

from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_history import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_policy import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy,
)
from backend.app.application.privacy.privacy_governance_reminder_scheduler import (
    PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Case:
    case_id: str
    governance_status: str
    triggered_at: datetime
    title: str = "Privacy governance test"
    change_id: str = "PCR-REGRESSION-001"
    risk: str = "MEDIUM"
    validation_status: str = "PASS"


class FakeCaseRegistry:
    def __init__(self, cases: list[Case]) -> None:
        self._cases = tuple(cases)

    def all(self) -> tuple[Case, ...]:
        return self._cases

    def get(self, case_id: str) -> Case:
        for case in self._cases:
            if case.case_id == case_id:
                return case
        raise KeyError(f"Governance case not found: {case_id}")


class FakeEmailService:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[str] = []
        self.fail = False

    async def send_governance_reminder(
        self,
        *,
        case: Case,
        recipient_role: str,
        reason: str,
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        del recipient_role, reason

        if self.fail:
            raise RuntimeError("Simulated email delivery failure.")

        self.calls.append(case.case_id)

        return {
            "status": "sent",
            "reference": f"MSG-{len(self.calls):03d}",
            "case_url": (
                "http://127.0.0.1:5173/privacy-governance/"
                f"{case.case_id}"
            ),
        }


def make_scheduler(
    cases: list[Case],
    *,
    email: FakeEmailService | None = None,
) -> tuple[PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler, FakeEmailService]:
    email_service = email or FakeEmailService()

    scheduler = PrivacyGovernanceReminderScheduler(
        case_registry=FakeCaseRegistry(cases),
        policy=PrivacyGovernanceReminderPolicy(
            reminder_after=timedelta(hours=24),
            cooldown=timedelta(hours=24),
        ),
        history=PrivacyGovernanceReminderHistory(),
        email_service=email_service,
    )

    return scheduler, email_service


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_pending_case_reminder_is_sent_and_contains_case_url() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-REG-001",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(hours=25),
    )

    scheduler, email = make_scheduler([case])

    results = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert len(results) == 1
    assert results[0].status == "REMINDER_SENT"
    assert results[0].email_status == "sent"
    assert results[0].case_url == (
        "http://127.0.0.1:5173/privacy-governance/CASE-REG-001"
    )
    assert email.calls == ["CASE-REG-001"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_approved_case_does_not_receive_reminder() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-REG-APPROVED",
        governance_status="APPROVED",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=7),
    )

    scheduler, email = make_scheduler([case])

    results = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert results[0].status == "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
    assert results[0].governance_status == "APPROVED"
    assert email.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_blocked_case_does_not_receive_reminder() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-REG-BLOCKED",
        governance_status="BLOCKED",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=7),
    )

    scheduler, email = make_scheduler([case])

    results = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert results[0].status == "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
    assert results[0].governance_status == "BLOCKED"
    assert email.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_cooldown_prevents_repeated_reminder() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-REG-COOLDOWN",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(hours=48),
    )

    scheduler, email = make_scheduler([case])

    first = await scheduler.run(now=now)
    second = await scheduler.run(now=now + timedelta(hours=1))

    assert first[0].status == "REMINDER_SENT"
    assert second[0].status == "NOT_DUE"
    assert email.calls == ["CASE-REG-COOLDOWN"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_email_failure_does_not_crash_scheduler() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    case = Case(
        case_id="CASE-REG-EMAIL-FAIL",
        governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
        triggered_at=now - timedelta(hours=25),
    )

    email = FakeEmailService()
    email.fail = True

    scheduler, _ = make_scheduler([case], email=email)

    results = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert results[0].status == "EMAIL_FAILED"
    assert results[0].email_status == "failed"
    assert results[0].error == "Simulated email delivery failure."
    assert email.calls == []


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_mixed_cases_only_pending_due_case_is_notified() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    cases = [
        Case(
            case_id="CASE-REG-PENDING",
            governance_status="PENDING_DPO_GRC",
            triggered_at=now - timedelta(hours=25),
        ),
        Case(
            case_id="CASE-REG-APPROVED",
            governance_status="APPROVED",
            triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=3),
        ),
        Case(
            case_id="CASE-REG-BLOCKED",
            governance_status="BLOCKED",
            triggered_at=now - timedelta(days=3),
        ),
    ]

    scheduler, email = make_scheduler(cases)

    results = await scheduler.run(now=now)

    assert [result.status for result in results] == [
        "REMINDER_SENT",
        "NOT_ELIGIBLE",
        "NOT_ELIGIBLE",
    ]
    assert email.calls == ["CASE-REG-PENDING"]

"""
Tests for the Resend email provider.

The provider supports two controlled email contracts:

1. Cybersecurity notifications
   -> existing cybersecurity HTML renderer.

2. Privacy Governance reminders
   -> application-owned HTML and inline logo attachment.

These tests ensure the provider boundary does not mix
the two presentation contracts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64

import pytest
import resend

from backend.cybersecurity.email.resend_email_provider import (
    ResendEmailProvider,
)


def test_resend_provider_requires_api_key_when_configuration_missing(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    Provider must reject missing API credentials when no
    configured environment value exists.
    """

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "backend.cybersecurity.email.resend_email_provider.RESEND_API_KEY",
        "",
    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ResendEmailProvider(
            api_key=None,
            sender="EasyChatBot <test@example.com>",
        )


def test_resend_provider_requires_sender_when_configuration_missing(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    Provider must reject missing sender configuration when no
    configured sender exists.
    """

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "backend.cybersecurity.email.resend_email_provider.EMAIL_FROM",
        "",
    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ResendEmailProvider(
            api_key="test-api-key",
            sender=None,
        )


def test_resend_provider_has_expected_identity():
    """
    Provider exposes its stable provider identifier.
    """

    provider = ResendEmailProvider(
        api_key="test-api-key",
        sender="EasyChatBot <test@example.com>",
    )

    assert provider.provider_id == "resend"

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_privacy_governance_reminder_uses_supplied_html(
    monkeypatch,
):
    """
    Privacy Governance reminders must use the application-owned
    html_body rather than the Cybersecurity renderer.
    """

    captured: dict[str, object] = {}

    class FakeResponse:
        id = "msg-privacy-governance-test"

    async def fake_send_async(params):
        captured["params"] = params
        return FakeResponse()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        resend.Emails,
        "send_async",
        fake_send_async,
    )

    provider = ResendEmailProvider(
        api_key="test-api-key",
        sender="EasyChatBot <test@example.com>",
    )

    supplied_html = """
    <html>
        <body>
            <h1>EasyChatBot Privacy Governance</h1>
            <p>CASE-E2E-001</p>
            <p>PCR-E2E-001</p>
            <a href="http://127.0.0.1:5173/privacy-governance/CASE-E2E-001">
                REVIEW THIS CASE
            </a>
        </body>
    </html>
    """

    result = await provider.send(
        "[EasyChatBot Privacy Governance] Reminder",
        {
            "recipient": "reviewer@example.com",
            "body": (
                "Review CASE-E2E-001 for PCR-E2E-001."
            ),
            "html_body": supplied_html,
            "email_type": "privacy_governance_reminder",
        },
    )

    assert result["provider"] == "resend"
    assert result["status"] == "accepted"
    assert result["message_id"] == (
        "msg-privacy-governance-test"
    )

    params = captured["params"]

    assert isinstance(params, dict)

    assert params["html"] == supplied_html

    assert (
        "EasyChatBot Cybersecurity Notification"
        not in params["html"]
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_privacy_governance_inline_attachment_uses_base64_content(
    monkeypatch,
    tmp_path,
):
    """
    Privacy Governance inline assets must be sent as base64 content.

    Resend does not accept a local Windows filesystem path as the
    attachment path. The provider must therefore convert the local
    file into attachment content before calling Resend.
    """

    logo = tmp_path / "easychatbot_logo.png"

    logo_bytes = b"fake-png-content"

    logo.write_bytes(logo_bytes)

    captured: dict[str, object] = {}

    class FakeResponse:
        id = "msg-privacy-logo-test"

    async def fake_send_async(params):
        captured["params"] = params
        return FakeResponse()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        resend.Emails,
        "send_async",
        fake_send_async,
    )

    provider = ResendEmailProvider(
        api_key="test-api-key",
        sender="EasyChatBot <test@example.com>",
    )

    result = await provider.send(
        "[EasyChatBot Privacy Governance] Reminder",
        {
            "recipient": "reviewer@example.com",
            "body": (
                "Review CASE-E2E-001."
            ),
            "html_body": (
                '<img src="cid:easychatbot-governance-logo">'
            ),
            "email_type": "privacy_governance_reminder",
            "attachments": [
                {
                    "path": str(logo),
                    "filename": "easychatbot_logo.png",
                    "content_id": (
                        "easychatbot-governance-logo"
                    ),
                    "inline": True,
                }
            ],
        },
    )

    assert result["status"] == "accepted"

    params = captured["params"]

    assert isinstance(params, dict)

    attachments = params["attachments"]

    assert isinstance(attachments, list)
    assert len(attachments) == 1

    attachment = attachments[0]

    assert "path" not in attachment

    assert (
        attachment["filename"]
        == "easychatbot_logo.png"
    )

    assert (
        attachment["content_id"]
        == "easychatbot-governance-logo"
    )

    expected_content = base64.b64encode(
        logo_bytes
    ).decode("ascii")

    assert (
        attachment["content"]
        == expected_content
    )

    assert "human-controlled" in result.interpretation.lower()

        {
            "event": "SECURITY_INCIDENT",

            "reason": "Critical vulnerability",
            "actor": "Cybersecurity monitoring",

    )

        "event": "PROVIDER_PAUSED",
        "component": "Provider delivery",
        "reason": "Incident",
        "actor": "Admin",
        "severity": "warning",
    }

    first = YetiGovernanceService().explain(event)
    second = YetiGovernanceService().explain(event)

    assert first == second

        "",
    )
    .strip()
    .lower()
    == "true"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROCESSING_ID = "PROC-E2E-001"
DATA_MAP_ID = "MAP-E2E-001"
RETENTION_ID = "RET-E2E-001"
PROCESSOR_ID = "PROC-PROVIDER-E2E-001"
DPIA_SCREENING_ID = "DPIA-E2E-001"
CHANGE_ID = "PCR-E2E-001"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _require_e2e_configuration() -> None:
    """
    Fail safely when the real Resend E2E test is explicitly enabled.

    The API key is never printed.
    """

    required = {
        "RESEND_API_KEY": os.getenv(
            "RESEND_API_KEY",
            "",
        ).strip(),
        "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_FROM": os.getenv(
            "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_FROM",
            "",
        ).strip(),
        "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_TO": os.getenv(
            "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_TO",
            "",
        ).strip(),
    }

    missing = [
        name
        for name, value in required.items()
        if not value
    ]

    if missing:
        pytest.fail(
            "Privacy Resend E2E test is enabled, but required "
            "configuration is missing: "
            f"{', '.join(missing)}"
        )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Real PrivacyValidationService
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _build_validation_service() -> PrivacyValidationService:
    """
    Build the real deterministic PrivacyValidationService.

    This is intentionally not a fake validation service.

    The E2E test must prove that the actual privacy validation layer
    passes before an email can be sent.
    """

    processing_activity = ProcessingActivity(
        processing_id=PROCESSING_ID,
        name="Beta 1 Privacy Governance E2E Test",
        purpose=(
            "Controlled end-to-end validation of the "
            "EasyChatBot privacy governance workflow."
        ),
        data_categories=(
            "account identifier",
            "learning interaction data",
        ),
        data_subjects=(
            "registered learner",
        ),
        source=(
            "EasyChatBot application",
        ),
        destinations=(
            "EasyChatBot backend",
            "approved email recipient",
        ),
        legal_basis=(
            "Documented Beta 1 lawful basis recorded in the "
            "controlled privacy assessment."
        ),
        retention_id=RETENTION_ID,
        processor_ids=(
            PROCESSOR_ID,
        ),
        data_map_id=DATA_MAP_ID,
        dpia_screening_id=DPIA_SCREENING_ID,
        gdpr_references=(
            "GDPR Art. 5(1)(a)",
            "GDPR Art. 5(1)(b)",
            "GDPR Art. 6",
            "GDPR Art. 13/14",
            "GDPR Art. 28",
            "GDPR Art. 30",
            "GDPR Art. 35 where applicable",
        ),
        security_controls=(
            "access control",
            "least privilege",
            "audit logging",
            "encryption in transit",
        ),
        approval_status="APPROVED",
    )

    processing_registry = ProcessingRegistry(
        [
            processing_activity,
        ]
    )

    data_processing_map = DataProcessingMap(
        [
            DataProcessingMapEntry(
                map_id=DATA_MAP_ID,
                processing_id=PROCESSING_ID,
                source="EasyChatBot application",
                input_data=(
                    "account identifier",
                    "learning interaction data",
                ),
                runtime_processing=(
                    "privacy validation",
                    "governance routing",
                ),
                pseudonymisation=(
                    "Learner identifiers are minimised "
                    "and pseudonymised where applicable."
                ),
                persistence=(
                    "controlled governance registry",
                ),
                destinations=(
                    "EasyChatBot backend",
                    "approved email recipient",
                ),
                third_country_transfer=False,
                transfer_safeguard=None,
            ),
        ]
    )

    retention_registry = RetentionRegistry(
        [
            RetentionRule(
                retention_id=RETENTION_ID,
                data_domain="privacy governance",
                record_type="privacy change evidence",
                retention_period=(
                    "Beta 1 controlled retention period"
                ),
                trigger="governance record closure",
                deletion_action=(

    processor_registry = ProcessorRegistry(

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Controlled Privacy Change
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _build_change() -> PrivacyChange:
    """
    Create the controlled PCR-E2E-001 governance change.
    """

    return PrivacyChange(
        change_id=CHANGE_ID,
        title="Beta 1 Privacy Governance Email Test",
        description=(
            "Controlled end-to-end test proving that a privacy "
            "change which passes automated privacy validation "
            "and requires DPO/GRC review generates an approval "
            "escalation through Resend."
        ),
        affected_processing_ids=[
            PROCESSING_ID,
        ],
        affected_data_map_ids=[
            DATA_MAP_ID,
        ],
        risk=PrivacyChangeRisk.MEDIUM,
        status=PrivacyChangeStatus.DRAFT,
        dpo_required=True,
        grc_required=True,
        metadata={
            "test_type": "controlled_e2e",
            "test_id": CHANGE_ID,
            "purpose": (
                "Verify Resend delivery and governance routing."
            ),
        },
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Real Resend E2E test
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.skipif(
    not E2E_ENABLED,
    reason=(
        "Real Resend delivery disabled. Set "
        "PRIVACY_E2E_SEND_EMAIL=true to explicitly run "
        "this test."
    ),
)
async def test_privacy_governance_resend_e2e():
    """
    Controlled real Resend E2E test.

    The expected flow is:

        PrivacyValidationService
                    |
                  PASS
                    |
                    v
        PrivacyGovernanceGate
                    |
                    v
           PENDING_DPO_GRC
                    |
                    v
        PrivacyApprovalEmailService
                    |
                    v
        ResendApprovalEmailSender
                    |
                    v
                 Resend
                    |
                    v
          DPO/GRC mailbox

    Critical governance invariant:

        Email sent != governance approval.
    """

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 0. Verify that the explicit E2E configuration exists.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    _require_e2e_configuration()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Build the REAL PrivacyValidationService.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    validation_service = _build_validation_service()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Execute REAL automated privacy validation.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    validation = validation_service.validate()

    assert validation.status == "PASS", (
        "The controlled E2E processing activity must pass "
        "PrivacyValidationService before any email can be sent. "
        f"Failures: {validation.failures}"
    )

    assert validation.failures == ()

    assert validation.checks > 0

    assert (
        validation.passed
        == validation.checks
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Build the REAL Resend infrastructure adapter.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    resend_sender = ResendApprovalEmailSender(
        api_key=os.environ[
            "RESEND_API_KEY"
        ],
        sender_email=os.environ[
            "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_FROM"
        ],
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Build the REAL PrivacyApprovalEmailService.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    approval_email_service = (
        PrivacyApprovalEmailService(
            sender=resend_sender,
            approval_recipient=os.environ[
                "PRIVACY_APPROVAL_EMAIL_TO"
            ],
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Build the REAL governance registry and gate.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    registry = PrivacyChangeRegistry()

    gate = PrivacyGovernanceGate(
        registry=registry,
        validation_service=validation_service,
        approval_email_service=approval_email_service,
    )

    change = _build_change()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. Execute the REAL governance flow.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    result = await gate.route_and_escalate(
        change
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. Verify the change identity.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        result.change_id
        == CHANGE_ID
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. Verify the governance state.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        result.status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 9. CRITICAL GOVERNANCE CONTROL:
    #
    #    Email delivery must NOT approve the change.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    assert (
        result.status
        != PrivacyChangeStatus.APPROVED
    )

    assert (
        gate.can_proceed(
            CHANGE_ID
        )
        is False
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 10. Verify that the change exists in the registry.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    registered = registry.get(
        CHANGE_ID
    )

    assert registered is not None

    assert (
        registered.status
        == PrivacyChangeStatus.PENDING_DPO_GRC
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 11. Controlled success output.
    #
    #     ResendApprovalEmailSender raises an exception if the
    #     Resend delivery call fails. Therefore reaching this point
    #     means the provider call completed without an exception.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    print(
        "\n"
        "============================================================\n"
        "PRIVACY GOVERNANCE RESEND E2E TEST PASSED\n"
        "============================================================\n"
        f"Change ID: {CHANGE_ID}\n"
        f"Validation: {validation.status}\n"
        f"Checks: {validation.checks}\n"
        f"Passed: {validation.passed}\n"
        "DPO required: YES\n"
        "GRC required: YES\n"
        "Governance status: PENDING_DPO_GRC\n"
        "Email delivery: Resend accepted without exception\n"
        "Governance approval: NOT GRANTED\n"
        "============================================================\n"
    )

"""
Tests for DeterministicEvaluator.
"""

from src.challenge_engine.models import (
    DiscussionQuestion,
    LearningChallenge,
    VocabularyItem,
)

from src.evaluation.deterministic_evaluator import (
    DeterministicEvaluator,
)


def _create_valid_challenge() -> LearningChallenge:
    return LearningChallenge(
        title="AI Act Learning Challenge",
        topic="AI Act",
        language="French",
        learner_level="B2",
        summary=(
            "The European Union AI Act establishes "
            "a risk-based framework."
        ),
        vocabulary=[
            VocabularyItem(
                term="gouvernance",
                definition=(
                    "Organisation et contrÃ´le "
                    "d'une activitÃ©."
                ),
            )
        ],
        discussion_questions=[
            DiscussionQuestion(
                question=(
                    "Pourquoi la gouvernance de "
                    "l'IA est-elle importante ?"
                )
            )
        ],
    )


def test_evaluator_returns_expected_criteria():

    evaluator = DeterministicEvaluator()

    scores = evaluator.evaluate(
        _create_valid_challenge()
    )

    names = {
        score.criterion
        for score in scores
    }

    assert names == {
        "completeness",
        "language_level",
        "educational_value",
        "source_coverage",
    }


def test_valid_challenge_scores_completeness():

    evaluator = DeterministicEvaluator()

    scores = evaluator.evaluate(
        _create_valid_challenge()
    )

    score = next(
        score
        for score in scores
        if score.criterion == "completeness"

"""
Tests for AI Evaluation Engine.
"""

import pytest

from src.evaluation.engine import EvaluationEngine
from src.evaluation.models import CriterionScore


CRITERIA = [
    {
        "name": "factuality",
        "description": "Factual accuracy.",
        "weight": 2.0,
    },
    {
        "name": "completeness",
        "description": "Completeness.",
        "weight": 1.0,
    },
]


def _create_engine() -> EvaluationEngine:
    from src.evaluation.models import EvaluationCriterion

    return EvaluationEngine(
        criteria=[
            EvaluationCriterion(**criterion)
            for criterion in CRITERIA
        ],
        passing_score=0.70,
    )


def test_engine_calculates_weighted_score():

    engine = _create_engine()

    result = engine.evaluate(
        [
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="factuality",
                score=1.0,
                reasoning="Fully supported.",
            ),
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="completeness",
                score=0.5,
                reasoning="Partially complete.",
            ),
        ]
    )

    # (1.0 * 2 + 0.5 * 1) / 3
    assert result.overall_score == pytest.approx(
        0.8333333333
    )

    assert result.passed is True


def test_engine_can_fail_evaluation():

    engine = _create_engine()

    result = engine.evaluate(
        [
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="factuality",
                score=0.5,
                reasoning="Partially supported.",
            ),
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="completeness",
                score=0.4,
                reasoning="Incomplete.",
            ),
        ]
    )

    assert result.overall_score == pytest.approx(
        0.4666666667
    )

    assert result.passed is False


def test_engine_rejects_empty_criteria():

    from src.evaluation.engine import EvaluationEngine

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        EvaluationEngine(criteria=[])


def test_engine_rejects_invalid_passing_score():

    from src.evaluation.models import EvaluationCriterion

    criterion = EvaluationCriterion(
        name="factuality",
        description="Factual accuracy.",
        weight=1.0,
    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        EvaluationEngine(
            criteria=[criterion],
            passing_score=1.5,
        )


def test_engine_rejects_unknown_criterion():

    engine = _create_engine()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        engine.evaluate(
            [
                CriterionScore(
                    criterion="unknown",
                    score=0.9,
                    reasoning="Invalid.",
                )
            ]
        )


def test_engine_rejects_invalid_score():

    engine = _create_engine()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        engine.evaluate(
            [
                CriterionScore(
                    criterion="factuality",
                    score=1.5,
                    reasoning="Invalid score.",
                )
            ]
        )


def test_engine_rejects_duplicate_criteria():

    engine = _create_engine()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        engine.evaluate(
            [
                CriterionScore(
                    criterion="factuality",
                    score=0.9,
                    reasoning="First score.",
                ),
                CriterionScore(
                    criterion="factuality",
                    score=0.8,
                    reasoning="Duplicate score.",
                ),
            ]
        )

"""
Tests for AI Evaluation domain models.
"""

from src.evaluation.models import (
    CriterionScore,
    EvaluationCriterion,
    EvaluationResult,
)


def test_evaluation_criterion_creation():

    criterion = EvaluationCriterion(
        name="factuality",
        description="Information is factually supported.",
        weight=2.0,
    )

    assert criterion.name == "factuality"
    assert criterion.weight == 2.0


def test_criterion_score_creation():

    score = CriterionScore(
        criterion="factuality",
        score=0.9,
        reasoning="Claims are supported by sources.",
    )

    assert score.criterion == "factuality"
    assert score.score == 0.9


def test_evaluation_result_creation():

    result = EvaluationResult(
        overall_score=0.85,
        scores=[
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="factuality",
                score=0.9,
                reasoning="Supported.",
            )
        ],
        passed=True,
    )

    assert result.overall_score == 0.85
    assert result.passed is True
    assert result.evaluator == "deterministic"


def test_evaluation_result_is_immutable():

    result = EvaluationResult(
        overall_score=0.8,
        scores=[],
        passed=True,
    )

    try:
        result.overall_score = 0.5
        assert False
    except AttributeError:
        assert True

"""
Tests for AI Evaluation Quality Report.
"""

from src.evaluation.models import (
    CriterionScore,
    EvaluationResult,
)

from src.evaluation.report import (
    EvaluationReport,
)


def _create_result() -> EvaluationResult:
    return EvaluationResult(
        overall_score=0.85,
        scores=[
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="completeness",
                score=1.0,
                reasoning="All required components are present.",
            ),
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="language_level",
                score=0.7,
                reasoning="CEFR level is valid.",
            ),
        ],
        passed=True,
    )


def test_report_contains_overall_score():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    output = report.generate(
        _create_result()
    )

    assert "Overall Score: 0.85" in output


def test_report_contains_pass_status():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    output = report.generate(
        _create_result()
    )

    assert "Status: PASS" in output


def test_report_contains_evaluator():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    output = report.generate(
        _create_result()
    )

    assert "Evaluator: deterministic" in output


def test_report_contains_criteria():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    output = report.generate(
        _create_result()
    )

    assert "completeness: 1.00" in output
    assert "language_level: 0.70" in output


def test_report_contains_reasoning():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    output = report.generate(
        _create_result()
    )

    assert (
        "All required components are present."
        in output
    )


def test_failed_report_shows_fail():

    report = EvaluationReport()

    result = EvaluationResult(
        overall_score=0.45,
        scores=[
            CriterionScore(
                criterion="completeness",
                score=0.45,
                reasoning="Several components are missing.",
            )
        ],
        passed=False,
    )

    output = report.generate(result)

    assert "Overall Score: 0.45" in output
    assert "Status: FAIL" in output

const cases = [
  {
    case_id: "CASE-001",
    title: "Pending case",
    summary: "Pending",

const detail = {
