from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.models import ProviderUsageEvent


def _event(
    *,
    provider: str,
    model: str,
    capability: str,
    functionality: str,
    agent: str,
    input_tokens: int | None,
    output_tokens: int | None,
    total_tokens: int | None,
    estimated_cost: Decimal,
    success: bool = True,
) -> ProviderUsageEvent:
    return ProviderUsageEvent(
        provider=provider,
        model=model,
        capability=capability,
        functionality=functionality,
        agent=agent,
        input_tokens=input_tokens,
        output_tokens=output_tokens,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
        latency_ms=100,
        estimated_cost=estimated_cost,
        quality_score=90.0,
        success=success,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )


def test_events_contain_required_aggregation_dimensions() -> None:
    event = _event(
        provider="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability="conversation",
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=1000,
        output_tokens=500,
        total_tokens=1500,
        estimated_cost=Decimal("0.0035"),
    )

    assert event.provider == "openai"
    assert event.model == "gpt-5-mini"
    assert event.capability == "conversation"
    assert event.functionality == "chat"
    assert event.agent == "conversation_agent"


def test_known_usage_can_be_summed() -> None:
    events = [
        _event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            functionality="chat",
            agent="conversation_agent",
            input_tokens=1000,
            output_tokens=500,
            total_tokens=1500,
            estimated_cost=Decimal("0.0035"),
        ),
        _event(
            provider="openai",
            model="gpt-5-mini",
            capability="conversation",
            functionality="chat",
            agent="conversation_agent",
            input_tokens=500,
            output_tokens=250,
            total_tokens=750,
            estimated_cost=Decimal("0.00175"),
        ),
    ]

    assert sum(e.input_tokens or 0 for e in events) == 1500
    assert sum(e.output_tokens or 0 for e in events) == 750
    assert sum(e.total_tokens or 0 for e in events) == 2250
    assert sum((e.estimated_cost for e in events), Decimal("0")) == Decimal(
        "0.00525"
    )


def test_failed_requests_are_retained_for_request_metrics() -> None:
    event = _event(
        provider="openai",
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability="conversation",
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=0,
        output_tokens=0,
        total_tokens=None,
        estimated_cost=Decimal("0"),
        success=False,
    )

    assert event.success is False
    assert event.estimated_cost == Decimal("0")


def test_unknown_usage_is_not_fabricated() -> None:
    event = _event(
        provider="ollama",
        model="local-model",
        capability="conversation",
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=None,
        output_tokens=None,
        total_tokens=None,
        estimated_cost=Decimal("0"),
    )

    assert event.input_tokens is None
    assert event.output_tokens is None
    assert event.total_tokens is None

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.aggregation import (
    ProviderUsageAggregationService,
)
from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.models import ProviderUsageEvent


def event(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    model: str = "gpt-5-mini",
    capability: str = "conversation",
    functionality: str = "chat",
    agent: str = "conversation_agent",
    input_tokens: int | None = 100,
    output_tokens: int | None = 50,
    total_tokens: int | None = 150,
    cost: Decimal = Decimal("0.001"),
    success: bool = True,
) -> ProviderUsageEvent:
    return ProviderUsageEvent(
        provider=provider,
        model=model,
        capability=capability,
        functionality=functionality,
        agent=agent,
        input_tokens=input_tokens,
        output_tokens=output_tokens,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
        latency_ms=100,
        estimated_cost=cost,
        quality_score=90,
        success=success,
    )


def test_aggregates_requests_tokens_cost_and_dimensions():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(),
            event(
                provider="ollama",
                model="local-model",
                input_tokens=200,
                output_tokens=100,
                total_tokens=300,
                cost=Decimal("0"),
            ),
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_requests == 2
    assert result.successful_requests == 2
    assert result.failed_requests == 0

    assert result.total_input_tokens == 300
    assert result.total_output_tokens == 150
    assert result.total_tokens == 450

    assert result.total_estimated_cost == Decimal("0.001")

    assert result.by_provider == {
        "openai": 1,
        "ollama": 1,
    }

    assert result.by_model == {
        "gpt-5-mini": 1,
        "local-model": 1,
    }


def test_failed_requests_are_counted():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(success=True),
            event(success=False),
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_requests == 2
    assert result.successful_requests == 1
    assert result.failed_requests == 1


def test_unknown_input_usage_remains_unknown():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(
                input_tokens=None,
                total_tokens=None,
            ),
            event(
                input_tokens=100,
                output_tokens=50,
                total_tokens=150,
            ),
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_input_tokens is None


def test_unknown_output_usage_remains_unknown():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(
                output_tokens=None,
                total_tokens=None,
            ),
            event(
                input_tokens=100,
                output_tokens=100,
                total_tokens=200,
            ),
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_output_tokens is None


def test_unknown_total_usage_remains_unknown():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(
                total_tokens=None,
            ),
            event(
                input_tokens=100,
                output_tokens=50,
                total_tokens=150,
            ),
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_tokens is None


def test_real_zero_usage_remains_zero():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(
        [
            event(
                input_tokens=0,
                output_tokens=0,
                total_tokens=0,
                cost=Decimal("0"),
            )
        ]
    )

    assert result.total_input_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_output_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_estimated_cost == Decimal("0")


def test_empty_event_set_returns_zero_metrics():
    result = ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate([])

    assert result.total_requests == 0
    assert result.successful_requests == 0
    assert result.failed_requests == 0
    assert result.total_input_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_output_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_tokens == 0
    assert result.total_estimated_cost == Decimal("0")
    assert result.by_provider == {}

    import pytest

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="events"):
        ProviderUsageAggregationService().aggregate(None)

"""
Provider usage service unit tests.

Validates:

ProviderUsageEvent
        |
        v
ProviderUsageRepository
        |
        v
ProviderUsageService
        |
        v
ProviderUsageSummary

The service does not:

- call providers;
- access external APIs;
- persist directly;
- execute agents.
"""

from decimal import Decimal

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.models import (
    ProviderUsageEvent,
)

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.repository import (
    InMemoryProviderUsageRepository,
)

from src.ai_runtime.providers.usage.service import (
    ProviderUsageService,
)


def create_service() -> ProviderUsageService:
    """
    Create service with injected repository.
    """

    return ProviderUsageService(
        repository=(
            InMemoryProviderUsageRepository()
        ),
    )


def create_event(
    *,
    provider: str = "openai",
    success: bool = True,
) -> ProviderUsageEvent:
    """
    Create deterministic usage event data.
    """

    return ProviderUsageEvent(
        provider=provider,
        model="gpt-5-mini",
        capability="conversation",
        functionality="chat",
        agent="conversation_agent",
        input_tokens=1000,
        output_tokens=500,
        latency_ms=800,
        estimated_cost=Decimal(
            "0.010"
        ),
        quality_score=95.0,
        success=success,
    )


def test_record_single_usage_event() -> None:
    service = create_service()

    service.record(
        create_event()
    )

    summary = service.summary()

    assert summary.total_requests == 1

    assert summary.total_tokens == 1500


def test_multiple_providers_are_aggregated() -> None:
    service = create_service()

    service.record(
        create_event(
            provider="openai",
        )
    )

    service.record(
        create_event(
            provider="gemini",
        )
    )

    summary = service.summary()

    assert summary.total_requests == 2

    assert summary.providers == (
        "gemini",
        "openai",
    )


def test_failed_requests_are_counted() -> None:
    service = create_service()

    service.record(
        create_event(
            success=False,
        )
    )

    summary = service.summary()

    assert summary.failed_requests == 1

    assert summary.successful_requests == 0


def test_empty_service_returns_empty_summary() -> None:
    service = create_service()

    summary = service.summary()

    assert summary.total_requests == 0

    assert summary.total_tokens == 0

    assert summary.total_cost == Decimal(
        "0"
    )


def test_clear_removes_repository_data() -> None:
    service = create_service()

    service.record(
        create_event()
    )

    service.clear()

    summary = service.summary()

    assert summary.total_requests == 0

"""
Provider Delivery Control tests.

Validates the manual provider-management kill switch.

Tests:
- initial active state;
- manual pause;
- execution blocking;
- pause reason;
- resume;
- repeated pause/resume operations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations


import pytest


from provider_management.control.provider_delivery_control import (
    ProviderDeliveryControl,
)



def test_provider_control_starts_active() -> None:
    """
    Provider execution is allowed by default.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    assert (
        control.is_paused()
        is False
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is True
    )


    status = (
        control.status()
    )


    assert (
        status["paused"]
        is False
    )


    assert (
        status["reason"]
        is None
    )


    assert (
        status["changed_at"]
        is None
    )



def test_provider_control_pause_blocks_execution() -> None:
    """
    Manual pause must immediately block provider execution.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    control.pause(
        reason=(
            "External provider security incident"
        ),
    )


    assert (
        control.is_paused()
        is True
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is False
    )


    status = (
        control.status()
    )


    assert (
        status["paused"]
        is True
    )


    assert (
        status["reason"]
        == "External provider security incident"
    )


    assert (
        status["changed_at"]
        is not None
    )



def test_provider_control_resume_allows_execution() -> None:
    """
    Resume must restore provider execution.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    control.pause(
        reason="Emergency provider stop",
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is False
    )


    control.resume()


    assert (
        control.is_paused()
        is False
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is True
    )


    status = (
        control.status()
    )


    assert (
        status["paused"]
        is False
    )


    assert (
        status["reason"]
        is None
    )


    assert (
        status["changed_at"]
        is not None
    )



def test_provider_control_requires_pause_reason() -> None:
    """
    A manual emergency stop must contain an operational reason.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="pause reason is required",
    ):

        control.pause("")



def test_provider_control_rejects_whitespace_pause_reason() -> None:
    """
    Whitespace-only reasons are invalid.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="pause reason is required",
    ):

        control.pause("   ")



def test_provider_control_strips_pause_reason() -> None:
    """
    Stored operational reason should be normalised.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    control.pause(
        reason="  Provider incident  ",
    )


    status = (
        control.status()
    )


    assert (
        status["reason"]
        == "Provider incident"
    )


def test_provider_control_supports_repeated_operations() -> None:
    """
    The control can be stopped and resumed repeatedly.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    control.pause(
        reason="First provider incident",
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is False
    )


    control.resume()


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is True
    )


    control.pause(
        reason="Second provider incident",
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is False
    )


    status = (
        control.status()
    )


    assert (
        status["reason"]
        == "Second provider incident"
    )


def test_provider_control_resume_is_idempotent() -> None:
    """
    Calling resume while already active is safe.
    """

    control = ProviderDeliveryControl()


    control.resume()


    assert (
        control.is_paused()
        is False
    )


    assert (
        control.allow_execution()
        is True
    )

class FakeConversationAgent:

        character=create_character(),

        "Yeti"

        is not None
    )

        IntelligenceContext,
    )

    )

    assert (
        received_context is not None
    )

    assert (
        received_context
        is not context
    )

    assert (
        received_context.intelligence_context
        is not None
    )

    assert (
        received_context.intelligence_context.query
        == context.request
    )

    assert (
        received_context.intelligence_context.source_count
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        result["conversation"][
            "intelligence_context"
        ]
        is received_context.intelligence_context
    )

    assert (
        context.intelligence_context
        is None
    )

"""
Tests for ConversationAgent LLM provider integration.

These tests verify the architecture:

ConversationAgent
    |
    v
LLMService
    |
    v
Injected LLMProvider
    |
    v
ProviderResult

No real provider API is called.
"""

import pytest

from backend.agents.conversation_agent import (
    ConversationAgent,
)

from backend.characters.character_profile import (
    CharacterProfile,
)

from backend.providers.provider_result import (
    ProviderResult,
)

from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import (
    ExecutionContext,
)


class FakeLLMProvider:
    """
    Deterministic provider for ConversationAgent tests.

    The provider is injected into ConversationAgent and
    therefore wrapped by LLMService internally.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        result: ProviderResult,
    ) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.received_request = None

    async def generate(
        self,
        request,
    ) -> ProviderResult:
        """
        Capture the request and return the configured result.
        """

        self.received_request = request

        return self.result


def create_character() -> CharacterProfile:
    """
    Create the deterministic test character.
    """

    return CharacterProfile(
        character_id="yeti",
        name="Yeti",
        description=(
            "Friendly AI learning companion"
        ),
        personality=(
            "Curious and encouraging"
        ),
        learning_style=(
            "Conversation based learning"
        ),
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_conversation_agent_executes_injected_provider():
    """
    ConversationAgent should execute an injected provider
    through the LLMService boundary.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            output=(
                "Artificial intelligence is "
                "the field of building systems "
                "that perform tasks requiring intelligence."
            ),
        )
    )

    agent = ConversationAgent(
        character=create_character(),
        llm_provider=provider,
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Explain artificial intelligence",
    )

    result = await agent.execute(
        context
    )

    assert result.success is True

    assert result.output["message"] == (
        "Artificial intelligence is "
        "the field of building systems "
        "that perform tasks requiring intelligence."
    )

    assert result.output["provider_id"] == (
        "fake_llm"
    )

    assert provider.received_request is not None

    assert (
        provider.received_request.user_prompt
        == "Explain artificial intelligence"
    )

    assert (
        provider.received_request.character_id
        == "yeti"
    )

    assert (
        agent.llm_service is not None
    )

    assert (
        agent.llm_service.llm_provider
        is provider
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_conversation_agent_handles_provider_failure():
    """
    Provider failures should be converted into a failed
    AgentResult without exposing provider SDK details.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=False,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            error="Provider unavailable",
        )
    )

    agent = ConversationAgent(
        character=create_character(),
        llm_provider=provider,
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Explain artificial intelligence",
    )

    result = await agent.execute(
        context
    )

    assert result.success is False

    assert result.output["provider_id"] == (
        "fake_llm"
    )

    assert result.output["provider_error"] == (
        "Provider unavailable"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_conversation_agent_without_provider_keeps_demo_behaviour():
    """
    ConversationAgent should preserve deterministic
    hackathon behaviour when no LLM service/provider
    is configured.
    """

    agent = ConversationAgent(
        character=create_character()
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Explain artificial intelligence",
    )

    result = await agent.execute(
        context
    )

    assert result.success is True

    assert (
        result.output["message"]
        == (
            "Yeti: Let's explore this together. "
            "You asked: Explain artificial intelligence"
        )
    )

    assert (
        "provider_id"
        not in result.output
    )

    assert (
        agent.llm_service
        is None
    )


def test_conversation_agent_rejects_both_service_and_provider():
    """
    ConversationAgent should reject ambiguous dependency
    injection when both LLMService and LLMProvider are supplied.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            output="Test response",
        )
    )

    from backend.services.llm_service import (
        LLMService,
    )

    service = LLMService(
        provider
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match=(
            "Provide either llm_service or "
            "llm_provider, not both"
        ),
    ):
        ConversationAgent(
            character=create_character(),
            llm_service=service,
            llm_provider=provider,
        )

import pytest

from backend.intelligence.intelligence_context import (
    IntelligenceContext,

def test_execution_context_creation():

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Hello",
    )

    assert context.user_id == (
        "demo-user"
    )

    assert context.request == (
        "Hello"
    )

    assert context.execution_id

    assert context.created_at

    assert context.metadata == {}

    assert context.intelligence_context is None

    assert context.has_intelligence_context is False


def test_execution_context_is_immutable():

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Hello",
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        AttributeError
    ):
        context.request = "Changed"


def test_execution_context_can_carry_intelligence():

    intelligence = IntelligenceContext(
        query="Latest European AI regulation",
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Explain this to me",
        intelligence_context=intelligence,
    )

    assert context.intelligence_context is intelligence

    assert context.has_intelligence_context is True

    assert (
        context.intelligence_context.query
        == "Latest European AI regulation"
    )

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_research_agent_propagates_provider_failure():

    class FailingResearchProvider:
        """
        Fake provider representing a provider failure.
        """

        async def execute(
            self,
            context,
        ):
            return ProviderResult(
                success=False,
                provider_id="fake_research",
                output=None,
                error="Research provider unavailable",
            )

    agent = ResearchAgent(
        provider=FailingResearchProvider()
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="Latest European AI regulation",
    )

    result = await agent.execute(
        context
    )

    assert result.success is False

    assert result.agent_id == (
        "research_agent"
    )

    assert result.output is None

    assert result.error == (
        "Research provider unavailable"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_research_agent_handles_empty_results():

    class EmptyResearchProvider:
        """
        Fake provider returning no research results.
        """

        async def execute(
            self,
            context,
        ):
            return ProviderResult(
                success=True,
                provider_id="fake_research",
                output={
                    "query": context.request,
                    "results": {
                        "results": []
                    },
                },
            )

    agent = ResearchAgent(
        provider=EmptyResearchProvider()
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id="demo-user",
        request="A very specific research question",
    )

    result = await agent.execute(
        context
    )

    assert result.success is True

    assert isinstance(
        result.output,
        IntelligenceContext,
    )

    assert result.output.source_count == 0

    assert result.output.has_sources is False

"""
Unit tests for CompanionService.

These tests verify the application orchestration boundary:

ExecutionContext
|
v
CompanionService
|
+--> MemoryService
|
+--> ResearchAgent
|       |
|       v
|   IntelligenceContext
|
+--> ConversationAgent
|
+--> QualityAgent
|
v
Interaction Result

No real LLM provider, OpenAI API, Parallel API,
or external infrastructure is called.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import pytest

from backend.agents.agent_result import (
    AgentResult,
)

    CharacterProfile,
)

    ExecutionContext,

@dataclass
class FakeMemory:
    """
    Deterministic memory record for tests.
    """

    user_id: str
    category: str
    content: str


class FakeMemoryService:
    """
    Deterministic MemoryService test double.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.memories = [
            FakeMemory(
                user_id="demo-user",
                category="conversation",
                content="Previous conversation",
            ),
        ]

        self.recall_calls = []
        self.remember_calls = []

    def recall(
        self,
        user_id: str,
    ):
        self.recall_calls.append(
            user_id
        )

        return [
            memory
            for memory in self.memories
            if memory.user_id == user_id
        ]

    def remember(
        self,
        user_id: str,
        category: str,
        content: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.remember_calls.append(
            {
                "user_id": user_id,
                "category": category,
                "content": content,
            }
        )


class FakeResearchAgent:
    """
    Deterministic ResearchAgent test double.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        result: AgentResult,
    ) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.received_contexts = []

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        self.received_contexts.append(
            context
        )

        return self.result


class FakeConversationAgent:

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_companion_service_orchestrates_conversation():
    """
    CompanionService should execute the ConversationAgent
    and QualityAgent for a normal interaction.

    Research must not execute when use_research=False.
    """

    conversation_agent = FakeConversationAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="conversation_agent",
            output={
                "message": "Fake conversation response",
            },
        )
    )

    research_agent = FakeResearchAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="research_agent",
            output="Should not execute",
        )
    )

    quality_agent = FakeQualityAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="quality_agent",
            output={
                "quality_score": 1.0,
                "passed": True,
            },
        )
    )

    memory_service = FakeMemoryService()

    service = CompanionService(
        character=create_character(),
        conversation_agent=conversation_agent,
        research_agent=research_agent,
        quality_agent=quality_agent,
        memory_service=memory_service,
    )

    context = create_context()

    result = await service.interact(
        context,
        use_research=False,
    )

    assert result["character"] == "Yeti"

    assert result["conversation"] == {
        "message": "Fake conversation response",
    }

    assert result["research"] is None

    assert result["quality"] == {
        "quality_score": 1.0,
        "passed": True,
    }

    assert result["memory_count"] == 1

    assert (
        len(
            conversation_agent.received_contexts
        )
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        conversation_agent.received_contexts[0]
        is context
    )

    assert (
        len(
            research_agent.received_contexts
        )
        == 0
    )

    assert (
        len(
            quality_agent.received_contexts
        )
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        quality_agent.received_contexts[0]
        is context
    )

    assert memory_service.recall_calls == [
        "demo-user",
    ]

    assert memory_service.remember_calls == [
        {
            "user_id": "demo-user",
            "category": "conversation",
            "content": (
                "Explain artificial intelligence"
            ),
        }
    ]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_companion_service_executes_research_when_requested():
    """
    When research is requested, CompanionService should:

    1. execute ResearchAgent
    2. attach its IntelligenceContext to a new
       ExecutionContext
    3. execute ConversationAgent with the enriched context
    4. execute QualityAgent with the enriched context
    """

    intelligence_context = object()

    research_agent = FakeResearchAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="research_agent",
            output=intelligence_context,
        )
    )

    conversation_agent = FakeConversationAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="conversation_agent",
            output={
                "message": "Research-aware response",
            },
        )
    )

    quality_agent = FakeQualityAgent(
        AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id="quality_agent",
            output={
                "quality_score": 0.95,
                "passed": True,
            },
        )
    )

    memory_service = FakeMemoryService()

    service = CompanionService(
        character=create_character(),
        conversation_agent=conversation_agent,
        research_agent=research_agent,
        quality_agent=quality_agent,
        memory_service=memory_service,
    )

    context = create_context(
        "What are the latest AI developments?"
    )

    result = await service.interact(
        context,
        use_research=True,
    )

    assert result["character"] == "Yeti"

    assert result["conversation"] == {
        "message": "Research-aware response",
    }

    assert (
        result["research"]
        is intelligence_context
    )

    assert result["quality"] == {
        "quality_score": 0.95,
        "passed": True,
    }

    assert (
        len(
            research_agent.received_contexts
        )
        == 1
    )

    assert (
        research_agent.received_contexts[0]
        is context
    )

    assert (
        len(
            conversation_agent.received_contexts
        )
        == 1
    )

    enriched_context = (
        conversation_agent.received_contexts[0]
    )

    assert enriched_context is not context

    assert (
        enriched_context.request
        == context.request
    )

    assert (
        enriched_context.user_id
        == context.user_id
    )

    assert (
        enriched_context.intelligence_context
        is intelligence_context
    )

    assert (
        quality_agent.received_contexts[0]
        is enriched_context
    )

"""
Unit tests for LLMService.

These tests verify that:

ConversationRequest
        |
        v
LLMService
        |
        v
Injected LLMProvider
        |
        v
ProviderResult

The tests never call a real provider API.
"""

import pytest

from backend.conversation.conversation_request import (
    ConversationRequest,
)

from backend.providers.provider_result import (
    ProviderResult,
)

from backend.services.llm_service import (
    LLMService,
)


class FakeLLMProvider:
    """
    Deterministic LLM provider for service tests.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        result: ProviderResult,
    ) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.received_request = None

    async def generate(
        self,
        request: ConversationRequest,
    ) -> ProviderResult:
        self.received_request = request

        return self.result


def create_request() -> ConversationRequest:
    """
    Create a valid provider-independent request.
    """

    return ConversationRequest(
        system_instruction=(
            "You are Yeti, a friendly AI companion."
        ),
        user_prompt=(
            "Explain artificial intelligence."
        ),
        character_id="yeti",
        character_name="Yeti",
    )


def test_llm_service_rejects_none_provider():
    """
    LLMService must require a provider.
    """

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="LLM provider cannot be None",
    ):
        LLMService(
            None,
        )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_llm_service_delegates_to_provider():
    """
    LLMService should delegate the request to the
    injected provider.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            output="Fake AI response",
        )
    )

    service = LLMService(
        provider,
    )

    request = create_request()

    result = await service.generate(
        request,
    )

    assert result.success is True

    assert result.provider_id == (
        "fake_llm"
    )

    assert result.output == (
        "Fake AI response"
    )

    assert provider.received_request is request


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_llm_service_preserves_provider_failure():
    """
    Provider failures should be returned unchanged
    as ProviderResult.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=False,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            error="Provider unavailable",
        )
    )

    service = LLMService(
        provider,
    )

    result = await service.generate(
        create_request(),
    )

    assert result.success is False

    assert result.provider_id == (
        "fake_llm"
    )

    assert result.output is None

    assert result.error == (
        "Provider unavailable"
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_llm_service_rejects_none_request():
    """
    LLMService should reject a missing request before
    invoking the provider.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="fake_llm",
            output="Should not execute",
        )
    )

    service = LLMService(
        provider,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="Conversation request cannot be None",
    ):
        await service.generate(
            None,
        )

    assert provider.received_request is None


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_llm_service_rejects_provider_without_result():
    """
    A provider returning None violates the service
    execution contract and should produce a RuntimeError.
    """

    provider = FakeLLMProvider(
        None,
    )

    service = LLMService(
        provider,
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        RuntimeError,
        match="LLM provider returned no result",
    ):
        await service.generate(
            create_request(),
        )

"""
Tests for Content/Product Discovery Skill.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.content_product_discovery import (
    ContentProductDiscoverySkill,
    DiscoveryCandidate,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.query_generation import (
    DiscoveryQuery,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


class FakeDiscoveryGateway:
    """
    Deterministic gateway used for Skill tests.

    No external provider is called.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        candidates: list[DiscoveryCandidate],
    ) -> None:
        self.candidates = candidates
        self.queries: list[DiscoveryQuery] = []

    async def discover(
        self,
        query: DiscoveryQuery,
    ) -> list[DiscoveryCandidate]:
        self.queries.append(query)
        return self.candidates


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_discovers_candidates_through_gateway():
    gateway = FakeDiscoveryGateway(
        [
            DiscoveryCandidate(
                title="AI Podcast",
                url="https://example.com/podcast",
                description="A podcast about AI.",
                content_type="podcast",
                source="test",
            ),
            DiscoveryCandidate(
                title="AI News",
                url="https://example.com/news",
                description="Latest AI news.",
                content_type="news",
                source="test",
            ),
        ]
    )

    skill = ContentProductDiscoverySkill(
        gateway=gateway,
    )

    query = DiscoveryQuery(
        query="artificial intelligence podcast",
        content_type="podcast",
        topics=("artificial intelligence",),
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find an AI podcast.",
            metadata={
                "discovery_queries": [query],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.content_product_discovery"
    )

    assert len(result.output) == 2

    assert result.output[0].title == "AI Podcast"
    assert result.output[0].content_type == "podcast"

    assert len(gateway.queries) == 1
    assert gateway.queries[0] == query


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_requires_discovery_queries():
    gateway = FakeDiscoveryGateway([])

    skill = ContentProductDiscoverySkill(
        gateway=gateway,
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find something interesting.",
        )
    )

    assert result.success is False
    assert result.error == (
        "discovery_queries are required."
    )

    )

"""
Tests for Discovery Quality Verification Skill.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.content_product_discovery import (
    DiscoveryCandidate,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.personalised_content_adaptation import (
    PersonalisedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_explanation import (
    RecommendationExplanation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_ranking import (
    RankedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.relevance_matching import (
    RelevanceMatch,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.discovery_quality_verification import (
    DiscoveryQualityVerificationSkill,
    QualityFinding,
    VerifiedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


def make_recommendation(
    *,
    title: str = "AI French Podcast",
    url: str = "https://example.com/ai",
    description: str = (
        "A French podcast about artificial intelligence."
    ),
    content_type: str = "podcast",
    score: float = 0.95,
    rank: int = 1,
    explanation: str = (
        "Recommended because it matches your "
        "interest in artificial intelligence."
    ),
    personalised_title: str = "AI French Podcast",
    personalised_summary: str = (
        "A French podcast about artificial intelligence."
    ),
    learning_suggestion: str = (
        "Explore this at your B2 level."
    ),
) -> PersonalisedRecommendation:
    """
    Build a valid personalised recommendation for testing.
    """

    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title=title,
        url=url,
        description=description,
        content_type=content_type,
        source="test",
    )

    match = RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=candidate,
        score=score,
    )

    ranked = RankedRecommendation(
        match=match,
        rank=rank,
    )

    explanation_result = RecommendationExplanation(
        recommendation=ranked,
        explanation=explanation,
        reasons=(
            "matches your interests",
        ),
    )

    return PersonalisedRecommendation(
        recommendation=explanation_result,
        personalised_title=personalised_title,
        personalised_summary=personalised_summary,
        learning_suggestion=learning_suggestion,
        adaptation_reasons=(
            "adapted to learner preferences",
        ),
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_valid_recommendation_passes_quality_gate():
    """
    A complete recommendation should pass verification.
    """

    skill = DiscoveryQualityVerificationSkill()

    recommendation = make_recommendation()

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find an AI podcast.",
            metadata={
                "personalised_recommendations": [
                    recommendation,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.quality_verification"
    )

    output = result.output

    assert output["verified_count"] == 1
    assert output["rejected_count"] == 0

    assert len(output["verified"]) == 1
    assert len(output["rejected"]) == 0

    verified = output["verified"][0]

    assert isinstance(
        verified,
        VerifiedRecommendation,
    )

    assert verified.recommendation == (
        recommendation
    )

    assert isinstance(
        verified.quality,
        QualityFinding,
    )

    assert verified.quality.passed is True
    assert verified.quality.findings == ()

"""
Tests for the Parallel Discovery Gateway.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.providers.provider_result import ProviderResult
from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import ExecutionContext
from backend.skills.discovery.parallel_gateway import (
    ParallelDiscoveryGateway,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.query_generation import (
    DiscoveryQuery,
)


class FakeParallelProvider:
    """
    Deterministic fake provider.

    No Parallel credentials or external API are required.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        result: ProviderResult,
    ) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.contexts: list[ExecutionContext] = []

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> ProviderResult:
        self.contexts.append(context)
        return self.result


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gateway_normalises_parallel_results():
    provider = FakeParallelProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="parallel_search",
            output={
                "results": [
                    {
                        "title": "AI Podcast",
                        "url": "https://example.com/podcast",
                        "excerpts": [
                            "An introduction to AI."
                        ],
                    },
                    {
                        "title": "AI News",
                        "url": "https://example.com/news",
                        "snippet": "Latest AI developments.",
                    },
                ]
            },
        )
    )

    gateway = ParallelDiscoveryGateway(
        provider=provider,
    )

    query = DiscoveryQuery(
        query="artificial intelligence podcast",
        content_type="podcast",
        topics=("artificial intelligence",),
        languages=("french",),
        learning_level="B2",
    )

    candidates = await gateway.discover(query)

    assert len(candidates) == 2

    assert candidates[0].title == "AI Podcast"
    assert candidates[0].url == (
        "https://example.com/podcast"
    )
    assert candidates[0].content_type == "podcast"
    assert candidates[0].source == "parallel"
    assert candidates[0].description == (
        "An introduction to AI."
    )

    assert candidates[1].title == "AI News"
    assert candidates[1].description == (
        "Latest AI developments."
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_gateway_passes_query_to_provider_context():
    provider = FakeParallelProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=True,
            provider_id="parallel_search",
            output={
                "results": []
            },
        )
    )

    gateway = ParallelDiscoveryGateway(
        provider=provider,
    )

    query = DiscoveryQuery(
        query="AI podcasts in French",
        content_type="podcast",
        topics=("artificial intelligence",),
        languages=("french",),
        learning_level="B2",
        constraints=("beginner friendly",),
    )

    await gateway.discover(query)

    assert len(provider.contexts) == 1

    context = provider.contexts[0]

    assert context.user_id == "discovery-system"
    assert context.request == (
        "AI podcasts in French"
    )

    assert context.metadata["content_type"] == (
        "podcast"
    )

    assert context.metadata["topics"] == (
        "artificial intelligence",
    )

    assert context.metadata["languages"] == (
        "french",
    )

    assert context.metadata["learning_level"] == (
        "B2"
    )

    assert context.metadata["constraints"] == (
        "beginner friendly",
    )

    provider = FakeParallelProvider(
        ProviderResult(
            success=False,
            provider_id="parallel_search",
            error="Parallel unavailable.",
        )
    )

    gateway = ParallelDiscoveryGateway(
        provider=provider,
    )

    query = DiscoveryQuery(
        query="AI news",
        content_type="news",
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        RuntimeError,
        match="Parallel unavailable.",
    ):
        await gateway.discover(query)

"""
Tests for Discovery Query Generation Skill.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.preference_understanding import (
    DiscoveryProfile,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.query_generation import (
    DiscoveryQuery,
    DiscoveryQueryGenerationSkill,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_generates_queries_for_multiple_content_types():
    """
    Query generation should create one provider-independent query
    for each approved content type.
    """

    skill = DiscoveryQueryGenerationSkill()

    profile = DiscoveryProfile(
        topics=(
            "artificial intelligence",
            "technology",
        ),
        content_types=(
            "podcast",
            "news",
            "product",
        ),
        languages=(
            "french",
        ),
        learning_level="B2",
        explicit_constraints=(
            "beginner friendly",
        ),
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find useful content about AI.",
            user_id="query-test-user",
            metadata={
                "discovery_profile": profile,
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.query_generation"
    )

    queries = result.output

    assert len(queries) == 3
    assert all(
        isinstance(query, DiscoveryQuery)
        for query in queries
    )

    assert [
        query.content_type
        for query in queries
    ] == [
        "podcast",
        "news",
        "product",
    ]

    assert all(
        "artificial intelligence" in query.query
        for query in queries
    )

    assert all(
        "french" in query.query
        for query in queries
    )

    assert all(
        "B2" in query.query
        for query in queries
    )

    assert all(
        "beginner friendly" in query.query
        for query in queries
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_explicit_request_remains_in_query():
    """
    The learner's current request must remain the primary intent.
    """

    skill = DiscoveryQueryGenerationSkill()

    profile = DiscoveryProfile(

"""
Tests for Discovery Recommendation Explanation Skill.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.content_product_discovery import (
    DiscoveryCandidate,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_explanation import (
    RecommendationExplanation,
    RecommendationExplanationSkill,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_ranking import (
    RankedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.relevance_matching import (
    RelevanceMatch,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


def make_recommendation() -> RankedRecommendation:
    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title="AI French Podcast",
        url="https://example.com/ai",
        description=(
            "A French podcast about artificial "
            "intelligence."
        ),
        content_type="podcast",
        source="test",
    )

    match = RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=candidate,
        score=0.95,
        matched_topics=(
            "artificial intelligence",
            "technology",
        ),
        matched_languages=(
            "french",
        ),
        matched_content_type=True,
        matched_learning_level=True,
        matched_constraints=(
            "beginner friendly",
        ),
    )

    return RankedRecommendation(
        match=match,
        rank=1,
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_explains_recommendation_from_evidence():
    skill = RecommendationExplanationSkill()

    recommendation = make_recommendation()

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find something useful.",
            metadata={
                "ranked_recommendations": [
                    recommendation,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.recommendation_explanation"
    )

    explanations = result.output

    assert len(explanations) == 1

    explanation = explanations[0]

    assert isinstance(
        explanation,
        RecommendationExplanation,
    )

    assert explanation.recommendation == (
        recommendation
    )

    assert "artificial intelligence" in (
        explanation.explanation
    )

    assert "technology" in (
        explanation.explanation
    )

    assert "french" in (
        explanation.explanation
    )

    assert "podcast" in (
        explanation.explanation
    )

    assert "beginner friendly" in (
        explanation.explanation
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_explanation_does_not_invent_reasons():
    skill = RecommendationExplanationSkill()

    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title="General Podcast",
        url="https://example.com/general",
        description="A general podcast.",
        content_type="podcast",
        source="test",
    )

    match = RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=candidate,
        score=0.20,
    )

    recommendation = RankedRecommendation(
        match=match,
        rank=1,
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find something.",
            metadata={
                "ranked_recommendations": [
                    recommendation,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True

    explanation = result.output[0]

    assert explanation.reasons == (
        "was selected because it received "
        "a relevance assessment from the "
        "discovery pipeline",
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio

    skill = RecommendationExplanationSkill()

    first = make_recommendation()

    second_candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title="Technology News",
        url="https://example.com/news",
        description="Technology news.",
        content_type="news",
        source="test",
    )

    second_match = RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=second_candidate,
        score=0.80,
        matched_topics=(
            "technology",
        ),
        matched_content_type=True,
    )

    second = RankedRecommendation(
        match=second_match,
        rank=2,
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find content.",
            metadata={
                "ranked_recommendations": [
                    first,
                    second,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert len(result.output) == 2

    assert result.output[0].recommendation.rank == 1
    assert result.output[1].recommendation.rank == 2

"""
Tests for Discovery Recommendation Ranking Skill.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.content_product_discovery import (
    DiscoveryCandidate,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.relevance_matching import (
    RelevanceMatch,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_ranking import (
    RankedRecommendation,
    RecommendationRankingSkill,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


def make_match(
    *,
    title: str,
    score: float,
) -> RelevanceMatch:
    """Create a deterministic relevance match for testing."""

    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title=title,
        url=f"https://example.com/{title.lower().replace(' ', '-')}",
        description=f"Description for {title}.",
        content_type="podcast",
        source="test",
    )

    return RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=candidate,
        score=score,
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_ranks_matches_by_score_descending():
    skill = RecommendationRankingSkill()

    matches = [
        make_match(
            title="Low Match",
            score=0.30,
        ),
        make_match(
            title="High Match",
            score=0.95,
        ),
        make_match(
            title="Medium Match",
            score=0.65,
        ),
    ]

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find relevant podcasts.",
            metadata={
                "relevance_matches": matches,
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.recommendation_ranking"
    )

    recommendations = result.output

    assert len(recommendations) == 3

    assert all(
        isinstance(
            recommendation,
            RankedRecommendation,
        )
        for recommendation in recommendations
    )

    assert recommendations[0].candidate.title == (
        "High Match"
    )
    assert recommendations[1].candidate.title == (
        "Medium Match"
    )
    assert recommendations[2].candidate.title == (
        "Low Match"
    )

    assert recommendations[0].score == 0.95
    assert recommendations[1].score == 0.65
    assert recommendations[2].score == 0.30


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_assigns_one_based_ranking_positions():
    skill = RecommendationRankingSkill()

    matches = [
        make_match(
            title="First",
            score=0.90,
        ),
        make_match(
            title="Second",
            score=0.80,
        ),
        make_match(
            title="Third",
            score=0.70,
        ),
    ]

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find podcasts.",
            metadata={
                "relevance_matches": matches,
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True

    recommendations = result.output

    assert [
        recommendation.rank
        for recommendation in recommendations
    ] == [1, 2, 3]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_preserves_discovery_order_for_equal_scores():
    skill = RecommendationRankingSkill()

    matches = [
        make_match(

    ]

    result = await skill.execute(

                "relevance_matches": matches,

        "Third",
    ]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_applies_recommendation_limit():
    skill = RecommendationRankingSkill()

    matches = [
        make_match(
            title=f"Candidate {index}",
            score=1.0 - (index * 0.1),
        )
        for index in range(5)
    ]

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find podcasts.",
            metadata={
                "relevance_matches": matches,
                "recommendation_limit": 3,
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True

    recommendations = result.output

    assert len(recommendations) == 3

    assert [
        recommendation.rank
        for recommendation in recommendations
    ] == [1, 2, 3]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_matches_relevant_candidate():
    skill = RelevanceMatchingSkill()

    profile = DiscoveryProfile(
        topics=(
            "artificial intelligence",
            "technology",
        ),
        content_types=(
            "podcast",
        ),
        languages=(
            "french",
        ),
        learning_level="B2",
        explicit_constraints=(
            "beginner friendly",
        ),
    )

    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title="Artificial Intelligence Podcast",
        url="https://example.com/ai",
        description=(
            "A beginner friendly French podcast "

        ),
        content_type="podcast",
        source="test",
        metadata={
            "language": "french",
        },
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request=(
                "Find a French AI podcast."
            ),
            metadata={
                "discovery_profile": profile,
                "discovery_candidates": [
                    candidate,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.relevance_matching"
    )

    matches = result.output

    assert len(matches) == 1
    assert isinstance(
        matches[0],
        RelevanceMatch,
    )

    match = matches[0]

    assert match.score > 0
    assert "artificial intelligence" in (
        match.matched_topics

"""
Tests for Discovery User Choice & Controlled Handoff Skill.

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from backend.skills.discovery.content_product_discovery import (
    DiscoveryCandidate,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.discovery_quality_verification import (
    VerifiedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.personalised_content_adaptation import (
    PersonalisedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_explanation import (
    RecommendationExplanation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.recommendation_ranking import (
    RankedRecommendation,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.relevance_matching import (
    RelevanceMatch,
)
from backend.skills.discovery.user_choice_handoff import (
    ControlledHandoff,
    HandoffOption,
    UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill,
)
from backend.skills.skill import SkillInput


def make_verified_recommendation(
    *,
    title: str,
    rank: int,
) -> VerifiedRecommendation:
    """Create a valid verified recommendation."""

    candidate = DiscoveryCandidate(
        title=title,
        url=(
            f"https://example.com/"
            f"{rank}"
        ),
        description=(
            f"Description for {title}."
        ),
        content_type="podcast",
        source="test",
    )

    match = RelevanceMatch(
        candidate=candidate,
        score=0.90,
    )

    ranked = RankedRecommendation(
        match=match,
        rank=rank,
    )

    explanation = RecommendationExplanation(
        recommendation=ranked,
        explanation=(
            f"{title} was recommended "
            "because it matches the "
            "discovery request."
        ),
        reasons=(
            "matches the discovery request",
        ),
    )

    personalised = PersonalisedRecommendation(
        recommendation=explanation,
        personalised_title=title,
        personalised_summary=(
            f"Personalised summary for {title}."
        ),
        learning_suggestion=(
            "Explore this recommendation."
        ),
        adaptation_reasons=(
            "adapted to learner preferences",
        ),
    )

    quality = (
        __import__(
            "backend.skills.discovery.discovery_quality_verification",
            fromlist=["QualityFinding"],
        ).QualityFinding(
            rank=rank,
            passed=True,
            findings=(),
        )
    )

    return VerifiedRecommendation(
        recommendation=personalised,
        quality=quality,
    )


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_without_selection_skill_waits_for_user_choice():
    """
    The Skill must never automatically select a recommendation.
    """

    skill = UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill()

    first = make_verified_recommendation(
        title="AI Podcast",
        rank=1,
    )

    second = make_verified_recommendation(
        title="Technology News",
        rank=2,
    )

    result = await skill.execute(
        SkillInput(
            request="Find AI content.",
            metadata={
                "verified_recommendations": [
                    first,
                    second,
                ],
            },
        )
    )

    assert result.success is True
    assert result.skill_id == (
        "discovery.user_choice_handoff"
    )

    assert result.output["status"] == (
        "awaiting_user_choice"
    )

    assert result.output["handoff"] is None

    options = result.output["options"]

    assert len(options) == 2

    assert all(
        isinstance(
            option,
            HandoffOption,
        )
        for option in options
    )

    assert options[0].option_id == (
        "recommendation-1"
    )

    assert options[1].option_id == (
        "recommendation-2"
    )

    """
    A valid explicit learner selection creates a handoff.
    """

    skill = UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill()

    first = make_verified_recommendation(
        title="AI Podcast",
        rank=1,
    )

    second = make_verified_recommendation(

    )

        SkillInput(

                ),

        "recommendation-2"
    )

    assert handoff.rank == 2

    assert (
        handoff.recommendation
        .personalised_title
        == "Technology News"
    )

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from backend.app.application.academy.academy_one_week_workflow import (
    AcademyOneWeekWorkflow,
)


class FakeUsers:
    def __init__(self, users):
        self.users = users

    async def list_one_week_candidates(self, *, window_start, window_end):
        return self.users


class FakeDeliveries:
    def __init__(self):
        self.claims = 0
        self.succeeded = []
        self.failed = []
        self.already_sent = False

    async def claim(self, *, user_id, notification_type, now):
        if self.already_sent:
            return None
        self.claims += 1
        self.already_sent = True
        return object()

    async def mark_succeeded(
        self, *, user_id, notification_type, provider_message_id, now
    ):
        self.succeeded.append(provider_message_id)

    async def mark_failed(self, *, user_id, notification_type, error, now):
        self.failed.append(error)


class FakeNotifications:
    @staticmethod
    def is_one_week_eligible(*, registered_at, now):
        age = now - registered_at
        return timedelta(days=7) <= age < timedelta(days=8)

    async def send_one_week(self, *, email, username, telegram_chat_id):
        return {
            "email": {
                "status": "accepted",
                "message_id": "academy-test-message",
            }
        }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_successful_delivery_is_recorded():
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 27, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    user = type(
        "User",
        (),
        {
            "user_id": uuid4(),
            "email": "test@example.com",
            "username": "tester",
            "created_at": now - timedelta(days=7),
        },
    )()

    deliveries = FakeDeliveries()
    workflow = AcademyOneWeekWorkflow(
        users=FakeUsers([user]),
        deliveries=deliveries,
        notifications=FakeNotifications(),
        clock=lambda: now,
    )

    result = await workflow.run()

    assert result["succeeded"] == 1
    assert result["failed"] == 0
    assert deliveries.succeeded == ["academy-test-message"]


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_second_run_is_idempotent():
    now = datetime(2026, 8, 27, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    user = type(
        "User",
        (),
        {
            "user_id": uuid4(),
            "email": "test@example.com",
            "username": "tester",
            "created_at": now - timedelta(days=7),
        },
    )()

    deliveries = FakeDeliveries()
    workflow = AcademyOneWeekWorkflow(
        users=FakeUsers([user]),
        deliveries=deliveries,
        notifications=FakeNotifications(),
        clock=lambda: now,
    )

    first = await workflow.run()
    second = await workflow.run()

    assert first["succeeded"] == 1
    assert second["skipped"] == 1
    assert deliveries.claims == 1

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

import pytest

from backend.app.application.academy.academy_one_week_workflow import (
    AcademyOneWeekWorkflow,
)


class Users:
    async def list_one_week_candidates(self, *, window_start, window_end):
        now = datetime(2026, 8, 27, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return [
            type(
                "User",
                (),
                {
                    "user_id": uuid4(),
                    "email": "test@example.com",
                    "username": "tester",
                    "created_at": now - timedelta(days=7),
                },
            )()
        ]


class Deliveries:
    def __init__(self):
        self.failed = []

    async def claim(self, *, user_id, notification_type, now):
        return object()

    async def mark_succeeded(
        self, *, user_id, notification_type, provider_message_id, now
    ):
        raise AssertionError("Success path must not execute")

    async def mark_failed(self, *, user_id, notification_type, error, now):
        self.failed.append(error)


class FailingNotifications:
    @staticmethod
    def is_one_week_eligible(*, registered_at, now):
        return True

    async def send_one_week(self, *, email, username, telegram_chat_id):
        raise RuntimeError("provider unavailable")


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_provider_failure_is_persisted_as_retryable_failure():
    deliveries = Deliveries()
    workflow = AcademyOneWeekWorkflow(
        users=Users(),
        deliveries=deliveries,
        notifications=FailingNotifications(),
        clock=lambda: datetime(2026, 8, 27, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
    )

    result = await workflow.run()

    assert result["failed"] == 1
    assert deliveries.failed == ["provider unavailable"]

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from backend.app.application.academy_notification_formatters import (
    AcademyEmailFormatter,
    AcademyTelegramFormatter,
)
from backend.app.application.academy_notification_service import (
    OneWeekNotificationOrchestrator,
)
from backend.app.domain.academy_notification import (
    AcademyNotification,
    AcademyNotificationType,
)


class FakeEmail:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    async def send(self, subject: str, content: dict) -> dict:
        self.calls.append((subject, content))
        return {"provider": "fake-email", "status": "accepted"}


class FakeTelegram:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[dict] = []

    async def send(self, *, chat_id: str, text: str, portal_url: str) -> dict:
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "chat_id": chat_id,
                "text": text,
                "portal_url": portal_url,
            }
        )
        return {"provider": "fake-telegram", "status": "accepted"}


def _notification() -> AcademyNotification:
    return AcademyNotification(
        AcademyNotificationType.ONE_WEEK_MILESTONE,
        "Davideasychabot",
        "http://localhost:3000/dashboard",
    )


def test_email_has_clickable_main_and_footer_logo(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    logo = tmp_path / "easychatbot-logo.png"
    logo.write_bytes(b"test")

    rendered = AcademyEmailFormatter(logo_path=logo).render(_notification())
    html = rendered["html"]

    assert html.count('href="http://localhost:3000/dashboard"') >= 3
    assert html.count("cid:easychatbot-logo") == 2
    assert rendered["attachments"] == [
        {
            "path": str(logo),
            "filename": "easychatbot-logo.png",
            "inline": True,
            "content_id": "easychatbot-logo",
        }
    ]


def test_email_has_configuration_driven_social_destinations(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    logo = tmp_path / "easychatbot-logo.png"
    logo.write_bytes(b"test")

    rendered = AcademyEmailFormatter(
        logo_path=logo,
        x_url="https://example.com/x",
        instagram_url="https://example.com/instagram",
        linkedin_url="https://example.com/linkedin",
        youtube_url="https://example.com/youtube",
    ).render(_notification())

    html = rendered["html"]

    assert 'href="https://example.com/x"' in html
    assert 'href="https://example.com/instagram"' in html
    assert 'href="https://example.com/linkedin"' in html
    assert 'href="https://example.com/youtube"' in html


def test_telegram_keeps_portal_button_contract() -> None:
    text = AcademyTelegramFormatter().render(_notification())
    assert "@Davideasychabot" in text
    assert "Congratulations" in text


def test_orchestrator_passes_inline_logo_asset() -> None:
    import asyncio

    async def run() -> None:
        email = FakeEmail()
        telegram = FakeTelegram()

        # The production formatter validates the logo path. A deterministic
        # temporary logo is used for this integration-level unit test.
        import tempfile

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            logo = Path(directory) / "easychatbot-logo.png"
            logo.write_bytes(b"test")

            service = OneWeekNotificationOrchestrator(
                email_sender=email,
                telegram_sender=telegram,
                email_formatter=AcademyEmailFormatter(logo_path=logo),
                telegram_formatter=AcademyTelegramFormatter(),
                registration_email="registrationeasychatbot@resend.dev",
                portal_url="http://localhost:3000/dashboard",
            )

            result = await service.send_one_week(
                email="test@example.com",
                username="Davideasychabot",
                telegram_chat_id="123456",
            )

            content = email.calls[0][1]
            assert content["from"] == "registrationeasychatbot@resend.dev"
            assert content["email_type"] == "academy_notification"
            assert content["attachments"][0]["inline"] is True
            assert content["attachments"][0]["content_id"] == "easychatbot-logo"
            assert result["notification_type"] == "1_WEEK_MILESTONE"
            assert telegram.calls[0]["chat_id"] == "123456"
            assert telegram.calls[0]["portal_url"] == "http://localhost:3000/dashboard"

    asyncio.run(run())


def test_one_week_eligibility_window() -> None:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    assert OneWeekNotificationOrchestrator.is_one_week_eligible(
        registered_at=now - timedelta(days=7),
        now=now,
    )
    assert not OneWeekNotificationOrchestrator.is_one_week_eligible(
        registered_at=now - timedelta(days=6),
        now=now,
    )

"""
Tests for Voice Notification Acceptance API.

Validates:

HTTP Request
      |
      â†“
Accept Notification
      |
      â†“
VoiceCallAcceptanceService
      |
      â†“
Voice Session Response


Does NOT:
- Test LiveKit.
- Test providers.
- Test repositories directly.
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


from app.main import app



client = TestClient(
    app
)



def test_accept_existing_voice_notification():
    """
    Verify accepting an existing notification.

    Expected:
    - HTTP 200
    - voice_call_id returned
    - session_id returned
    - character identity preserved
    """


    #
    # Create voice call trigger first.
    #
    # This simulates:
    #
    # VoiceCall
    #      |
    #      â†“
    # Invitation
    #      |
    #      â†“
    # Notification
    #

    trigger_response = client.post(
        "/voice/trigger",
        json={
            "learner_id": "learner-001",
            "character_id": "yeti",
            "world_id": "french_world",
            "language_code": "fr",
            "channel": "inbox",
        },
    )


    assert trigger_response.status_code == 200


    trigger_body = (
        trigger_response.json()
    )


    notification_id = (
        trigger_body["notification_id"]
    )


    voice_call_id = (
        trigger_body["voice_call_id"]
    )


    #
    # Accept notification
    #

    response = client.post(
        f"/voice/notification/{notification_id}/accept"
    )


    print(
        response.json()
    )


    assert response.status_code == 200


    body = response.json()


    assert body["voice_call_id"] == (
        voice_call_id
    )


    assert body["learner_id"] == (
        "learner-001"
    )


    assert body["character_id"] == (
        "yeti"
    )


    assert body["session_id"]


    assert body["state"]



def test_accept_unknown_notification():

    """
    Unknown notification must return 404.
    """


    response = client.post(
        "/voice/notification/unknown/accept"
    )


    assert response.status_code == 404

"""
Tests for Voice Call Notification Repository.

Validates the repository contract.

Responsibilities tested:
- Save notification.
- Retrieve notification.
- Delete notification.

The concrete infrastructure
implementation is tested separately.
"""

from datetime import (
    datetime,
    timedelta,
    timezone,
)


import pytest


from app.application.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification_repository import (
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification import (
    VoiceCallNotification,
    VoiceCallNotificationChannel,
    VoiceCallNotificationStatus,
)



class FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository(
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository port.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
    ):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        notification: VoiceCallNotification,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification:

        self.storage[
            notification.id
        ] = notification


        return notification



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            notification_id
        )



    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.storage.pop(
            notification_id,
            None,
        )



def create_repository():

    return (
        FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository()
    )



def create_notification():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallNotification(
        id="notification-001",
        invitation_id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel=(
            VoiceCallNotificationChannel.INBOX
        ),
        status=(
            VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
        ),
        created_at=now,
    )



def test_save_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    result = repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    assert result.id == (
        "notification-001"
    )



def test_get_notification_by_id():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    stored = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    )


    assert stored is not None


    assert stored.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )



def test_unknown_notification_returns_none():

    repository = create_repository()


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="unknown",
    )


    assert result is None



def test_delete_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    repository.delete(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    )


    assert repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    ) is None

from datetime import (

def create_notification():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallNotification(
        id="notification-001",
        invitation_id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel=(
            VoiceCallNotificationChannel.INBOX
        ),

            VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
        ),

    )



def test_create_voice_call_notification():

    notification = (
        create_notification()
    )


    assert notification.id == (
        "notification-001"
    )


    assert notification.invitation_id == (
        "inv-001"
    )


    assert notification.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )


    assert notification.learner_id == (
        "learner-001"
    )


    assert notification.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )


    assert notification.channel == (
        VoiceCallNotificationChannel.INBOX
    )


    assert notification.status == (
        VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
    )



def test_notification_lifecycle():

    notification = (
        create_notification()
    )


    pending = (
        notification
        .mark_pending()
    )


    sent = (
        pending
        .mark_sent()
    )


    read = (
        sent
        .mark_read()
    )


    actioned = (
        read
        .mark_actioned()
    )


    assert actioned.status == (
        VoiceCallNotificationStatus.ACTIONED
    )



def test_notification_failed_state():

    notification = (
        create_notification()
    )


    failed = (
        notification
        .mark_failed()
    )


    assert failed.status == (
        VoiceCallNotificationStatus.FAILED
    )



def test_notification_is_recent():

    notification = (
        create_notification()
    )


    result = notification.is_recent(
        now=(
            datetime.now(
                timezone.utc
            )
            +
            timedelta(
                minutes=5
            )
        ),
    )


    assert result is True

            )

    assert result is False

        timezone.utc
    )


    try:

        VoiceCallNotification(
            id="",

            voice_call_id="vc-001",

            channel=(
                VoiceCallNotificationChannel.EMAIL
            ),
            status=(
                VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
            ),
            created_at=now,
        )


        assert False

        assert str(exc) == (
            "Notification id is required."
        )
